var echoSuppressSoundUntil = Date.now() + 6000;

function unlockEchoNotificationSound() {
  if (echoSoundUnlocked) return;
  var audio = document.getElementById('echo-notification-sound');
  if (!audio) return;
  var oldVolume = audio.volume;
  audio.volume = 0;
  var p = audio.play();
  if (p && p.then) {
    p.then(function() {
      audio.pause();
      audio.currentTime = 0;
      audio.volume = oldVolume;
      echoSoundUnlocked = true;
    }).catch(function() {
      audio.volume = oldVolume;
    });
  } else {
    audio.pause();
    audio.currentTime = 0;
    audio.volume = oldVolume;
    echoSoundUnlocked = true;
  }
}

document.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlockEchoNotificationSound, { once: true });
document.addEventListener('keydown', unlockEchoNotificationSound, { once: true });

function playEchoNotificationSound() {
  if (!echoSoundUnlocked || Date.now() < echoSuppressSoundUntil) return;
  var now = Date.now();
  if (now - echoLastSoundAt < 1200) return;
  var audio = document.getElementById('echo-notification-sound');
  if (!audio) return;
  echoLastSoundAt = now;
  try {
    audio.pause();
    audio.currentTime = 0;
    audio.volume = 1;
    var p = audio.play();
    if (p && p.catch) p.catch(function() {});
  } catch(e) {}
}
var profileNameColorCycleFrame = null;
var profileNameColorCycleStartedAt = 0;

function stopProfileNameColorCycle() {
  if (profileNameColorCycleFrame !== null) {
    cancelAnimationFrame(profileNameColorCycleFrame);
    profileNameColorCycleFrame = null;
  }
  profileNameColorCycleStartedAt = 0;
}

function startProfileNameColorCycle(el) {
  stopProfileNameColorCycle();
  if (!el) return;

  profileNameColorCycleStartedAt = performance.now();

  function tick(now) {
    if (!el.classList.contains('name-color-cycle')) {
      stopProfileNameColorCycle();
      return;
    }

    var elapsed = now - profileNameColorCycleStartedAt;
    var hue = (elapsed / 1500 * 360) % 360;
    el.style.setProperty('color', 'hsl(' + hue.toFixed(1) + ', 100%, 50%)', 'important');
    profileNameColorCycleFrame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  profileNameColorCycleFrame = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

var profileNameLetterShuffleTimer = null;
var profileNameLetterShuffleTickTimer = null;

function setProfileNameTextOnly(el, value) {
  if (!el) return;
  var textNode = null;
  for (var i = 0; i < el.childNodes.length; i++) {
    if (el.childNodes[i].nodeType === 3) {
      textNode = el.childNodes[i];
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!textNode) {
    textNode = document.createTextNode('');
    el.insertBefore(textNode, el.firstChild);
  }
  textNode.nodeValue = value;
}

function getProfileNameTextOnly(el) {
  if (!el) return '';
  for (var i = 0; i < el.childNodes.length; i++) {
    if (el.childNodes[i].nodeType === 3) return el.childNodes[i].nodeValue || '';
  }
  return '';
}

function randomShuffleCharacter(original) {
  if (/[A-Z]/.test(original)) {
    var upper = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
    return upper.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * upper.length));
  }
  if (/[a-z]/.test(original)) {
    var lower = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz';
    return lower.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * lower.length));
  }
  if (/[0-9]/.test(original)) {
    return String(Math.floor(Math.random() * 10));
  }
  return original;
}

function stopProfileNameLetterShuffle(el) {
  if (profileNameLetterShuffleTimer) {
    clearTimeout(profileNameLetterShuffleTimer);
    profileNameLetterShuffleTimer = null;
  }
  if (profileNameLetterShuffleTickTimer) {
    clearTimeout(profileNameLetterShuffleTickTimer);
    profileNameLetterShuffleTickTimer = null;
  }

  if (el) {
    var realName = el.getAttribute('data-echo-real-name');
    if (realName !== null) setProfileNameTextOnly(el, realName);
  }
}

function startProfileNameLetterShuffle(el) {
  stopProfileNameLetterShuffle(el);
  if (!el) return;

  var realName = el.getAttribute('data-echo-real-name');
  if (!realName) {
    realName = getProfileNameTextOnly(el).trim();
    el.setAttribute('data-echo-real-name', realName);
  }
  if (!realName) return;

  function scheduleNext() {
    if (!el.classList.contains('name-letter-shuffle')) return;
    profileNameLetterShuffleTimer = setTimeout(runShuffle, 2400 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1700));
  }

  function runShuffle() {
    if (!el.classList.contains('name-letter-shuffle')) {
      stopProfileNameLetterShuffle(el);
      return;
    }

    var startedAt = performance.now();
    var duration = 720;

    function scrambleTick() {
      if (!el.classList.contains('name-letter-shuffle')) {
        stopProfileNameLetterShuffle(el);
        return;
      }

      var progress = Math.min(1, (performance.now() - startedAt) / duration);
      var resolvedThrough = Math.floor(progress * realName.length);
      var output = '';

      for (var i = 0; i < realName.length; i++) {
        output += i < resolvedThrough ? realName.charAt(i) : randomShuffleCharacter(realName.charAt(i));
      }

      setProfileNameTextOnly(el, output);

      if (progress < 1) {
        profileNameLetterShuffleTickTimer = setTimeout(scrambleTick, 55);
      } else {
        setProfileNameTextOnly(el, realName);
        profileNameLetterShuffleTickTimer = null;
        scheduleNext();
      }
    }

    scrambleTick();
  }

  
  profileNameLetterShuffleTimer = setTimeout(runShuffle, 700);
}

  } catch(e) {}
}

  return !!history[userId];
}

function loadEchoFavoriteCounts(postIds, callback) {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var ids = (postIds || []).map(function(id) {
    return Number(id);
  }).filter(function(id) {
    return Number.isFinite(id) && id > 0;
  });

  if (!sb || !ids.length) {
    callback({});
    return;
  }

  sb.rpc('echo_favorite_counts', { p_post_ids: ids }).then(function(res) {
    var map = {};

    if (!res.error && res.data) {
      for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
        var row = res.data[i];
        map[String(row.post_id)] = Number(row.fav_count) || 0;
      }
      callback(map, null);
      return;
    }

    

    sb.from('favorites').select('post_id').in('post_id', ids).then(function(fallbackRes) {
      var fallbackMap = {};
      if (fallbackRes.data) {
        for (var j = 0; j < fallbackRes.data.length; j++) {
          var id = String(fallbackRes.data[j].post_id);
          fallbackMap[id] = (fallbackMap[id] || 0) + 1;
        }
      }
      callback(fallbackMap, fallbackRes.error || res.error || null);
    });
  });
}

function setEchoDarkMode(enabled) {
  if (enabled) document.body.classList.add('echo-dark');
  else document.body.classList.remove('echo-dark');

  var latestEchoes = document.querySelector('.home-title');
  if (latestEchoes) {
    if (enabled) latestEchoes.style.setProperty('color', '#ffffff', 'important');
    else latestEchoes.style.removeProperty('color');
  }

  var sideLogo = document.getElementById('side-echo-logo');
  if (sideLogo) {
    sideLogo.src = enabled
      ? 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/echo-logo-white_orig.png'
      : 'https://theechonetwork.weebly.com/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/ecc_orig.png';
  }

  var profileName = document.getElementById('profile-name');
  if (profileName) {
    var currentStyleBio = profileName.getAttribute('data-echo-style-bio') || '';
    var currentNameStyle = getProfileStyleData(currentStyleBio);
    if (currentNameStyle.nameColor || profileName.classList.contains('name-color-cycle')) {
      startProfileNameColorCycle(profileName);
    } else if (currentNameStyle.customNameColor) {
      profileName.style.setProperty('color', currentNameStyle.customNameColor, 'important');
    } else if (enabled) {
      profileName.style.setProperty('color', '#ffffff', 'important');
    } else {
      profileName.style.removeProperty('color');
    }
  }

  try { localStorage.setItem('echoDarkMode', enabled ? '1' : '0'); } catch(e) {}
  var toggle = document.getElementById('dark-mode-toggle');
  if (toggle) toggle.checked = !!enabled;
}

function loadEchoDarkMode() {
  var enabled = false;
  try { enabled = localStorage.getItem('echoDarkMode') === '1'; } catch(e) {}
  setEchoDarkMode(enabled);
}

function maybeShowWelcomeEcho(user) {
  if (!user) return;
  var meta = user.user_metadata || {};
  if (meta.echo_welcome_pending !== true || meta.echo_welcome_seen === true) return;

  var modal = document.getElementById('welcome-echo-modal');
  if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';

  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (sb) {
    sb.auth.updateUser({
      data: {
        echo_welcome_pending: false,
        echo_welcome_seen: true
      }
    }).then(function(res) {
      if (!res.error && res.data && res.data.user) currentUser = res.data.user;
    });
  }
}

  var modal = document.getElementById('welcome-echo-modal');

}

function checkEchoAdmin() {
  var link = document.getElementById('admin-panel-link');
  isEchoAdmin = false;
  if (link) link.style.display = 'none';
  if (!currentUser) return;

  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;
  sb.from('echo_admins').select('user_id').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) return;
    isEchoAdmin = !!res.data;
    if (link) link.style.display = isEchoAdmin ? 'block' : 'none';
  });
}

function checkPendingAdminWarning() {
  if(!currentUser) return;
  var sb=getSupabase();
  sb.from('admin_warnings').select('id,message,created_at').eq('user_id',currentUser.id).is('acknowledged_at',null).order('created_at',{ascending:true}).limit(1).then(function(res){
    if(res.error || !res.data || !res.data.length) return;
    currentAdminWarningId=res.data[0].id;
    var warningMessage = res.data[0].message || 'Echo staff have issued an account warning.';
    addNotif('admin-warning-' + res.data[0].id, currentUser.id, 'Admin warning: ' + warningMessage, null, 'admin_warning');
    document.getElementById('admin-warning-text').textContent=warningMessage;
    document.getElementById('admin-warning-modal').style.display='flex';
  });
}
function acknowledgeAdminWarning() {
  if(!currentAdminWarningId) { document.getElementById('admin-warning-modal').style.display='none'; return; }
  var sb=getSupabase();
  sb.rpc('acknowledge_echo_warning',{warning_id:currentAdminWarningId}).then(function(){
    currentAdminWarningId=null;
    document.getElementById('admin-warning-modal').style.display='none';
    setTimeout(checkPendingAdminWarning,100);
  });
}

function checkAccountModeration(callback) {
  if (!currentUser) { callback(false); return; }
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) { callback(true); return; }

  sb.from('account_moderation').select('banned, suspended_until, reason').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    
    if (res.error || !res.data) { callback(true); return; }

    if (res.data.banned) {
      var reason = res.data.reason ? '<br><br>Reason: ' + res.data.reason : '';
      sb.auth.signOut().then(function() {
        currentUser = null;
        updateUI();
        showMessage('Account banned', 'This Echo account has been banned.' + reason);
      });
      callback(false);
      return;
    }

    if (res.data.suspended_until) {
      var until = new Date(res.data.suspended_until);
      if (until > new Date()) {
        var reasonText = res.data.reason ? '<br><br>Reason: ' + res.data.reason : '';
        sb.auth.signOut().then(function() {
          currentUser = null;
          updateUI();
          showMessage('Account suspended', 'This Echo account is suspended until ' + until.toLocaleString() + '.' + reasonText);
        });
        callback(false);
        return;
      }
    }

    callback(true);
  });
}

function echoNotificationSignature(userId, text, postId, type) {
  return [
    type || 'profile',
    userId || '',
    postId || '',
    (text || '').toString()
  ].join('|');
}

function echoDismissedNotifStorageKey() {
  return currentUser && currentUser.id
    ? 'echoDismissedNotifications:' + currentUser.id
    : null;
}

function loadDismissedNotifications() {
  dismissedNotifKeys = {};
  var key = echoDismissedNotifStorageKey();
  if (!key) return;

  try {
    var parsed = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || '{}');
    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') dismissedNotifKeys = parsed;
  } catch(e) {
    dismissedNotifKeys = {};
  }
}

function saveDismissedNotifications() {
  var key = echoDismissedNotifStorageKey();
  if (!key) return;

  
  var entries = Object.keys(dismissedNotifKeys).map(function(k) {
    return [k, Number(dismissedNotifKeys[k]) || 0];
  }).sort(function(a, b) {
    return b[1] - a[1];
  }).slice(0, 500);

  var trimmed = {};
  for (var i = 0; i < entries.length; i++) trimmed[entries[i][0]] = entries[i][1];
  dismissedNotifKeys = trimmed;

  try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(dismissedNotifKeys)); } catch(e) {}
}

function loadLocal() {
  try { privacy = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('echoPrivacy') || '{"privateProfile":false,"hideFavorites":false,"postsVisibility":"everyone"}'); } catch(e) {}
  try { notifTimes = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('echoNotifTimes') || '{}'); } catch(e) {}
  try { notifications = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('echoNotifications') || '[]'); } catch(e) { notifications = []; }
  try { lastNotifCheck = localStorage.getItem('echoLastNotifCheck') || null; } catch(e) { lastNotifCheck = null; }
  try { mutedUsers = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('echoMutedUsers') || '[]'); } catch(e) { mutedUsers = []; }
  loadEchoDarkMode();

  

  syncNotificationBellState();
}
function saveNotifTimes() { try { localStorage.setItem('echoNotifTimes', JSON.stringify(notifTimes)); } catch(e) {} }
function saveNotifications() { try { localStorage.setItem('echoNotifications', JSON.stringify(notifications)); } catch(e) {} }
function savePrivacy() {
  privacy.privateProfile = document.getElementById('private-profile').checked;
  privacy.hideFavorites = document.getElementById('hide-favorites').checked;
  privacy.postsVisibility = document.getElementById('posts-visibility').value;
  try { localStorage.setItem('echoPrivacy', JSON.stringify(privacy)); } catch(e) {}
  if (!currentUser) return;
  if (privacySaveTimer) clearTimeout(privacySaveTimer);
  privacySaveTimer = setTimeout(savePrivacyToProfile, 250);
}

function savePrivacyToProfile() {
  if (!currentUser) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('profiles').select('bio').eq('id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) { showMessage('Error', res.error.message); return; }
    var style = getProfileStyleData((res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
    var storedBio = buildStoredBio(
      style.bio, style.moving, style.bioColor, style.nameColor,
      style.avatarGlow, style.avatarFloat, style.profileAura,
      style.profileNameGlow, style.profileNeonBorder, style.profileShine,
      style.profileElectricPulse, style.avatarOrbit, style.backgroundKey,
      style.top8Ids, privacy.privateProfile, privacy.hideFavorites, privacy.postsVisibility,
      style.customNameColor, style.showcaseIds, style.locationText, style.showcaseRemoteItems, style.top8BffId, style.profileExtras
    );
    sb.from('profiles').update({ bio: storedBio }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function(updateRes) {
      if (updateRes.error) showMessage('Error', updateRes.error.message);
    });
  });
}
function isBlocked(userId) { return blockedUsers.indexOf(userId) !== -1; }
function isMuted(userId) { return mutedUsers.indexOf(userId) !== -1; }
function saveMutedUsers() {
  try { localStorage.setItem('echoMutedUsers', JSON.stringify(mutedUsers)); } catch(e) {}
}
function updateMuteProfileOption() {
  var option = document.getElementById('mute-profile-option');
  if (!option || !viewingUserId) return;
  option.innerHTML = isMuted(viewingUserId) ? 'Unmute' : 'Mute';
}
function toggleMuteViewingUser() {
  if (!currentUser || !viewingUserId || viewingUserId === currentUser.id) return;
  if (isMuted(viewingUserId)) {
    mutedUsers = mutedUsers.filter(function(id) { return id !== viewingUserId; });
    saveMutedUsers();
    showMessage('Unmuted', 'You will see this account\'s Echos and notifications again.');
  } else {
    mutedUsers.push(viewingUserId);
    saveMutedUsers();
    showMessage('Muted', 'This account\'s Echos and notifications will be hidden. They are not blocked or unfollowed.');
  }
  updateMuteProfileOption();
  var active = document.querySelector('.page.active');
  if (active && active.id === 'page-home') loadPosts();
}

function timeAgo(dateStr) {
  var now = new Date(), then = new Date(dateStr), diff = Math.floor((now - then) / 1000);
  if (diff < 5) return 'just now';
  if (diff < 60) return diff + ' sec';
  if (diff < 3600) return Math.floor(diff / 60) + ' mins ago';
  if (diff < 86400) return Math.floor(diff / 3600) + 'hrs ago';
  return then.toLocaleDateString();
}

function exactEchoDateTime(dateStr) {
  var d = new Date(dateStr);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';
  return d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
    year: 'numeric',
    month: 'long',
    day: 'numeric'
  }) + ' at ' + d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, {
    hour: '2-digit',
    minute: '2-digit',
    second: '2-digit'
  });
}

var ECHO_BADGE_ORDER = [
  'follow_3','first_echo','followers_10','followers_50','followers_100',

var echoBadgePopupQueue = [];
var echoBadgePopupCurrent = '';
var echoBadgeCheckBusy = false;
var echoBadgeCheckAgain = false;
var echoBadgeBackendUnavailable = false;

function loadProfileBadges(userId) {
  var box = document.getElementById('profile-badges');
  if (!box || !userId) return;

  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;

  sb.from('echo_badges')
    .select('badge_key, earned_at')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .then(function(res) {
      if (res.error || !res.data || !res.data.length) {
        box.innerHTML = '';
        box.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      var earned = {};
      for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
        earned[res.data[i].badge_key] = true;
      }

      var html = '';
      for (var j = 0; j < ECHO_BADGE_ORDER.length; j++) {
        var key = ECHO_BADGE_ORDER[j];
        if (!earned[key] || !ECHO_BADGES[key]) continue;

        var badge = ECHO_BADGES[key];
        html += '<img class="echo-profile-badge" src="' +
          echoEscapeHtml(badge.image) + '" alt="' +
          echoEscapeHtml(badge.name + ' Badge') + '" title="' +
          echoEscapeHtml(badge.name + ' — ' + badge.description) + '">';
      }

      box.innerHTML = html;
      box.style.display = html ? 'flex' : 'none';
    });
}

function queueEchoBadgePopup(badgeKey) {
  if (!ECHO_BADGES[badgeKey]) return;
  if (echoBadgePopupCurrent === badgeKey) return;
  if (echoBadgePopupQueue.indexOf(badgeKey) !== -1) return;

  echoBadgePopupQueue.push(badgeKey);

  var modal = document.getElementById('badge-earned-modal');
  if (!modal || modal.style.display === 'none') showNextEchoBadgePopup();
}

function showNextEchoBadgePopup() {
  if (echoBadgePopupCurrent || !echoBadgePopupQueue.length) return;

  var badgeKey = echoBadgePopupQueue.shift();
  var badge = ECHO_BADGES[badgeKey];
  if (!badge) {
    showNextEchoBadgePopup();
    return;
  }

  echoBadgePopupCurrent = badgeKey;

  var image = document.getElementById('badge-earned-image');
  var name = document.getElementById('badge-earned-name');
  var description = document.getElementById('badge-earned-description');
  var modal = document.getElementById('badge-earned-modal');

  if (image) {
    image.src = badge.image;
    image.alt = badge.name + ' Badge';
  }

  if (name) name.textContent = "You earned the '" + badge.name + "' Badge.";
  if (description) description.textContent = badge.description;
  if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
}

function closeEchoBadgeModal() {
  var modal = document.getElementById('badge-earned-modal');
  if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';

  echoBadgePopupCurrent = '';

  if (echoBadgePopupQueue.length) {
    setTimeout(showNextEchoBadgePopup, 120);
  }
}

function checkEchoBadges() {
if (!currentUser || echoBadgeBackendUnavailable) return;

if (echoBadgeCheckBusy) {
echoBadgeCheckAgain = true;
return;
}

var sb = getSupabase();
if (!sb) return;

echoBadgeCheckBusy = true;
var checkedUserId = currentUser.id;

sb.rpc('claim_my_echo_badges').then(function(res) {
echoBadgeCheckBusy = false;

if (!currentUser || currentUser.id !== checkedUserId) return;

if (res.error) {
var message = (res.error.message || '').toLowerCase();
if (
res.error.code === 'PGRST202' ||
res.error.code === '42883' ||
message.indexOf('claim_my_echo_badges') !== -1
) {
echoBadgeBackendUnavailable = true;
}
return;
}

if (res.data && res.data.length) {
for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
var badgeKey = res.data[i].badge_key || res.data[i];
queueEchoBadgePopup(badgeKey);
}

if (viewingUserId === checkedUserId) {
loadProfileBadges(checkedUserId);
}
}

if (echoBadgeCheckAgain) {
echoBadgeCheckAgain = false;
setTimeout(checkEchoBadges, 100);
}
});
}

function echoEscapeHtml(value) {
  return (value == null ? '' : String(value))
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

function echoEscapeComposerHtml(value) {
  return (value == null ? '' : String(value))
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

function getEchoPostText(editor) {
  if (!editor) return '';
  return getEchoComposerText(editor)
    .replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n')
    .replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '');
}


function echoSafeHttpUrl(value) {
  if (!value) return '';
  try {
    var parsed = new URL(String(value), window.location.origin);
    if (parsed.protocol !== 'http:' && parsed.protocol !== 'https:') return '';
    return parsed.href;
  } catch(e) {
    return '';
  }
}

function echoSafeImageUrl(value, fallback) {
  return echoSafeHttpUrl(value) || fallback || '';
}

function echoHtmlCssBackground(value, fallback) {
  var safe = echoSafeImageUrl(value, fallback || ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR);
  return 'url(&quot;' + echoEscapeHtml(safe) + '&quot;)';
}

function echoCssBackgroundValue(value, fallback) {
  var safe = echoSafeImageUrl(value, fallback || ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR)
    .replace(/\\/g, '%5C')
    .replace(/"/g, '%22')
    .replace(/'/g, '%27')
    .replace(/\(/g, '%28')
    .replace(/\)/g, '%29')
    .replace(/[\r\n\f]/g, '');
  return 'url("' + safe + '")';
}

  if (!item) return '';
  if (item.id && ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG[item.id]) return ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG[item.id].image;
  return item.type === 'Band'
    ? 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A//www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20width%3D%22128%22%20height%3D%22128%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%20128%20128%22%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%22128%22%20height%3D%22128%22%20rx%3D%2218%22%20fill%3D%22%23222%22/%3E%3Ctext%20x%3D%2264%22%20y%3D%2276%22%20font-size%3D%2254%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20fill%3D%22white%22%3E%E2%99%AA%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E'
    : 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A//www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20width%3D%22128%22%20height%3D%22128%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%20128%20128%22%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%22128%22%20height%3D%22128%22%20rx%3D%2218%22%20fill%3D%22%23222%22/%3E%3Ctext%20x%3D%2264%22%20y%3D%2276%22%20font-size%3D%2244%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20fill%3D%22white%22%3E%F0%9F%8E%AE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E';
}

function linkMentionsAndTags(text) {
  var raw = text == null ? '' : String(text);
  var tokenRe = /(https?:\/\/[^\s<>"']+|@[a-zA-Z0-9_]+|#[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g;
  var html = '';
  var last = 0;
  var match;

  while ((match = tokenRe.exec(raw)) !== null) {
    html += echoEscapeHtml(raw.substring(last, match.index));
    var token = match[0];

    if (token.charAt(0) === '@') {
      var username = token.substring(1);
      html += '<span class="mention" onclick="goToUserByName(\'' + username + '\')">' +
        echoEscapeHtml(token) + '</span>';
    } else if (token.charAt(0) === '#') {
      var tag = token.substring(1);
      html += '<span class="hashtag" onclick="goToHashtag(\'' + tag + '\')">' +
        echoEscapeHtml(token) + '</span>';
    } else {
      var safeUrl = echoSafeHttpUrl(token);
      if (!safeUrl) {
        html += echoEscapeHtml(token);
      } else {
        var host = '';
        try { host = new URL(safeUrl).hostname.toLowerCase(); } catch(e) {}
        var isEchoLink =
          host === window.location.hostname.toLowerCase() ||
          host === 'theechonetwork.net' ||
          host.endsWith('.theechonetwork.net') ||
          host === 'theechoblog.weebly.com';

        if (isEchoLink) {
          html += '<a href="' + echoEscapeHtml(safeUrl) +
            '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color:#1da1f2;">' +
            echoEscapeHtml(token) + '</a>';
        } else {
          html += '<span class="mention" style="color:#1da1f2;cursor:pointer;" data-echo-url="' +
            echoEscapeHtml(safeUrl) +
            '" onclick="warnExternal(this.getAttribute(\'data-echo-url\'))">' +
            echoEscapeHtml(token) + '</span>';
        }
      }
    }
    last = tokenRe.lastIndex;
  }

  html += echoEscapeHtml(raw.substring(last));
  return html.replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
}
function warnExternal(url) {
  var safeUrl = echoSafeHttpUrl(url);
  if (!safeUrl) {
    showMessage('External Link', 'That link is not valid.');
    return;
  }
  showMessage(
    'External Link',
    'This will take you to an external site. You click links at your own risk.<br><br>' +
    '<a href="' + echoEscapeHtml(safeUrl) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="color:#0587fc;">Continue</a>'
  );
}
function goToUserByName(username) {
  var sb = getSupabase(); if (!sb) return;
  var clean = (username || '').toLowerCase().replace(/^@/, '').trim();
  if (!clean) { showMessage('Not found', 'No user'); return; }
  sb.from('profiles').select('id, username').ilike('username', clean).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (res.data) viewProfile(res.data.id); else showMessage('Not found', 'No user @' + clean);
  });
}
function goToHashtag(tag) {
  currentHashtag = tag;
  showPage('discover');
  var sb = getSupabase(); if (!sb) return;

  sb.from('posts')
    .select('id, text, created_at, user_id, pinned, poll_options')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(100)
    .then(function(res) {
      var box = document.getElementById('hashtags');
      if (res.error || !res.data) {
        box.innerHTML = '<p>No posts found</p>';
        return;
      }

      var matches = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
        if (
          (res.data[i].text || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('#' + tag.toLowerCase()) !== -1 &&
          !isBlocked(res.data[i].user_id)
        ) {
          matches.push(res.data[i]);
        }
      }

      if (matches.length === 0) {
        box.innerHTML = '<p>No posts with #' + echoEscapeHtml(tag) + '</p>';
        return;
      }

      var ids = [];
      var postIds = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) {
        if (ids.indexOf(matches[i].user_id) === -1) ids.push(matches[i].user_id);
        postIds.push(matches[i].id);
      }

      sb.from('profiles')
        .select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified, bio')
        .in('id', ids)
        .then(function(prof) {
          var map = {};
          if (prof.data) {
            for (var j = 0; j < prof.data.length; j++) {
              var pd = prof.data[j];
              map[pd.id] = {
                username: pd.username || 'user',
                display_name: pd.display_name || pd.username || 'user',
                avatar: pd.avatar_url,
                verified: !!pd.verified,
                bio: pd.bio || ''
              };
            }
          }

          var counts = {};
          var pollVoteMap = {};
          var done = 0;

          function finish() {
            done++;
            if (done < 4) return;

            var html = '<h4 style="margin-bottom:10px;">#' + echoEscapeHtml(tag) + '</h4>';

            for (var i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) {
              var p = matches[i];
              var u = map[p.user_id] || {
                username: 'user',
                display_name: 'user',
                avatar: null,
                verified: false
              };

              p.poll_votes = pollVoteMap[p.id] || {};

              var av = u.avatar
                ? "url('" + u.avatar + "')"
                : "url('https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/friend_orig.png')";

              html += renderTweet(p, u, av, false, counts[p.id] || {});
            }

            box.innerHTML = html;
          }

          if (postIds.length === 0) {
            finish(); finish(); finish(); finish();
            return;
          }

          sb.from('likes').select('post_id').in('post_id', postIds).then(function(r) {
            if (r.data) {
              for (var k = 0; k < r.data.length; k++) {
                var id = r.data[k].post_id;
                if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
                counts[id].likes = (counts[id].likes || 0) + 1;
              }
            }
            finish();
          });

          loadEchoFavoriteCounts(postIds, function(favCounts) {
            for (var k = 0; k < postIds.length; k++) {
              var id = postIds[k];
              if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
              counts[id].favs = favCounts[String(id)] || 0;
            }
            finish();
          });

          sb.from('reposts').select('post_id').in('post_id', postIds).then(function(r) {
            if (r.data) {
              for (var k = 0; k < r.data.length; k++) {
                var id = r.data[k].post_id;
                if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
                counts[id].reposts = (counts[id].reposts || 0) + 1;
              }
            }
            finish();
          });

          loadPollVoteCounts(postIds, function(voteMap) {
            pollVoteMap = voteMap || {};
            finish();
          });
        });
    });
}

function canViewerSeeProfilePosts(userId, storedBio) {
  var style = getProfileStyleData(storedBio || '');
  if (currentUser && userId === currentUser.id) return true;
  if (!currentUser) return !style.privateProfile && style.postsVisibility === 'everyone';
  var viewerFollows = !!followingMap[userId];
  var authorFollowsViewer = !!followedByMap[userId];
  if (style.privateProfile && !viewerFollows) return false;
  if (style.postsVisibility === 'followers' && !viewerFollows) return false;
  if (style.postsVisibility === 'mutual' && !(viewerFollows && authorFollowsViewer)) return false;
  return true;
}

function checkProfileContentAccess(userId, storedBio, callback) {
  var style = getProfileStyleData(storedBio || '');
  if (!currentUser) { callback(!style.privateProfile && style.postsVisibility === 'everyone'); return; }
  if (userId === currentUser.id) { callback(true); return; }
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('follows').select('follower_id').eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).eq('following_id', userId).maybeSingle().then(function(followRes) {
    var viewerFollows = !!followRes.data;
    followingMap[userId] = viewerFollows;
    if (style.privateProfile && !viewerFollows) { callback(false); return; }
    if (style.postsVisibility === 'followers' && !viewerFollows) { callback(false); return; }
    if (style.postsVisibility !== 'mutual') { callback(true); return; }
    if (!viewerFollows) { callback(false); return; }
    sb.from('follows').select('follower_id').eq('follower_id', userId).eq('following_id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle().then(function(backRes) {
      followedByMap[userId] = !!backRes.data;
      callback(!!backRes.data);
    });
  });
}

function renderTweet(p, u, av, isRepost, counts) {
  if (!canViewerSeeProfilePosts(p.user_id, u && u.bio ? u.bio : '')) return '';
  var viewingMutedProfile = document.getElementById('page-profile').className.indexOf('active') !== -1 && viewingUserId === p.user_id;
  if (isMuted(p.user_id) && !viewingMutedProfile) return '';

  counts = counts || {};
  var del = (currentUser && p.user_id === currentUser.id && !isRepost)
    ? ' <button class="danger-btn" style="float:none;margin-top:0;margin-left:8px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();askDeletePost(' + p.id + ')">Delete</button>'
    : '';
  var liked = likedPosts[p.id] ? ' active' : '';
  var faved = favPosts[p.id] ? ' active' : '';
  var reposted = repostPosts[p.id] ? ' active' : '';
  var cls = isRepost ? 'tweet repost' : 'tweet';
  var name = echoEscapeHtml(u.display_name || u.username || 'user');
  var handle = echoEscapeHtml(u.username || 'user');
  var nameClass = 'username';
  var avatarClass = 'avatar';
  var safeAvatar = echoHtmlCssBackground(u.avatar || u.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR);
  var check = u.verified ? ' <img class="verified-check" src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/31311_orig.png" alt="">' : '';
  var repostLabel = isRepost ? '<div class="repost-label">Repost</div>' : '';
  var own = currentUser && p.user_id === currentUser.id;

  var likeBtn = '<button class="action-btn like echo-like-button' + liked + '" data-post-id="' + p.id + '" style="background-image:url(\'' +
    (likedPosts[p.id] ? 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/heart2_orig.png' : 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/heart1_orig.png') +
    '\');width:22px;height:22px;background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;border:none;background-color:transparent;cursor:pointer;margin-right:10px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleLike(' +
    p.id + ', this)"></button><span class="action-count echo-like-count" data-post-id="' + p.id + '" style="margin-left:0;margin-right:10px;">' + (counts.likes || 0) + '</span>';

  var favBtn = '<button class="action-btn fav' + faved + '" style="background-image:url(\'' +
    (favPosts[p.id] ? 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/fav1_orig.png' : 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/fav_orig.png') +
    '\');width:22px;height:22px;background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:center;border:none;background-color:transparent;cursor:pointer;margin-right:10px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleFav(' +
    p.id + ', this)"></button><span class="action-count" style="margin-left:0;margin-right:10px;">' + (counts.favs || 0) + '</span>';

  var repostBtn = '<button class="action-btn repost' + reposted + '" style="background-image:url(\'' +
    (repostPosts[p.id] ? 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/213321_orig.png' : 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/rt12_orig.png') +
    '\');width:22px;height:22px;background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;border:none;background-color:transparent;cursor:pointer;margin-right:10px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleRepost(' +
    p.id + ', this)"></button><span class="action-count" style="margin-left:0;margin-right:10px;">' + (counts.reposts || 0) + '</span>';

  var shareBtn = '<button style="background:url(\'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/sadffsa_orig.png\') center/24px no-repeat;border:none;width:24px;height:24px;cursor:pointer;margin-left:4px;margin-top:-5px;transition:transform 0.1s;vertical-align:middle;" onmousedown="this.style.transform=\'scale(0.85)\'" onmouseup="this.style.transform=\'scale(1)\'" onmouseleave="this.style.transform=\'scale(1)\'" onclick="event.stopPropagation();copyPostLink(' + p.id + ')" title="Copy link"></button>';
  var reportBtn = own ? '' : '<button style="background:transparent;border:none;color:#888;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;margin-left:8px;vertical-align:middle;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();reportPost(' + p.id + ',\'' + p.user_id + '\')">Report</button>';

  var pollHtml = '';
  if (p.poll_options) {
    try {
      var opts = JSON.parse(p.poll_options);
      var votes = p.poll_votes || {};
      var total = 0;
      for (var k in votes) total += votes[k];
      pollHtml = '<div style="margin-top:8px;">';
      for (var i = 0; i < opts.length; i++) {
        var pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((votes[i] || 0) / total * 100) : 0;
        pollHtml += '<div style="padding:6px 10px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:4px;margin:4px 0;cursor:pointer;position:relative;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();votePoll(' +
          p.id + ',' + i + ')"><div style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:' + pct +
          '%;background:#0587fc;opacity:0.2;border-radius:4px;"></div><span style="position:relative;">' +
          echoEscapeHtml(opts[i]) +
          '</span><span style="float:right;position:relative;font-size:12px;color:#888;">' +
          pct + '%</span></div>';
      }
      pollHtml += '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-top:4px;">' + total + ' votes</div></div>';
    } catch(e) {}
  }

  return '<div class="' + cls + '" onclick="openPostModal(' + p.id + ')">' +
    repostLabel +
    '<div class="tweet-time">' + timeAgo(p.created_at) + '</div>' +
    '<div class="' + avatarClass + '" style="background-image:' + safeAvatar + ';cursor:pointer;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();viewProfile(\'' + p.user_id + '\')"></div>' +
    '<div><span class="' + nameClass + '" onclick="event.stopPropagation();viewProfile(\'' + p.user_id + '\')">' +
    name + check +
    '</span><span class="screen-name">@' + handle + '</span>' +
    del +
    '<div style="margin-top:8px;">' + linkMentionsAndTags(p.text) + '</div>' +
    pollHtml +
    '<div class="tweet-actions" onclick="event.stopPropagation();">' +
    likeBtn + favBtn + repostBtn + shareBtn + reportBtn +
    '</div></div><div class="clear"></div></div>';
}

function loadPollVoteCounts(postIds, callback) {
  var ids = (postIds || []).filter(function(id, index, arr) {
    return id !== null && id !== undefined && arr.indexOf(id) === index;
  });

  if (!ids.length) {
    callback({});
    return;
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('poll_votes')
    .select('post_id, option_index')
    .in('post_id', ids)
    .then(function(res) {
      var map = {};

      if (!res.error && res.data) {
        for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
          var row = res.data[i];
          if (!map[row.post_id]) map[row.post_id] = {};
          map[row.post_id][row.option_index] = (map[row.post_id][row.option_index] || 0) + 1;
        }
      }

      callback(map);
    });
}

function votePoll(postId, optionIndex) {
  if (!currentUser) { showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to vote'); return; }
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('poll_votes').select('id').eq('post_id', postId).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(existing) {
    if (existing.data && existing.data.length > 0) { showMessage('Already voted', 'You already voted on this poll'); return; }
    sb.from('poll_votes').insert({ post_id: postId, user_id: currentUser.id, option_index: optionIndex }).then(function(res) {
      if (res.error) showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
      else { showMessage('Voted', 'Vote recorded'); refreshCurrentView(); }
    });
  });
}

function refreshCurrentView() {
  var activePage = document.querySelector('.page.active');
  if (!activePage) { loadPosts(); return; }
  var id = activePage.id;
  if (id === 'page-home') {
    loadPosts();
  } else if (id === 'page-profile' && viewingUserId) {
    if (currentProfileTab === 'favorites') loadFavorites();
    else loadUserPosts(viewingUserId, viewingAvatarUrl);
  } else if (id === 'page-discover') {
    if (currentHashtag) goToHashtag(currentHashtag);
    else loadDiscover();
  } else {
    loadPosts();
  }
}

function showRepostToast() {
  var t = document.getElementById('repost-toast');
  t.style.display = 'block';
  setTimeout(function() { t.style.display = 'none'; }, 1000);
}

function togglePostFollow(userId, btn) {
  if (!currentUser) { showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to follow'); return; }
  var was = !!followingMap[userId];
  if (was) {
    window.pendingUnfollowUserId = userId;
    window.pendingUnfollowBtn = btn;
    document.getElementById('unfollow-modal').style.display = 'flex';
    return;
  }
  doPostFollow(userId, btn, false);
}
function doPostFollow(userId, btn, wasFollowing) {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  followingMap[userId] = !wasFollowing;
  btn.className = 'follow-post-btn' + (followingMap[userId] ? ' following' : ' follow');
  if (wasFollowing) {
    sb.from('follows').delete().eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).eq('following_id', userId).then(function(r) {
      if (r.error) { followingMap[userId] = wasFollowing; btn.className = 'follow-post-btn' + (wasFollowing ? ' following' : ' follow'); }
      else { loadStats(); if (viewingUserId === userId) checkFollow(userId); }
    });
  } else {
    sb.from('follows').insert({ follower_id: currentUser.id, following_id: userId }).then(function(r) {
      if (r.error) {
        followingMap[userId] = wasFollowing;
        btn.className = 'follow-post-btn' + (wasFollowing ? ' following' : ' follow');
      } else {
        rememberCrewFollowed(userId);
        loadStats();
        checkEchoBadges();
        if (viewingUserId === userId) checkFollow(userId);
      }
    });
  }
}

function openPostModal(postId) {
  currentPostForComment = postId;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('posts').select('id, text, created_at, user_id, pinned, poll_options').eq('id', postId).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (!res.data) { showMessage('Error', 'Post not found'); return; }
    var p = res.data;
    sb.from('profiles').select('username, display_name, avatar_url, verified').eq('id', p.user_id).maybeSingle().then(function(prof) {
      var u = prof.data || { username: 'user', display_name: 'user' };
      var name = u.display_name || u.username || 'user';
      var handle = u.username || 'user';
      var check = u.verified ? ' <img class="verified-check" src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/31311_orig.png" alt="">' : '';
      document.getElementById('comment-post-title').innerHTML = '<span style="cursor:pointer;" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + p.user_id + '\');closeCommentModal();">' + echoEscapeHtml(name) + '</span>' + check;
      document.getElementById('comment-post-handle').textContent = '@' + handle;
      var av = echoCssBackgroundValue(u.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR);
      var commentAvatar = document.getElementById('comment-avatar');
      commentAvatar.style.backgroundImage = av;
      commentAvatar.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      commentAvatar.onclick = function() {
        closeCommentModal();
        viewProfile(p.user_id);
      };
      function renderModalPostContent(voteMap) {
        var pollHtml = '';

        if (p.poll_options) {
          try {
            var opts = JSON.parse(p.poll_options);
            var votes = voteMap || {};
            var total = 0;

            for (var voteKey in votes) total += votes[voteKey];

            pollHtml = '<div style="margin-top:10px;">';

            for (var oi = 0; oi < opts.length; oi++) {
              var pct = total > 0 ? Math.round((votes[oi] || 0) / total * 100) : 0;

              pollHtml += '<div style="padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:4px;margin:5px 0;cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();votePoll(' +
                p.id + ',' + oi + ');setTimeout(function(){openPostModal(' + p.id + ');},350)">' +
                '<div style="position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:' + pct +
                '%;background:#0587fc;opacity:.18;"></div>' +
                '<span style="position:relative;">' + echoEscapeHtml(opts[oi]) + '</span>' +
                '<span style="float:right;position:relative;font-size:12px;color:#888;">' + pct + '%</span>' +
                '</div>';
            }

            pollHtml += '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-top:4px;">' + total + ' votes</div></div>';
          } catch(e) {}
        }

        document.getElementById('comment-post-content').innerHTML =
          linkMentionsAndTags(p.text) +
          pollHtml +
          '<div style="font-size:12px;color:#888;margin-top:6px;">Posted ' + echoEscapeHtml(exactEchoDateTime(p.created_at)) + '</div>';
      }

      if (p.poll_options) {
        loadPollVoteCounts([p.id], function(pollMap) {
          renderModalPostContent(pollMap[p.id] || {});
        });
      } else {
        renderModalPostContent({});
      }

      document.getElementById('comment-input').value = '';
      // Load action counts and likers
      var counts = { likes: 0, favs: 0, reposts: 0 };
      var done = 0;
      function finishActions() {
        done++;
        if (done < 4) return;
        var liked = likedPosts[p.id] ? ' active' : '';
        var faved = favPosts[p.id] ? ' active' : '';
        var reposted = repostPosts[p.id] ? ' active' : '';
        var likeBtn = '<button class="action-btn like echo-like-button' + liked + '" data-post-id="' + p.id + '" style="background-image:url(\'' + (likedPosts[p.id] ? 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/heart2_orig.png' : 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/heart1_orig.png') + '\');width:22px;height:22px;background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;border:none;background-color:transparent;cursor:pointer;margin-right:10px;margin-top:7px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleLike(' + p.id + ', this)"></button><span class="action-count echo-like-count" data-post-id="' + p.id + '" style="margin-left:0;margin-right:10px;">' + (counts.likes || 0) + '</span>';
        var favBtn = '<button class="action-btn fav' + faved + '" style="background-image:url(\'' + (favPosts[p.id] ? 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/fav1_orig.png' : 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/fav_orig.png') + '\');width:22px;height:22px;background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;border:none;background-color:transparent;cursor:pointer;margin-right:10px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleFav(' + p.id + ', this)"></button><span class="action-count" style="margin-left:0;margin-right:10px;">' + (counts.favs || 0) + '</span>';
        var repostBtn = '<button class="action-btn repost' + reposted + '" style="background-image:url(\'' + (repostPosts[p.id] ? 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/213321_orig.png' : 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/rt12_orig.png') + '\');width:22px;height:22px;background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;border:none;background-color:transparent;cursor:pointer;margin-right:10px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleRepost(' + p.id + ', this)"></button><span class="action-count" style="margin-left:0;margin-right:10px;">' + (counts.reposts || 0) + '</span>';
        var reportBtn = (currentUser && p.user_id !== currentUser.id) ? '<button style="background:transparent;border:none;color:#888;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer;margin-left:8px;" onclick="reportPost(' + p.id + ',\'' + p.user_id + '\')">Report</button>' : '';
        document.getElementById('comment-actions').innerHTML = likeBtn + favBtn + repostBtn + reportBtn;
      }
      // Exact counts
      sb.from('likes').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('post_id', postId).then(function(r) { counts.likes = (r.count !== undefined && r.count !== null) ? r.count : 0; finishActions(); });
      loadEchoFavoriteCounts([postId], function(favCounts) { counts.favs = favCounts[String(postId)] || 0; finishActions(); });
      sb.from('reposts').select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true }).eq('post_id', postId).then(function(r) { counts.reposts = (r.count !== undefined && r.count !== null) ? r.count : 0; finishActions(); });
      // Latest likers (separate)
      sb.from('likes').select('user_id').eq('post_id', postId).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(10).then(function(r) {
        var likerIds = (r.data || []).map(function(l) { return l.user_id; });
        if (likerIds.length) {
          sb.from('profiles').select('id, avatar_url, username').in('id', likerIds).then(function(lp) {
            var html = '';
            if (lp.data) for (var i = 0; i < lp.data.length; i++) {
              var lu = lp.data[i];
              var lav = lu.avatar_url ? "url('" + lu.avatar_url + "')" : "url('https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/friend_orig.png')";
              html += '<div class="following-avatar" style="background-image:' + lav + ';width:28px;height:28px;margin:2px;" title="@' + (lu.username || 'user') + '" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + lu.id + '\');closeCommentModal();"></div>';
            }
            document.getElementById('comment-likers').innerHTML = html ? '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-bottom:4px;">Liked by</div>' + html : '';
            finishActions();
          });
        } else {
          document.getElementById('comment-likers').innerHTML = '';
          finishActions();
        }
      });
      loadComments(postId);
      document.getElementById('comment-modal').className = 'modal comment-modal show';
    });
  });
}
function closeCommentModal() {
  document.getElementById('comment-modal').className = 'modal comment-modal';
  currentPostForComment = null;
}
function loadComments(postId) {
var sb = getSupabase();
var box = document.getElementById('comments-list');
box.innerHTML = '<p>Loading comments...</p>';

sb.from('comments')
.select('id, text, created_at, user_id')
.eq('post_id', postId)
.order('created_at', { ascending:true })
.then(function(res) {
if (res.error || !res.data || res.data.length === 0) {
box.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">No comments yet.</p>';
return;
}

var comments = res.data;
var ids = [];
var commentIds = [];

for (var i = 0; i < comments.length; i++) {
if (ids.indexOf(comments[i].user_id) === -1) ids.push(comments[i].user_id);
commentIds.push(comments[i].id);
}

sb.from('profiles')
.select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified, bio')
.in('id', ids)
.then(function(prof) {
var map = {};

if (prof.data) {
for (var j = 0; j < prof.data.length; j++) {
var pd = prof.data[j];
map[pd.id] = {
username:pd.username || 'user',
display_name:pd.display_name || pd.username || 'user',
avatar:pd.avatar_url,
verified:!!pd.verified,
bio:pd.bio || ''
};
}
}

sb.from('comment_likes')
.select('comment_id')
.in('comment_id', commentIds)
.then(function(allLikes) {
var likeCounts = {};

if (allLikes.data) {
for (var k = 0; k < allLikes.data.length; k++) {
var cid = allLikes.data[k].comment_id;
likeCounts[cid] = (likeCounts[cid] || 0) + 1;
}
}

function renderWithMyLikes(myLikeRows) {
for (var cidx = 0; cidx < commentIds.length; cidx++) {
delete likedComments[commentIds[cidx]];
}

for (var ml = 0; ml < myLikeRows.length; ml++) {
likedComments[myLikeRows[ml].comment_id] = true;
}

var html = '';

for (var ci = 0; ci < comments.length; ci++) {
var c = comments[ci];
var u = map[c.user_id] || { username:'user', display_name:'user', avatar:null };
var av = echoHtmlCssBackground(u.avatar, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR);
var liked = likedComments[c.id] ? ' liked' : '';
var likeCount = likeCounts[c.id] || 0;
var hasHeart = likeCount > 0;
var heartHtml = hasHeart
? '<img src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/heart2_orig.png" alt="Liked" style="width:12px;height:12px;object-fit:contain;vertical-align:-2px;margin-right:2px;">'
: '♡';

var deleteCommentLink = (currentUser && c.user_id === currentUser.id)
? ' <button class="comment-like-btn" onclick="deleteOwnComment(' + c.id + ')">Delete</button>'
: '';

html += '<div class="comment">' +
'<div class="avatar" style="background-image:' + av + ';float:left;margin-right:8px;cursor:pointer;" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + c.user_id + '\');closeCommentModal();"></div>' +
'<div><strong onclick="viewProfile(\'' + c.user_id + '\');closeCommentModal();" style="cursor:pointer;">' +
echoEscapeHtml(u.display_name || u.username) +
'</strong> <span class="screen-name">@' + echoEscapeHtml(u.username) + '</span>' +
'<div>' + linkMentionsAndTags(c.text) + '</div>' +
'<div style="font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-top:4px;">' +
timeAgo(c.created_at) +
' <button class="comment-like-btn' + liked + '" data-comment-id="' + c.id + '" onclick="toggleCommentLike(' + c.id + ', this)">' +
'<span class="comment-like-icon">' + heartHtml + '</span> <span class="comment-like-count">' + likeCount + '</span></button>' +
deleteCommentLink +
'</div></div><div class="clear"></div></div>';
}

box.innerHTML = html;
}

if (!currentUser) {
renderWithMyLikes([]);
return;
}

sb.from('comment_likes')
.select('comment_id')
.eq('user_id', currentUser.id)
.in('comment_id', commentIds)
.then(function(myLikes) {
renderWithMyLikes((myLikes && myLikes.data) ? myLikes.data : []);
});
});
});
});
}
function postComment() {
  if (!currentUser || !currentPostForComment) { showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to comment'); return; }
  var text = document.getElementById('comment-input').value.trim();
  if (!text) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('comments').insert({ post_id: currentPostForComment, user_id: currentUser.id, text: text }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
    else {
      document.getElementById('comment-input').value = '';
      loadComments(currentPostForComment);
      if (viewingUserId === currentUser.id && currentProfileTab === 'comments') loadProfileComments();
    }
  });
}
function deleteOwnComment(commentId) {
  if (!currentUser || !currentPostForComment) return;
  commentToDelete = commentId;
  document.getElementById('deletecomment-modal').style.display = 'flex';
}

function closeDeleteOwnComment() {
  document.getElementById('deletecomment-modal').style.display = 'none';
  commentToDelete = null;
}

function confirmDeleteOwnComment() {
  if (!currentUser || !currentPostForComment || !commentToDelete) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var postId = currentPostForComment;
  var commentId = commentToDelete;
  sb.from('comments').delete().eq('id', commentId).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) {
      showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
      return;
    }
    delete likedComments[commentId];
    closeDeleteOwnComment();
    loadComments(postId);
  });
}

function toggleCommentLike(commentId, btn) {
  if (!currentUser) {
    showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to like comments');
    return;
  }

  if (!btn || btn.getAttribute('data-comment-like-busy') === '1') return;
  btn.setAttribute('data-comment-like-busy', '1');

  var sb = getSupabase();
  var userId = currentUser.id;
  var icon = btn.querySelector('.comment-like-icon');
  var countEl = btn.querySelector('.comment-like-count');
  var likedHeart = '<img src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/heart2_orig.png" alt="Liked" style="width:12px;height:12px;object-fit:contain;vertical-align:-2px;margin-right:2px;">';

  function readCount() {
    var n = parseInt(countEl ? countEl.textContent : '0', 10);
    return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
  }

  function setButtonState(isLiked, count) {
    btn.classList.toggle('liked', isLiked);
    if (icon) icon.innerHTML = isLiked || count > 0 ? likedHeart : '♡';
    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = Math.max(0, count);
  }

  function finish() {
    btn.removeAttribute('data-comment-like-busy');
  }

  

  sb.from('comment_likes')
    .select('comment_id')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .eq('comment_id', commentId)
    .maybeSingle()
    .then(function(existing) {
      if (existing.error) {
        finish();
        showMessage('Error', existing.error.message);
        return;
      }

      var oldCount = readCount();

      if (existing.data) {
        
        delete likedComments[commentId];
        setButtonState(false, Math.max(0, oldCount - 1));

        sb.from('comment_likes')
          .delete()
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .eq('comment_id', commentId)
          .select('comment_id')
          .then(function(r) {
            if (r.error || !r.data || r.data.length === 0) {
              likedComments[commentId] = true;
              setButtonState(true, oldCount);
              finish();

              if (r.error) showMessage('Error', r.error.message);
              else showMessage('Error', 'Could not remove your comment like. Run the supplied comment-like RLS fix once in Supabase.');
              return;
            }

            finish();
          });
        return;
      }

      
      likedComments[commentId] = true;
      setButtonState(true, oldCount + 1);

      sb.from('comment_likes')
        .insert({ user_id:userId, comment_id:commentId })
        .then(function(r) {
          if (r.error && r.error.code !== '23505') {
            delete likedComments[commentId];
            setButtonState(false, oldCount);
            finish();
            showMessage('Error', r.error.message);
            return;
          }

          

          if (r.error && r.error.code === '23505') {
            setButtonState(true, Math.max(1, oldCount));
          }

          finish();
        });
    });
}

function echoModalActionCount(btn, delta) {
  if (!btn || !btn.closest || !btn.closest('#comment-modal') || !delta) return;
  var count = btn.nextElementSibling;
  if (!count || !count.classList || !count.classList.contains('action-count')) return;
  var value = parseInt(count.textContent || '0', 10);
  if (isNaN(value)) value = 0;
  count.textContent = Math.max(0, value + delta);
}

function toggleFav(postId, btn) {
  if (!currentUser) { showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to favorite'); return; }
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var inModal = !!(btn && btn.closest && btn.closest('#comment-modal'));

  sb.from('posts').select('user_id').eq('id', postId).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (res.data && res.data.user_id === currentUser.id) { showMessage('Oops', 'You cannot favorite your own post'); return; }

    var was = !!favPosts[postId];
    var previousActivityTime = favActivityTimes[postId];
    var next = !was;
    favPosts[postId] = next;
    if (next) favActivityTimes[postId] = new Date().toISOString();
    else delete favActivityTimes[postId];
    btn.className = 'action-btn fav' + (next ? ' active' : '');
    if (inModal) echoModalActionCount(btn, next ? 1 : -1);

    function rollbackFav(message) {
      favPosts[postId] = was;
      if (previousActivityTime) favActivityTimes[postId] = previousActivityTime;
      else delete favActivityTimes[postId];
      btn.className = 'action-btn fav' + (was ? ' active' : '');
      if (inModal) echoModalActionCount(btn, next ? -1 : 1);
      if (message) showMessage('Error', message);
    }

    if (was) {
      sb.from('favorites').delete().eq('user_id', currentUser.id).eq('post_id', postId).then(function(r) {
        if (r.error) rollbackFav(r.error.message);
        else if (!inModal) refreshCurrentView();
      });
    } else {
      sb.from('favorites').insert({ user_id: currentUser.id, post_id: postId }).then(function(r) {
        if (r.error) rollbackFav(r.error.message);
        else if (!inModal) refreshCurrentView();
      });
    }
  });
}
function copyPostLink(postId) {
  var url = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname + '?post=' + postId;
  if (navigator.clipboard) {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(function() {
      showMessage('Copied', 'Link copied to clipboard');
    });
  } else {
    var input = document.createElement('input');
    input.value = url;
    document.body.appendChild(input);
    input.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(input);
    showMessage('Copied', 'Link copied to clipboard');
  }
}

function syncEchoLikeUI(postId, isLiked, delta) {
  var likedIcon = 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/heart2_orig.png';
  var normalIcon = 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/heart1_orig.png';

  var buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.echo-like-button[data-post-id="' + postId + '"]');
  for (var i = 0; i < buttons.length; i++) {
    buttons[i].className = 'action-btn like echo-like-button' + (isLiked ? ' active' : '');
    buttons[i].style.backgroundImage = "url('" + (isLiked ? likedIcon : normalIcon) + "')";
  }

  if (delta) {
    var counts = document.querySelectorAll('.echo-like-count[data-post-id="' + postId + '"]');
    for (var j = 0; j < counts.length; j++) {
      var current = parseInt(counts[j].textContent || '0', 10);
      if (isNaN(current)) current = 0;
      counts[j].textContent = Math.max(0, current + delta);
    }
  }
}

function refreshEchoLikeCount(postId) {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;

  sb.from('likes')
    .select('*', { count:'exact', head:true })
    .eq('post_id', postId)
    .then(function(res) {
      if (res.error) return;

      var count = (res.count !== undefined && res.count !== null) ? res.count : 0;
      var counts = document.querySelectorAll('.echo-like-count[data-post-id="' + postId + '"]');

      for (var i = 0; i < counts.length; i++) {
        counts[i].textContent = count;
      }
    });
}

function toggleLike(postId, btn) {
  if (!currentUser) {
    showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to like');
    return;
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();
  var userId = currentUser.id;

  


  sb.from('likes')
    .select('post_id')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .eq('post_id', postId)
    .maybeSingle()
    .then(function(existing) {
      if (existing.error) {
        showMessage('Error', existing.error.message);
        return;
      }

      if (existing.data) {
        sb.from('likes')
          .delete()
          .eq('user_id', userId)
          .eq('post_id', postId)
          .then(function(res) {
            if (res.error) {
              showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
              return;
            }

            likedPosts[postId] = false;
            syncEchoLikeUI(postId, false, 0);
            refreshEchoLikeCount(postId);
          });
        return;
      }

      sb.from('likes')
        .insert({ user_id:userId, post_id:postId })
        .then(function(res) {
          if (res.error && res.error.code !== '23505') {
            showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
            return;
          }

          

          likedPosts[postId] = true;
          syncEchoLikeUI(postId, true, 0);
          refreshEchoLikeCount(postId);
        });
    });
}

function openDeleteAccountModal() {
  if (!currentUser) {
    showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to manage your account.');
    return;
  }

  var input = document.getElementById('delete-account-confirm-input');
  var error = document.getElementById('delete-account-error');
  var button = document.getElementById('delete-account-confirm-btn');

  if (input) input.value = '';
  if (error) {
    error.style.display = 'none';
    error.textContent = '';
  }
  if (button) {
    button.disabled = false;
    button.textContent = 'Delete Forever';
  }

  document.getElementById('delete-account-modal').style.display = 'flex';
  setTimeout(function() { if (input) input.focus(); }, 50);
}

function closeDeleteAccountModal() {
  var modal = document.getElementById('delete-account-modal');
  if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
}

function clearEchoLocalAccountData() {
  var keysToRemove = [
    'echoPrivacy',
    'echoNotifTimes',
    'echoNotifications',
    'echoLastNotifCheck',
    'echoMutedUsers',
    'echoCrewSeen'
  ];

  try {
    for (var i = 0; i < keysToRemove.length; i++) localStorage.removeItem(keysToRemove[i]);

    if (currentUser && currentUser.id) {
      localStorage.removeItem('echoCrewFollowHistory:' + currentUser.id);
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}

function confirmDeleteAccount() {
  if (!currentUser) return;

  var input = document.getElementById('delete-account-confirm-input');
  var error = document.getElementById('delete-account-error');
  var button = document.getElementById('delete-account-confirm-btn');

  if (!input || input.value.trim().toUpperCase() !== 'DELETE') {
    if (error) {
      error.textContent = 'Type DELETE exactly to confirm permanent account deletion.';
      error.style.display = 'block';
    }
    return;
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;

  if (error) {
    error.style.display = 'none';
    error.textContent = '';
  }
  if (button) {
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Deleting...';
  }

  stopCrewPresence();

  sb.rpc('delete_my_echo_account').then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) {
      if (button) {
        button.disabled = false;
        button.textContent = 'Delete Forever';
      }
      if (error) {
        error.textContent = res.error.message.indexOf('Could not find the function') !== -1
          ? 'Account deletion backend is not installed yet.'
          : res.error.message;
        error.style.display = 'block';
      }
      return;
    }

    clearEchoLocalAccountData();
    closeDeleteAccountModal();
    closeEditProfile();

    accountSessionToken++;
    resetAccountScopedViewState();

    sb.auth.signOut().then(function() {
      currentUser = null;
      currentUsername = null;
      currentDisplayName = null;
      currentUserVerified = false;
      updateUI();
      showPage('home');
      openAuth('signin');
      showMessage('Account Deleted', 'Your Echo account and account data have been permanently deleted.');
    });
  });
}

function askSignOut() { document.getElementById('signout-modal').style.display = 'block'; }
function closeSignOut() { document.getElementById('signout-modal').style.display = 'none'; }
function confirmSignOut() {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  stopCrewPresence();
  accountSessionToken++;
  resetAccountScopedViewState();
  if (sb) sb.auth.signOut();
  currentUser = null; currentUsername = null; currentDisplayName = null; currentUserVerified = false;
  document.getElementById('signout-modal').style.display = 'none';
  var loader = document.getElementById('loading-screen');
  if (loader) {
    loader.style.display = 'flex';
    loader.className = '';
  }
  setTimeout(function() {
    updateUI();
    showPage('home');
    openAuth('signin');
    if (loader) {
      loader.className = 'hide';
      setTimeout(function() { if (loader) loader.style.display = 'none'; }, 600);
    }
  }, 1200);
}
function askDeletePost(postId) { postToDelete = postId; document.getElementById('deletepost-modal').className = 'modal show'; }
function closeDeletePost() { document.getElementById('deletepost-modal').className = 'modal'; postToDelete = null; }
function confirmDeletePost() {
  if (!postToDelete) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var id = postToDelete;
  sb.from('posts').delete().eq('id', id).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
    else {
      showMessage('Deleted', 'Post deleted');
      loadPosts();
      loadStats();
      if (viewingUserId === currentUser.id) loadUserPosts(currentUser.id, viewingAvatarUrl);
    }
    closeDeletePost();
  });
}

function switchSettingsTab(name) {
  var names = ['appearance','customisation','profile'];

  for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
    var pane = document.getElementById('settings-tab-' + names[i]);
    var btn = document.getElementById('settings-tab-btn-' + names[i]);
    var active = names[i] === name;

    if (pane) pane.classList.toggle('active', active);
    if (btn) btn.classList.toggle('active', active);
  }

  var content = document.querySelector('#edit-profile-modal .echo-settings-modal');
  if (content) content.scrollTop = 0;
}

function updateEchoPassword() {
  if (!currentUser) return;

  var password = document.getElementById('settings-new-password').value;
  var confirmPassword = document.getElementById('settings-confirm-password').value;

  if (!password || password.length < 6) {
    showMessage('Password', 'Use at least 6 characters for your new password.');
    return;
  }

  if (password !== confirmPassword) {
    showMessage('Password', 'The new passwords do not match.');
    return;
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.auth.updateUser({ password: password }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) {
      showMessage('Password', res.error.message);
      return;
    }

    document.getElementById('settings-new-password').value = '';
    document.getElementById('settings-confirm-password').value = '';
    showMessage('Password Updated', 'Your Echo password has been changed.');
  });
}

if (res.data) {
var storedBio = res.data.bio || '';
var profileStyle = getProfileStyleData(storedBio);
currentTop8Showcase = (profileStyle.top8Ids || []).slice(0, 8);
currentTop8BffId = profileStyle.top8BffId || '';
if (profileStyle.privacyStored) {

privacy.hideFavorites = profileStyle.hideFavorites;

try { localStorage.setItem('echoPrivacy', JSON.stringify(privacy)); } catch(e) {}

document.getElementById('username-letter-shuffle').checked = !!(profileStyle.profileExtras && profileStyle.profileExtras.letterShuffle);

renderProfileInterestSettings(res.data.interests || '');
var extras = profileStyle.profileExtras || { accentColor:'#0587fc', seasonalEffect:'none', gamingHandles:{}, boxShape:'rounded', cuteHearts:false, pawCorners:false, kittyCorners:false, pastelGlow:false, starSparkles:false };
document.getElementById('profile-accent-color').value = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(extras.accentColor || '') ? extras.accentColor : '#0587fc';
var settingsBoxShape = ['square','rounded','bubble'].indexOf(extras.boxShape) !== -1 ? extras.boxShape : 'rounded';

if (['square','rounded','bubble'].indexOf(metadataBoxShape) !== -1) {

function saveDisplayName() {
  var newName = document.getElementById('new-displayname').value.trim().substring(0, 20);
  if (!newName) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('profiles').update({ display_name: newName }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
    else {
      currentDisplayName = newName;
      document.getElementById('sidebar-name').textContent = newName;
      var profileNameEl = document.getElementById('profile-name');
      profileNameEl.textContent = newName;
      profileNameEl.setAttribute('data-echo-real-name', newName);
      applyProfileNameStyle('profile-name', profileNameEl.getAttribute('data-echo-style-bio') || '');
      showMessage('Saved', 'Display name updated.');
    }
  });
}
function saveUsername() {
  var newName = document.getElementById('new-username').value.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/^@/, '').replace(/\s+/g, '').substring(0, 20);
  if (!newName || newName === currentUsername) return;
  if (newName.indexOf(' ') !== -1) { showMessage('Error', 'Handle cannot contain spaces'); return; }
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('profiles').select('username').eq('username', newName).maybeSingle().then(function(check) {
    if (check.data) { showMessage('Error', 'Handle already taken'); return; }
    sb.from('profiles').update({ username: newName }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
      if (res.error) showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
      else {
        currentUsername = newName;
        document.getElementById('sidebar-handle').textContent = '@' + newName;
        document.getElementById('profile-handle').textContent = '@' + newName;
        showMessage('Saved', 'Handle updated.');
        refreshCurrentView();
      }
    });
  });
}

    return;

  sb.from('profiles').select('id, username').in('id', blockedUsers).then(function(res) {

      var u = res.data[i];

  });
}
