function getEchoComposerNodeText(node) {
  if (!node) return '';
  if (node.nodeType === 3) return node.nodeValue || '';
  if (node.nodeName === 'BR') return '\n';

  var out = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
    out += getEchoComposerNodeText(node.childNodes[i]);
  }
  return out;
}

function getEchoComposerText(root) {
  return getEchoComposerNodeText(root);
}

function getEchoCaretOffset(root) {
  var sel = window.getSelection();
  if (!sel || sel.rangeCount === 0) return 0;
  var range = sel.getRangeAt(0);
  if (!root.contains(range.startContainer)) return getEchoComposerText(root).length;

  var pre = range.cloneRange();
  pre.selectNodeContents(root);
  pre.setEnd(range.startContainer, range.startOffset);
  var fragment = pre.cloneContents();
  return getEchoComposerNodeText(fragment).length;
}

function setEchoCaretOffset(root, offset) {
  if (!root) return;
  if (offset === null || offset < 0) offset = 0;

  var remaining = offset;
  var range = document.createRange();
  var placed = false;

  function walk(node) {
    if (placed) return;

    if (node.nodeType === 3) {
      var len = (node.nodeValue || '').length;
      if (remaining <= len) {
        range.setStart(node, remaining);
        range.collapse(true);
        placed = true;
        return;
      }
      remaining -= len;
      return;
    }

    if (node.nodeName === 'BR') {
      if (remaining === 0) {
        range.setStartBefore(node);
        range.collapse(true);
        placed = true;
        return;
      }
      if (remaining === 1) {
        range.setStartAfter(node);
        range.collapse(true);
        placed = true;
        return;
      }
      remaining -= 1;
      return;
    }

    for (var i = 0; i < node.childNodes.length; i++) {
      walk(node.childNodes[i]);
      if (placed) return;
    }
  }

  walk(root);

  if (!placed) {
    range.selectNodeContents(root);
    range.collapse(false);
  }

  var sel = window.getSelection();
  sel.removeAllRanges();
  sel.addRange(range);
}

var echoMentionRequestTokens = {};

function getEchoMentionContext(editor) {
  if (!editor) return null;
  var text = getEchoComposerText(editor);
  var caret = getEchoCaretOffset(editor);
  var before = text.substring(0, caret);
  var match = before.match(/(?:^|\s)@([a-zA-Z0-9_]*)$/);

  if (!match) return null;

  var query = match[1] || '';
  var atIndex = caret - query.length - 1;

  return {
    query: query,
    atIndex: atIndex,
    caret: caret,
    text: text
  };
}

function getEchoMentionBox(editorId) {
  return document.getElementById(
    editorId === 'home-compose-editor'
      ? 'home-mention-suggestions'
      : 'compose-mention-suggestions'
  );
}

function hideEchoMentionSuggestions(editorId) {
  var box = getEchoMentionBox(editorId);
  if (!box) return;
  box.style.display = 'none';
  box.innerHTML = '';
}

function updateEchoMentionSuggestions(editor) {
if (!editor || !currentUser) {
if (editor) hideEchoMentionSuggestions(editor.id);
return;
}

var context = getEchoMentionContext(editor);
if (!context || context.query.length > 20) {
hideEchoMentionSuggestions(editor.id);
return;
}

var editorId = editor.id;
var token = (echoMentionRequestTokens[editorId] || 0) + 1;
echoMentionRequestTokens[editorId] = token;

var sb = getSupabase();
var query = context.query.toLowerCase();
var fields = 'id,username,display_name,avatar_url';

function finish(rows) {
if (echoMentionRequestTokens[editorId] !== token) return;

var currentContext = getEchoMentionContext(editor);
if (!currentContext || currentContext.query.toLowerCase() !== query) {
hideEchoMentionSuggestions(editorId);
return;
}

var box = getEchoMentionBox(editorId);
if (!box) return;

if (!rows || !rows.length) {
hideEchoMentionSuggestions(editorId);
return;
}

var html = '';
for (var i = 0; i < rows.length && i < 7; i++) {
var p = rows[i];
var username = p.username || '';
if (!username) continue;

html += '<div class="echo-mention-item" data-username="' +
echoEscapeHtml(username) +
'" onmousedown="event.preventDefault();chooseEchoMention(\'' +
editorId +
'\',this.getAttribute(\'data-username\'))">' +
'<div class="echo-mention-avatar" style="background-image:' +
echoHtmlCssBackground(p.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
';"></div>' +
'<div class="echo-mention-name"><strong>' +
echoEscapeHtml(p.display_name || username) +
'</strong><span>@' +
echoEscapeHtml(username) +
'</span></div></div>';
}

if (!html) {
hideEchoMentionSuggestions(editorId);
return;
}

box.innerHTML = html;
box.style.display = 'block';
}

if (query) {
sb.from('profiles')
.select(fields)
.or('username.ilike.%' + query + '%,display_name.ilike.%' + query + '%')
.limit(7)
.then(function(res) {
var rows = res.data || [];
rows.sort(function(a, b) {
return (followingMap[b.id] ? 1 : 0) - (followingMap[a.id] ? 1 : 0);
});
finish(rows);
});
return;
}

var followedIds = Object.keys(followingMap).filter(function(id) {
return followingMap[id];
}).slice(0, 5);

var followedRequest = followedIds.length
? sb.from('profiles').select(fields).in('id', followedIds)
: Promise.resolve({ data: [] });

var randomRequest = sb.from('profiles').select(fields).limit(30);

Promise.all([followedRequest, randomRequest]).then(function(results) {
var followedRows = (results[0] && results[0].data) || [];
var pool = (results[1] && results[1].data) || [];
var seen = {};

for (var i = 0; i < followedRows.length; i++) {
seen[followedRows[i].id] = true;
}

var randomRows = [];
for (var j = 0; j < pool.length; j++) {
if (!seen[pool[j].id]) randomRows.push(pool[j]);
}

for (var k = randomRows.length - 1; k > 0; k--) {
var r = Math.floor(Math.random() * (k + 1));
var temp = randomRows[k];
randomRows[k] = randomRows[r];
randomRows[r] = temp;
}

finish(followedRows.concat(randomRows).slice(0, 7));
});
}

function chooseEchoMention(editorId, username) {
  var editor = document.getElementById(editorId);
  if (!editor || !username) return;

  var context = getEchoMentionContext(editor);
  if (!context) return;

  var before = context.text.substring(0, context.atIndex);
  var after = context.text.substring(context.caret);
  var inserted = '@' + username + ' ';
  var nextText = before + inserted + after;
  var nextCaret = before.length + inserted.length;

  editor.textContent = nextText;

  if (editorId === 'home-compose-editor') {
    updateHomeCompose();
  } else {
    updateComposePreview();
  }

  setEchoCaretOffset(editor, nextCaret);
  hideEchoMentionSuggestions(editorId);
  editor.focus();
}

function replaceEchoComposerText(editor, text, caretOffset) {
  if (!editor) return;

  editor.textContent = text;

  if (editor.id === 'home-compose-editor') {
    updateHomeCompose();
  } else if (editor.id === 'compose-editor') {
    updateComposePreview();
  }

  setEchoCaretOffset(editor, caretOffset);
}

function replaceEchoComposerText(editor, text, caretOffset) {
  if (!editor) return;

  var html = echoEscapeHtml(text)
    .replace(/#([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g, '<span style="color:#1da1f2;">#$1</span>')
    .replace(/@([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g, '<span style="color:#1da1f2;">@$1</span>')
    .replace(/\n/g, '<br>');

  editor.innerHTML = html;

  if (editor.id === 'home-compose-editor') {
    document.getElementById('home-compose-count').innerHTML = 160 - text.length;
    updateEchoMentionSuggestions(editor);
  } else if (editor.id === 'compose-editor') {
    document.getElementById('compose-count').innerHTML = 160 - text.length;
    updateEchoMentionSuggestions(editor);
  }

  setEchoCaretOffset(editor, caretOffset);
}

function handleEchoComposerKeydown(event, editor) {
  if (!event || !editor) return;

  var text = getEchoComposerText(editor);
  var caret = getEchoCaretOffset(editor);
  var before = text.substring(0, caret);
  var after = text.substring(caret);
  var lineStart = before.lastIndexOf('\n') + 1;
  var currentLine = before.substring(lineStart);

  
  if (event.key === ' ' && /^(\s*)-$/.test(currentLine)) {
    event.preventDefault();
    var indent = currentLine.match(/^(\s*)-/)[1] || '';
    var replacement = indent + '• ';
    var bulletText = text.substring(0, lineStart) + replacement + after;
    var bulletCaret = lineStart + replacement.length;
    replaceEchoComposerText(editor, bulletText, bulletCaret);
    return;
  }

  if (event.key !== 'Enter') return;

  event.preventDefault();

  var bulletMatch = currentLine.match(/^(\s*)•\s?(.*)$/);

  if (bulletMatch) {
    
    if (!bulletMatch[2].trim()) {
      var beforeLine = text.substring(0, lineStart);
      var endedText = beforeLine + after;
      replaceEchoComposerText(editor, endedText, beforeLine.length);
      return;
    }

    var nextBullet = '\n' + bulletMatch[1] + '• ';
    var continuedText = before + nextBullet + after;
    replaceEchoComposerText(editor, continuedText, before.length + nextBullet.length);
    return;
  }

  var inserted = '\n';
  var nextText = before + inserted + after;
  replaceEchoComposerText(editor, nextText, before.length + 1);
}

function updateComposePreview() {
  var editor = document.getElementById('compose-editor');
  var caretOffset = getEchoCaretOffset(editor);
  var rawText = getEchoComposerText(editor);

  if (rawText.length > 160) {
    rawText = rawText.substring(0, 160);
    replaceEchoComposerText(editor, rawText, Math.min(caretOffset, 160));
    return;
  }

  document.getElementById('compose-count').textContent = 160 - rawText.length;

  if (!rawText) {
    hideEchoMentionSuggestions('compose-editor');
    return;
  }

  var html = echoEscapeComposerHtml(rawText)
    .replace(/#([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g, '<span style="color:#1da1f2;">#$1</span>')
    .replace(/@([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g, '<span style="color:#1da1f2;">@$1</span>')
    .replace(/\n/g, '<br>');

  editor.innerHTML = html;
  setEchoCaretOffset(editor, caretOffset);
  updateEchoMentionSuggestions(editor);
}
function openEmojiPicker(targetId, btn) {
  var existing = document.getElementById('emoji-picker-popup');
  if (existing) existing.remove();
  var emojis = ['\uD83D\uDE0A','\uD83D\uDE02','\u2764\uFE0F','\uD83D\uDC4D','\uD83D\uDD25','\uD83C\uDF89','\uD83D\uDE0E','\uD83E\uDD14','\uD83D\uDE22','\uD83D\uDE2E','\uD83D\uDCAF','\u2728','\uD83D\uDE4F','\uD83D\uDC4F','\uD83D\uDE80'];
  var picker = document.createElement('div');
  picker.id = 'emoji-picker-popup';
  picker.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:6px;padding:8px;z-index:2000;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;width:200px;';
  emojis.forEach(function(e) {
    var b = document.createElement('button');
    b.textContent = e;
    b.style.cssText = 'font-size:20px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:4px;line-height:1;width:32px;';
    b.onclick = function(ev) {
      ev.stopPropagation();
      var el = document.getElementById(targetId);
      if (el.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || el.tagName === 'INPUT') {
        el.value += e;
      } else {
        if (el.innerText === "What's new?") { el.innerHTML = ''; el.style.color = '#333'; }
        el.innerHTML += e;
        if (targetId === 'home-compose-editor') updateHomeCompose();
        else if (targetId === 'compose-editor') updateComposePreview();
      }
      picker.remove();
    };
    picker.appendChild(b);
  });
  document.body.appendChild(picker);
  var r = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
  picker.style.left = r.left + 'px';
  picker.style.top = (r.bottom + window.scrollY + 4) + 'px';
  setTimeout(function() {
    function closer(ev) {
      if (!picker.contains(ev.target) && picker.parentNode) {
        picker.remove();
        document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', closer, true);
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', closer, true);
  }, 10);
}
function updateHomeCompose() {
  var editor = document.getElementById('home-compose-editor');
  var caretOffset = getEchoCaretOffset(editor);
  var rawText = getEchoComposerText(editor);

  if (rawText.length > 160) {
    rawText = rawText.substring(0, 160);
    replaceEchoComposerText(editor, rawText, Math.min(caretOffset, 160));
    return;
  }

  document.getElementById('home-compose-count').textContent = 160 - rawText.length;

  if (!rawText || rawText === "What's new?") {
    hideEchoMentionSuggestions('home-compose-editor');
    return;
  }

  var html = echoEscapeComposerHtml(rawText)
    .replace(/#([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g, '<span style="color:#1da1f2;">#$1</span>')
    .replace(/@([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/g, '<span style="color:#1da1f2;">@$1</span>')
    .replace(/\n/g, '<br>');

  editor.innerHTML = html;
  setEchoCaretOffset(editor, caretOffset);
  updateEchoMentionSuggestions(editor);
}

function postFromHome() {
  if (!currentUser) { showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to post'); return; }
  var homeEditor = document.getElementById('home-compose-editor');
  var text = getEchoPostText(homeEditor);
  if (!text || text === "What's new?") return;
  if (text.length > 160) {
    showMessage('Echo too long', 'Echos can be up to 160 characters. Your Echo is ' + text.length + ' characters.');
    return;
  }
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var pollOpts = [];
  if (document.getElementById('home-poll-options') && document.getElementById('home-poll-options').style.display !== 'none') {
    for (var i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
      var v = document.getElementById('home-poll' + i).value.trim();
      if (v) pollOpts.push(v);
    }
  }
  var insert = { user_id: currentUser.id, text: text };
  if (pollOpts.length >= 2) insert.poll_options = JSON.stringify(pollOpts);
  sb.from('posts').insert(insert).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
    else {
      document.getElementById('home-compose-editor').innerHTML = "What's new?";
      document.getElementById('home-compose-editor').style.color = '#999';
      document.getElementById('home-compose-count').innerHTML = '160';
      if (document.getElementById('home-poll-options')) document.getElementById('home-poll-options').style.display = 'none';
      loadPosts(); loadStats(); loadTrending();
      checkEchoBadges();
    }
  });
}
function togglePollOptions() {
  var el = document.getElementById('poll-options');
  el.style.display = el.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
}

function postFromModal() {
  var composeEditor = document.getElementById('compose-editor');
  var text = getEchoPostText(composeEditor);
  if (!text) return;
  if (text.length > 160) {
    showMessage('Echo too long', 'Echos can be up to 160 characters. Your Echo is ' + text.length + ' characters.');
    return;
  }
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var pollOpts = [];
  if (document.getElementById('poll-options').style.display !== 'none') {
    for (var i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
      var v = document.getElementById('poll-opt' + i).value.trim();
      if (v) pollOpts.push(v);
    }
  }
  var insert = { user_id: currentUser.id, text: text };
  if (pollOpts.length >= 2) insert.poll_options = JSON.stringify(pollOpts);
  sb.from('posts').insert(insert).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) {
      showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
    } else {
      closeCompose();
      loadPosts();
      loadStats();
      loadTrending();
      checkEchoBadges();

      var profilePage = document.getElementById('page-profile');
      if (
        profilePage &&
        profilePage.classList.contains('active') &&
        viewingUserId === currentUser.id &&
        currentProfileTab === 'echos'
      ) {
        loadUserPosts(currentUser.id, viewingAvatarUrl);
        loadProfileStats(currentUser.id);
      }
    }
  });
}

function closeAllDropdowns() {
  ['profile-dropdown','notif-dropdown','other-dropdown'].forEach(function(id) {
    var d = document.getElementById(id);
    if (d && d.classList.contains('show')) { d.classList.remove('show'); setTimeout(function() { if (d) d.style.display = 'none'; }, 150); }
  });
  var sd = document.getElementById('search-dropdown'); if (sd) sd.style.display = 'none';
  var otherWrap = document.getElementById('other-profile-menu');
  if (otherWrap) otherWrap.classList.remove('open');
}
document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (!e.target.closest('.profile-dropdown-wrap') && !e.target.closest('.notif-wrap') && !e.target.closest('.other-profile-dropdown') && !e.target.closest('.search-wrap')) closeAllDropdowns();
});
function toggleProfileDropdown() {
  var d = document.getElementById('profile-dropdown');
  if (d.classList.contains('show')) {
    d.classList.remove('show');
    setTimeout(function() { d.style.display = 'none'; }, 150);
  } else {
    closeAllDropdowns();
    d.style.display = 'block';
    setTimeout(function() { d.classList.add('show'); }, 10);
  }
}
function toggleNotifDropdown() {
  var d = document.getElementById('notif-dropdown');
  if (d.classList.contains('show')) {
    d.classList.remove('show');
    setTimeout(function() { d.style.display = 'none'; }, 150);
  } else {
    closeAllDropdowns();
    renderNotifications();
    d.style.display = 'block';
    setTimeout(function() { d.classList.add('show'); }, 10);
  }
}
function syncNotificationBellState() {
  var btn = document.getElementById('notif-btn');
  if (!btn) return;

  var unreadCount = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < notifications.length; i++) {
    if (!notifications[i].read) unreadCount++;
  }

  btn.src = unreadCount > 0
    ? 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/bellahge_orig.png'
    : 'https://theechonetwork.weebly.com/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/bell_orig.png';

  btn.className = unreadCount > 0 ? 'notif-btn has-notif' : 'notif-btn';
}

function renderNotifications() {
  var box = document.getElementById('notif-dropdown');
  var btn = document.getElementById('notif-btn');
  if (!box) return;

  var unreadCount = 0;
  for (var u = 0; u < notifications.length; u++) {
    if (!notifications[u].read) unreadCount++;
  }

  if (notifications.length === 0) {
    box.innerHTML = '<div class="notif-item">No notifications yet</div>';
    syncNotificationBellState();
    return;
  }

  var html =
    '<div class="notif-toolbar">' +
      '<button onclick="event.stopPropagation();markAllNotificationsRead()">Mark all read</button>' +
      '<button onclick="event.stopPropagation();clearReadNotifications()">Clear read</button>' +
    '</div>';

  for (var i = 0; i < notifications.length; i++) {
    var n = notifications[i] || {};
    var safeText = echoEscapeHtml(n.text || '');
    var readClass = n.read ? ' notif-read' : '';

    if (n.type === 'room_invite') {
      html += '<div class="notif-item' + readClass + '">' + safeText +
        '<br><button class="blue-btn" style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:11px;margin-top:4px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();acceptRoomInvite(' + i + ')">Accept</button> ' +
        '<button style="padding:2px 8px;font-size:11px;margin-top:4px;background:#666;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();declineRoomInvite(' + i + ')">Decline</button></div>';
    } else {
      html += '<div class="notif-item' + readClass + '" onclick="handleNotifClick(' + i + ')">' + safeText + '</div>';
    }
  }

  box.innerHTML = html;

  syncNotificationBellState();
}

function markAllNotificationsRead() {
  for (var i = 0; i < notifications.length; i++) notifications[i].read = true;
  saveNotifications();
  renderNotifications();
}

function clearReadNotifications() {
  var clearedAt = Date.now();

  for (var i = 0; i < notifications.length; i++) {
    var n = notifications[i] || {};
    if (!n.read) continue;

    if (n.key) dismissedNotifKeys[n.key] = clearedAt;

    dismissedNotifKeys[
      echoNotificationSignature(n.userId, n.text, n.postId, n.type)
    ] = clearedAt;

    if (n.type === 'room_invite' && n.inviteId) {
      dismissedNotifKeys['room-invite-' + n.inviteId] = clearedAt;
    }
  }

  notifications = notifications.filter(function(n) { return !n.read; });

  
  lastNotifCheck = new Date(clearedAt).toISOString();
  try { localStorage.setItem('echoLastNotifCheck', lastNotifCheck); } catch(e) {}

  saveDismissedNotifications();
  saveNotifications();
  renderNotifications();
}

function viewPost(postId) {
  if (!postId) { showPage('home'); return; }
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('posts').select('id, text, created_at, user_id, pinned, poll_options').eq('id', postId).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (!res.data) { showMessage('Not found', 'Post not found'); showPage('home'); return; }
    var p = res.data;
    sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified, bio').eq('id', p.user_id).maybeSingle().then(function(prof) {
      var u = prof.data ? { username: prof.data.username || 'user', display_name: prof.data.display_name || prof.data.username || 'user', avatar: prof.data.avatar_url, verified: !!prof.data.verified, bio: prof.data.bio || '' } : { username: 'user', display_name: 'user', avatar: null, verified: false, bio: '' };
      var av = u.avatar ? "url('" + u.avatar + "')" : "url('https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/friend_orig.png')";
      var counts = {};
      var done = 0;
      function finish() {
        done++;
        if (done < 3) return;
        showPage('home');
        var timeline = document.getElementById('timeline');
        timeline.innerHTML = renderTweet(p, u, av, false, counts[p.id] || {}) + '<p style="margin-top:10px;color:#888;">Showing specific post. <a href="#" onclick="loadPosts();return false;">Back to feed</a></p>';
      }
      sb.from('likes').select('post_id').eq('post_id', postId).then(function(r) {
        counts[postId] = counts[postId] || {};
        counts[postId].likes = (r.data || []).length;
        finish();
      });
      loadEchoFavoriteCounts([postId], function(favCounts) {
        counts[postId] = counts[postId] || {};
        counts[postId].favs = favCounts[String(postId)] || 0;
        finish();
      });
      sb.from('reposts').select('post_id').eq('post_id', postId).then(function(r) {
        counts[postId] = counts[postId] || {};
        counts[postId].reposts = (r.data || []).length;
        finish();
      });
    });
  });
}

function acceptRoomInvite(index) {
  var n = notifications[index];
  if (!n || n.type !== 'room_invite') return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('room_invites').update({ status: 'accepted' }).eq('id', n.inviteId).then(function() {
    sb.from('room_members').insert({ room_id: n.roomId, user_id: currentUser.id }).then(function() {
      notifications.splice(index, 1);
      saveNotifications();
      renderNotifications();
      toggleNotifDropdown();
      showPage('crew');
      setTimeout(function() { openCrewRoom(n.roomId); }, 300);
    });
  });
}
function declineRoomInvite(index) {
  var n = notifications[index];
  if (!n || n.type !== 'room_invite') return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('room_invites').update({ status: 'declined' }).eq('id', n.inviteId).then(function() {
    notifications.splice(index, 1);
    saveNotifications();
    renderNotifications();
    toggleNotifDropdown();
  });
}

function handleNotifClick(index) {
  var n = notifications[index];
  if (!n) return;

  n.read = true;
  saveNotifications();
  renderNotifications();

  if (n.type === 'admin_warning') {
    var warningText = (n.text || '').replace(/^Admin warning:\s*/i, '');
    showMessage('Admin warning', echoEscapeHtml(warningText));
  } else if (n.type === 'follow' || !n.postId) {
    viewProfile(n.userId);
  } else if (n.type === 'comment' || n.type === 'reply') {
    openPostModal(n.postId);
  } else {
    viewPost(n.postId);
  }

  var d = document.getElementById('notif-dropdown');
  if (d) {
    d.classList.remove('show');
    setTimeout(function() { d.style.display = 'none'; }, 150);
  }
}

function addNotif(key, userId, text, postId, type) {
  if (userId && isMuted(userId)) return;

  var signature = echoNotificationSignature(userId, text, postId, type);

  

  if (dismissedNotifKeys[key] || dismissedNotifKeys[signature]) return;

  var now = Date.now();
  if (notifTimes[key]) return;

  notifTimes[key] = now;
  notifications.unshift({
    key: key,
    userId: userId,
    text: text,
    time: new Date().toISOString(),
    postId: postId || null,
    type: type || 'profile',
    read: false
  });

  if (notifications.length > 30) notifications = notifications.slice(0, 30);
  saveNotifTimes();
  saveNotifications();
  renderNotifications();
  playEchoNotificationSound();
}

function checkNotifications() {
if (!currentUser || !currentUsername) return;
var sb = getSupabase();
var checkStartedAt = new Date().toISOString();
var since = lastNotifCheck || new Date(Date.now() - (7 * 86400000)).toISOString();


sb.from('admin_warnings')
.select('id,message,created_at')
.eq('user_id', currentUser.id)
.gt('created_at', since)
.order('created_at', { ascending:false })
.limit(20)
.then(function(warnings) {
if (!warnings.error && warnings.data) {
warnings.data.forEach(function(w) {
addNotif(
'admin-warning-' + w.id,
currentUser.id,
'Admin warning: ' + (w.message || 'Echo staff have issued an account warning.'),
null,
'admin_warning'
);
});
}
});

sb.from('follows').select('follower_id, created_at').eq('following_id', currentUser.id).gt('created_at', since).limit(10).then(function(res) {
if (res.data && res.data.length) {
checkEchoBadges();
var ids = res.data.map(function(f) { return f.follower_id; });
sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name').in('id', ids).then(function(prof) {
var map = {};
if (prof.data) prof.data.forEach(function(p) { map[p.id] = p.display_name || p.username || 'Someone'; });
res.data.forEach(function(f) {
addNotif('follow-' + f.follower_id, f.follower_id, (map[f.follower_id] || 'Someone') + ' followed you', null, 'follow');
});
});
}
});

sb.from('posts').select('id').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(myPosts) {
var myIds = (myPosts.data || []).map(function(p) { return p.id; });
if (myIds.length === 0) return;
sb.from('likes').select('user_id, post_id').in('post_id', myIds).limit(30).then(function(likes) {
if (likes.data && likes.data.length) {
var uids = likes.data.map(function(l) { return l.user_id; });
sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name').in('id', uids).then(function(prof) {

if (prof.data) prof.data.forEach(function(p) { map[p.id] = p.display_name || p.username || 'Someone'; });
likes.data.forEach(function(l) {
if (l.user_id !== currentUser.id) addNotif('like-' + l.user_id + '-' + l.post_id, l.user_id, (map[l.user_id] || 'Someone') + ' liked your echo', l.post_id, 'like');
});
});
}
});
sb.from('favorites').select('user_id, post_id').in('post_id', myIds).limit(30).then(function(favs) {
if (favs.data && favs.data.length) {
var uids = favs.data.map(function(f) { return f.user_id; });
sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name').in('id', uids).then(function(prof) {
var map = {};
if (prof.data) prof.data.forEach(function(p) { map[p.id] = p.display_name || p.username || 'Someone'; });
favs.data.forEach(function(f) {
if (f.user_id !== currentUser.id) addNotif('fav-' + f.user_id + '-' + f.post_id, f.user_id, (map[f.user_id] || 'Someone') + ' favorited your echo', f.post_id, 'fav');
});
});
}
});
sb.from('reposts').select('user_id, post_id').in('post_id', myIds).limit(30).then(function(rps) {
if (rps.data && rps.data.length) {
var uids = rps.data.map(function(r) { return r.user_id; });
sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name').in('id', uids).then(function(prof) {
var map = {};
if (prof.data) prof.data.forEach(function(p) { map[p.id] = p.display_name || p.username || 'Someone'; });
rps.data.forEach(function(r) {
if (r.user_id !== currentUser.id) addNotif('repost-' + r.user_id + '-' + r.post_id, r.user_id, (map[r.user_id] || 'Someone') + ' reposted your echo', r.post_id, 'repost');
});
});
}
});
});

sb.from('posts').select('id, user_id, text, created_at').gt('created_at', since).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(50).then(function(res) {
if (!res.data) return;
var mentioned = [];
res.data.forEach(function(p) {
if (p.user_id !== currentUser.id && (p.text || '').toLowerCase().indexOf('@' + currentUsername.toLowerCase()) !== -1) {
mentioned.push(p);
}
});
if (mentioned.length === 0) return;
var uids = mentioned.map(function(m) { return m.user_id; });
sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name').in('id', uids).then(function(prof) {
var map = {};
if (prof.data) prof.data.forEach(function(p) { map[p.id] = p.display_name || p.username || 'Someone'; });
mentioned.forEach(function(m) {
addNotif('mention-' + m.user_id + '-' + m.id, m.user_id, (map[m.user_id] || 'Someone') + ' mentioned you', m.id, 'mention');
});
});
});

sb.from('posts').select('id').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(myPosts) {
var myIds = (myPosts.data || []).map(function(p) { return p.id; });
if (myIds.length === 0) return;
sb.from('comments').select('user_id, post_id, created_at').in('post_id', myIds).gt('created_at', since).limit(20).then(function(cmts) {
if (cmts.data && cmts.data.length) {
var uids = cmts.data.map(function(c) { return c.user_id; });
sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name').in('id', uids).then(function(prof) {
var map = {};
if (prof.data) prof.data.forEach(function(p) { map[p.id] = p.display_name || p.username || 'Someone'; });
cmts.data.forEach(function(c) {
if (c.user_id !== currentUser.id) addNotif('comment-' + c.user_id + '-' + c.post_id + '-' + c.created_at, c.user_id, (map[c.user_id] || 'Someone') + ' commented on your echo', c.post_id, 'comment');
});
});
}
});
});

sb.from('comments').select('post_id').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(myComments) {
var postIds = [];
if (myComments.data) {
for (var i = 0; i < myComments.data.length; i++) {
if (postIds.indexOf(myComments.data[i].post_id) === -1) postIds.push(myComments.data[i].post_id);
}
}
if (postIds.length === 0) return;
sb.from('comments').select('user_id, post_id, created_at').in('post_id', postIds).gt('created_at', since).limit(30).then(function(replies) {
if (!replies.data || replies.data.length === 0) return;
var uids = [];
for (var j = 0; j < replies.data.length; j++) {
if (replies.data[j].user_id !== currentUser.id && uids.indexOf(replies.data[j].user_id) === -1) uids.push(replies.data[j].user_id);
}
if (uids.length === 0) return;
sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name').in('id', uids).then(function(prof) {
var map = {};
if (prof.data) prof.data.forEach(function(p) { map[p.id] = p.display_name || p.username || 'Someone'; });
replies.data.forEach(function(r) {
if (r.user_id !== currentUser.id) addNotif('reply-' + r.user_id + '-' + r.post_id + '-' + r.created_at, r.user_id, (map[r.user_id] || 'Someone') + ' replied to your comment', r.post_id, 'reply');
});
});
});
});

lastNotifCheck = checkStartedAt;
try { localStorage.setItem('echoLastNotifCheck', lastNotifCheck); } catch(e) {}

sb.from('room_invites').select('id, room_id, inviter_id, status').eq('invitee_id', currentUser.id).eq('status', 'pending').then(function(res) {
if (res.data && res.data.length) {
var ids = res.data.map(function(i) { return i.inviter_id; });
var roomIds = res.data.map(function(i) { return i.room_id; });
sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name').in('id', ids).then(function(prof) {
var map = {};
if (prof.data) prof.data.forEach(function(p) { map[p.id] = p.display_name || p.username || 'Someone'; });
sb.from('rooms').select('id, name').in('id', roomIds).then(function(rooms) {
var roomMap = {};
if (rooms.data) rooms.data.forEach(function(r) { roomMap[r.id] = r.name; });
var addedInvite = false;
res.data.forEach(function(inv) {
var inviteKey = 'room-invite-' + inv.id;
var inviteText = (map[inv.inviter_id] || 'Someone') + ' invited you to "' + (roomMap[inv.room_id] || 'a room') + '"';
var inviteSignature = echoNotificationSignature(inv.inviter_id, inviteText, null, 'room_invite');
var already = notifications.some(function(n) { return n.inviteId === inv.id; });

if (!already && !dismissedNotifKeys[inviteKey] && !dismissedNotifKeys[inviteSignature]) {
notifications.unshift({
key: inviteKey,
userId: inv.inviter_id,
text: inviteText,
time: new Date().toISOString(),
type: 'room_invite',
inviteId: inv.id,
roomId: inv.room_id,
read: false
});
addedInvite = true;
}
});
if (notifications.length > 30) notifications = notifications.slice(0, 30);
saveNotifications();
renderNotifications();
if (addedInvite) playEchoNotificationSound();
});
});
}
});

sb.from('room_invites').select('id, room_id, invitee_id, status').eq('inviter_id', currentUser.id).eq('status', 'declined').then(function(res) {
if (res.data && res.data.length) {
var ids = res.data.map(function(i) { return i.invitee_id; });
sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name').in('id', ids).then(function(prof) {
var map = {};
if (prof.data) prof.data.forEach(function(p) { map[p.id] = p.display_name || p.username || 'Someone'; });
res.data.forEach(function(inv) {
var key = 'decline-' + inv.id;
if (!notifTimes[key]) {
addNotif(key, inv.invitee_id, (map[inv.invitee_id] || 'Someone') + ' declined your room invite', null, 'room_decline');
sb.from('room_invites').update({ status: 'declined_seen' }).eq('id', inv.id);
}
});
});
}
});
}

function toggleOtherDropdown() {
  var d = document.getElementById('other-dropdown');
  var wrap = document.getElementById('other-profile-menu');
  if (d.classList.contains('show')) {
    d.classList.remove('show');
    if (wrap) wrap.classList.remove('open');
    setTimeout(function() { d.style.display = 'none'; }, 150);
  } else {
    closeAllDropdowns();
    d.style.display = 'block';
    if (wrap) wrap.classList.add('open');
    setTimeout(function() { d.classList.add('show'); }, 10);
  }
}
function handleDropdownAuth() { toggleProfileDropdown(); if (currentUser) askSignOut(); else openAuth('signin'); }

function blockUser() {
  if (!currentUser || !viewingUserId) { showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to block'); return; }
  if (viewingUserId === currentUser.id) return;
  var targetId = viewingUserId;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('blocks').select('blocked_id').eq('blocker_id', currentUser.id).eq('blocked_id', targetId).maybeSingle().then(function(existing) {
    function finishBlock() {
      if (blockedUsers.indexOf(targetId) === -1) blockedUsers.push(targetId);
      mutedUsers = mutedUsers.filter(function(id) { return id !== targetId; });
      saveMutedUsers();
      sb.from('follows').delete().eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).eq('following_id', targetId).then(function() {
        delete followingMap[targetId];
        loadStats();
      });
      showMessage('Blocked', 'Account blocked and unfollowed.');
      showPage('home');
      loadPosts();
    }

    if (existing.data) {
      finishBlock();
      return;
    }

    sb.from('blocks').insert({ blocker_id: currentUser.id, blocked_id: targetId }).then(function(res) {
      if (res.error) { showMessage('Error', res.error.message); return; }
      finishBlock();
    });
  });
}
function openReportModal(type, userId, postId) {
  if (!currentUser) { showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to report'); return; }
  reportTargetType = type || 'profile';
  reportTargetUserId = userId || null;
  reportTargetPostId = postId || null;
  document.getElementById('report-spam').checked = false;
  document.getElementById('report-harassment').checked = false;
  document.getElementById('report-hate').checked = false;
  document.getElementById('report-illegal').checked = false;
  document.getElementById('report-impersonation').checked = false;
  document.getElementById('report-details').value = '';
  document.getElementById('report-modal-title').innerHTML = reportTargetType === 'post' ? 'Report Echo' : 'Report profile';
  document.getElementById('report-modal').style.display = 'flex';
}

function reportUser() {
  if (!currentUser || !viewingUserId) { showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to report'); return; }
  openReportModal('profile', viewingUserId, null);
}

function reportPost(postId, userId) {
  if (!currentUser) { showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to report'); return; }
  if (!postId || !userId || (currentUser && userId === currentUser.id)) return;
  openReportModal('post', userId, postId);
}
function triggerReportThresholdEmail(type, targetUserId, postId) {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var reasonPrefix = type === 'post' && postId ? '[Post ID ' + postId + '] ' : '[Profile] ';

  sb.from('reports')
    .select('reporter_id, reason')
    .eq('reported_id', targetUserId)
    .like('reason', reasonPrefix + '%')
    .limit(10)
    .then(function(reportRes) {
      var reports = reportRes.data || [];
      var reportLines = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < reports.length; i++) {
        reportLines.push((i + 1) + '. Reporter: ' + reports[i].reporter_id + '\n   ' + reports[i].reason);
      }

      function openSupportEmail(subjectText, targetDetails) {
        var bodyText =
          'Echo automatic report threshold reached.\n\n' +
          'Type: ' + (type === 'post' ? 'Echo/Post' : 'Profile') + '\n' +
          targetDetails + '\n' +
          'Reported user ID: ' + targetUserId + '\n' +
          'Report count: 10\n\n' +
          'Reports:\n' + reportLines.join('\n\n');

        window.location.href =
          'mailto:echowebsupport@gmail.com?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(subjectText) +
          '&body=' + encodeURIComponent(bodyText);
      }

      if (type === 'post' && postId) {
        sb.from('posts').select('id, text, created_at, user_id').eq('id', postId).maybeSingle().then(function(postRes) {
          var p = postRes.data || {};
          sb.from('profiles').select('username, display_name').eq('id', targetUserId).maybeSingle().then(function(profileRes) {
            var profile = profileRes.data || {};
            openSupportEmail(
              'Echo: Post reported 10 times - Post ' + postId,
              'Post ID: ' + postId + '\n' +
              'Author: ' + (profile.display_name || profile.username || 'Unknown') +
              (profile.username ? ' (@' + profile.username + ')' : '') + '\n' +
              'Created: ' + (p.created_at || 'Unknown') + '\n' +
              'Post text: ' + (p.text || '')
            );
          });
        });
      } else {
        sb.from('profiles').select('username, display_name, bio, interests').eq('id', targetUserId).maybeSingle().then(function(profileRes) {
          var profile = profileRes.data || {};
          openSupportEmail(
            'Echo: Profile reported 10 times - ' + (profile.username ? '@' + profile.username : targetUserId),
            'Account: ' + (profile.display_name || profile.username || 'Unknown') +
            (profile.username ? ' (@' + profile.username + ')' : '') + '\n' +
            'Bio: ' + (getVisibleBio(profile.bio || '') || '') + '\n' +
            'Interests: ' + (profile.interests || '')
          );
        });
      }
    });
}

function submitReport() {
  var reasons = [];
  if (document.getElementById('report-spam').checked) reasons.push('Spam');
  if (document.getElementById('report-harassment').checked) reasons.push('Harassment');
  if (document.getElementById('report-hate').checked) reasons.push('Extreme hate or violence');
  if (document.getElementById('report-illegal').checked) reasons.push('Illegal content');
  if (document.getElementById('report-impersonation').checked) reasons.push('Impersonation');
  var details = document.getElementById('report-details').value.trim();
  if (reasons.length === 0 && !details) { showMessage('Select a reason', 'Please select at least one reason or add details'); return; }

  var targetType = reportTargetType;
  var targetPostId = reportTargetPostId;
  var targetUserId = reportTargetUserId || viewingUserId;
  if (!targetUserId) { showMessage('Error', 'Report target not found.'); return; }

  var prefix = targetType === 'post' && targetPostId ? '[Post ID ' + targetPostId + '] ' : '[Profile] ';
  var reason = prefix + reasons.join(', ') + (details ? ' — ' + details : '');
  document.getElementById('report-modal').style.display = 'none';
  var sb = getSupabase();

  sb.from('reports').insert({ reporter_id: currentUser.id, reported_id: targetUserId, reason: reason }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) { showMessage('Error', res.error.message); return; }

    showMessage('Reported', targetType === 'post' ? 'Thank you. We will review this Echo.' : 'Thank you. We will review this account.');

    sb.from('reports')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('reported_id', targetUserId)
      .like('reason', prefix + '%')
      .then(function(countRes) {
        if (countRes.count === 10) {
          triggerReportThresholdEmail(targetType, targetUserId, targetPostId);
        }
      });

    reportTargetType = 'profile';
    reportTargetUserId = null;
    reportTargetPostId = null;
  });
}

function fetchAnthemName(url, userId) {
  if (url.indexOf('youtube.com') === -1 && url.indexOf('youtu.be') === -1) return;
  var id = url.match(/(?:v=|youtu\.be\/)([^&?]+)/);
  if (!id) return;
  var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
  xhr.open('GET', 'https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=' + id[1] + '&format=json', true);
  xhr.onload = function() {
    if (xhr.status === 200) {
      try {
        var data = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
        var title = data.title || 'Song';
        var el = document.getElementById('profile-anthem');
        if (el && el.innerHTML.indexOf('Anthem - Song') !== -1) {
          el.innerHTML = '<a href="#" onclick="playAnthem(\'' + url.replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\');return false;" style="color:#1da1f2;">Anthem - ' + title + '</a>';
        }
      } catch(e) {}
    }
  };
  xhr.send();
}

function setBackground(url) {
  if (!currentUser) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('profiles').update({ background_url: url }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
    else {
      document.body.style.backgroundImage = "url('" + url + "')";
      showMessage('Saved', 'Background updated.');
    }
  });
}

function saveAnthem() {
  var url = document.getElementById('anthem-url').value.trim();
  if (!url) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('profiles').update({ anthem_url: url }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
    else { showMessage('Saved', 'Anthem saved.'); loadProfile(); }
  });
}
function removeAnthem() {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('profiles').update({ anthem_url: null, anthem_name: null }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
    else { showMessage('Removed', 'Anthem removed.'); document.getElementById('anthem-url').value = ''; loadProfile(); }
  });
}
function playAnthem(url) {
  if (!url) return;
  var embed = '';
  if (url.indexOf('youtube.com') !== -1 || url.indexOf('youtu.be') !== -1) {
    var id = url.match(/(?:v=|youtu\.be\/)([^&?]+)/);
    if (id) embed = '<iframe width="280" height="157" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/' + id[1] + '?autoplay=1" frameborder="0" allow="autoplay"></iframe>';
  } else if (url.indexOf('spotify.com') !== -1) {
    var match = url.match(/track\/([a-zA-Z0-9]+)/);
    if (match) embed = '<iframe src="https://open.spotify.com/embed/track/' + match[1] + '" width="280" height="80" frameborder="0" allow="autoplay"></iframe>';
  }
  if (embed) {
    showMessage('Anthem', embed);
  } else {
    window.open(url, '_blank');
  }
}
