var currentShowcaseSelection = [];
var currentShowcaseRemoteItems = [];
var showcaseOnlineResults = [];
var showcaseSearchTimer = null;
var showcaseSearchVersion = 0;

function getShowcaseItem(id, remoteItems) {
  if (ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG[id]) {
    return {
      id: id,
      type: ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG[id].type,
      name: ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG[id].name,
      image: ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG[id].image
    };
  }

  remoteItems = remoteItems || currentShowcaseRemoteItems || [];
  for (var i = 0; i < remoteItems.length; i++) {
    if (remoteItems[i].id === id) {
      return {
        id: id,
        type: remoteItems[i].type === 'Band' ? 'Band' : 'Game',
        name: (remoteItems[i].name || '').toString().substring(0, 120),
        image: echoSafeShowcaseImage(remoteItems[i])
      };
    }
  }

  for (var j = 0; j < showcaseOnlineResults.length; j++) {
    if (showcaseOnlineResults[j].id === id) {
      return {
        id: id,
        type: showcaseOnlineResults[j].type === 'Band' ? 'Band' : 'Game',
        name: (showcaseOnlineResults[j].name || '').toString().substring(0, 120),
        image: echoSafeShowcaseImage(showcaseOnlineResults[j])
      };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function getSelectedRemoteShowcaseItems() {
  return currentShowcaseRemoteItems.filter(function(item) {
    return currentShowcaseSelection.indexOf(item.id) !== -1;
  }).slice(0, 8);
}

function getSelectedShowcaseFromSettings() {
  return currentShowcaseSelection.slice(0, 8);
}

function getShowcaseTypeCount(type) {
  var count = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < currentShowcaseSelection.length; i++) {
    var selected = getShowcaseItem(currentShowcaseSelection[i]);
    if (selected && selected.type === type) count++;
  }
  return count;
}

function normalizeShowcaseSelectionLimits() {
  var games = 0, bands = 0, kept = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < currentShowcaseSelection.length; i++) {
    var id = currentShowcaseSelection[i];
    var item = getShowcaseItem(id);
    if (!item) continue;
    if (item.type === 'Game' && games < 4) {
      kept.push(id); games++;
    } else if (item.type === 'Band' && bands < 4) {
      kept.push(id); bands++;
    }
  }
  currentShowcaseSelection = kept.slice(0, 8);
  currentShowcaseRemoteItems = currentShowcaseRemoteItems.filter(function(item) {
    return currentShowcaseSelection.indexOf(item.id) !== -1;
  });
}

function syncShowcaseSelection(id, checked) {
  var item = getShowcaseItem(id);
  if (!item) return;
  var idx = currentShowcaseSelection.indexOf(id);

  if (checked && idx === -1) {
    var typeCount = getShowcaseTypeCount(item.type);
    if (item.type === 'Game' && typeCount >= 4) {
      showMessage('My Showcase', 'You can add up to 4 games.');
      filterShowcaseSettings();
      return;
    }
    if (item.type === 'Band' && typeCount >= 4) {
      showMessage('My Showcase', 'You can add up to 4 bands.');
      filterShowcaseSettings();
      return;
    }
    if (currentShowcaseSelection.length >= 8) {
      showMessage('My Showcase', 'You can add up to 4 games and 4 bands.');
      filterShowcaseSettings();
      return;
    }

    currentShowcaseSelection.push(id);

    if (!ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG[id]) {
      var exists = currentShowcaseRemoteItems.some(function(remote) {
        return remote.id === id;
      });
      if (!exists) {
        currentShowcaseRemoteItems.push({
          id: item.id,
          type: item.type,
          name: item.name,
          image: item.image
        });
      }
    }
  } else if (!checked && idx !== -1) {
    currentShowcaseSelection.splice(idx, 1);
    if (!ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG[id]) {
      currentShowcaseRemoteItems = currentShowcaseRemoteItems.filter(function(remote) {
        return remote.id !== id;
      });
    }
  }
}

function checkShowcaseLimit() {
  normalizeShowcaseSelectionLimits();
}

var showcaseArtworkCache = {};

function fetchShowcaseGameArtwork(title, callback) {
  
  callback('');
}

function hydrateShowcaseGameArtwork(container, limit) {
  if (!container) return;
  var imgs = container.querySelectorAll('img[data-showcase-game-title]');
  var done = 0;
  limit = limit || imgs.length;

  for (var i = 0; i < imgs.length && done < limit; i++) {
    (function(img) {
      if (img.getAttribute('data-art-loaded') === '1') return;
      var title = img.getAttribute('data-showcase-game-title') || '';
      if (!title) return;
      img.setAttribute('data-art-loaded', '1');
      done++;

      fetchShowcaseGameArtwork(title, function(url) {
        if (url && img && img.parentNode) img.src = url;
      });
    })(imgs[i]);
  }
}

function renderShowcaseSettings(selectedIds, searchText, typeFilter) {
  var box = document.getElementById('showcase-settings-options');
  if (!box) return;
  if (Array.isArray(selectedIds)) currentShowcaseSelection = selectedIds.slice(0, 8);

  var query = (searchText == null ? '' : searchText).toString().trim().toLowerCase();
  var type = typeFilter || 'all';
  var rendered = {};
  var items = [];

  for (var s = 0; s < currentShowcaseRemoteItems.length; s++) {
    var selectedRemote = getShowcaseItem(currentShowcaseRemoteItems[s].id, currentShowcaseRemoteItems);
    if (selectedRemote && currentShowcaseSelection.indexOf(selectedRemote.id) !== -1) {
      items.push(selectedRemote);
      rendered[selectedRemote.id] = true;
    }
  }

  Object.keys(ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG).forEach(function(key) {
    var item = ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG[key];
    if (type !== 'all' && item.type !== type) return;
    if (query && item.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) === -1 && item.type.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) === -1) return;
    items.push({ id:key, type:item.type, name:item.name, image:item.image });
    rendered[key] = true;
  });

  for (var r = 0; r < showcaseOnlineResults.length; r++) {
    var remote = getShowcaseItem(showcaseOnlineResults[r].id, showcaseOnlineResults);
    if (!remote || rendered[remote.id]) continue;
    if (type !== 'all' && remote.type !== type) continue;
    if (query && remote.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) === -1) continue;
    items.push(remote);
    rendered[remote.id] = true;
  }

  items.sort(function(a, b) {
    var aSelected = currentShowcaseSelection.indexOf(a.id) !== -1 ? 0 : 1;
    var bSelected = currentShowcaseSelection.indexOf(b.id) !== -1 ? 0 : 1;
    if (aSelected !== bSelected) return aSelected - bSelected;
    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
  });

  var html = '';
  for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
    var item = items[i];
    var checked = currentShowcaseSelection.indexOf(item.id) !== -1 ? ' checked' : '';
    html += '<label class="showcase-settings-item">' +
      '<input type="checkbox" class="showcase-cb" value="' + echoEscapeHtml(item.id) + '"' + checked +
      ' onchange="syncShowcaseSelection(\'' + item.id.replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\', this.checked);filterShowcaseSettings()">' +
      '<img src="' + echoEscapeHtml(echoSafeShowcaseImage(item)) + '" ' +
      (item.type === 'Game' ? 'data-showcase-game-title="' + echoEscapeHtml(item.name) + '" ' : '') +
      'alt="' + echoEscapeHtml(item.name) + '">' +
      '<strong>' + echoEscapeHtml(item.name) + '</strong><small>' + echoEscapeHtml(item.type) + '</small></label>';
  }

  box.innerHTML = html || '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;grid-column:1/-1;">No matching bands or games.</p>';
  var count = document.getElementById('showcase-search-count');
  if (count) {
    count.textContent =
      getShowcaseTypeCount('Game') + '/4 games · ' +
      getShowcaseTypeCount('Band') + '/4 bands · ' +
      items.length + ' shown';
  }
}

function fetchWikipediaShowcase(query, type, version) {
  var searches = [];
  if (type === 'all' || type === 'Band') searches.push({ type: 'Band', term: query + ' band' });
  if (type === 'all' || type === 'Game') searches.push({ type: 'Game', term: query + ' video game' });

  Promise.all(searches.map(function(search) {
    var url = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&generator=search' +
      '&gsrsearch=' + encodeURIComponent(search.term) +
      '&gsrlimit=18&format=json&origin=*';

    return fetch(url)
      .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
      .then(function(data) {
        var pages = data && data.query && data.query.pages
          ? Object.keys(data.query.pages).map(function(k) { return data.query.pages[k]; })
          : [];
        return pages.map(function(page) {
          return {
            id: 'wiki-' + search.type.toLowerCase() + '-' + page.pageid,
            type: search.type,
            name: page.title,
            image: search.type === 'Band'
              ? 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A//www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20width%3D%22128%22%20height%3D%22128%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%20128%20128%22%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%22128%22%20height%3D%22128%22%20rx%3D%2218%22%20fill%3D%22%23222%22/%3E%3Ctext%20x%3D%2264%22%20y%3D%2276%22%20font-size%3D%2254%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20fill%3D%22white%22%3E%E2%99%AA%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E'
              : 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=UTF-8,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A//www.w3.org/2000/svg%22%20width%3D%22128%22%20height%3D%22128%22%20viewBox%3D%220%200%20128%20128%22%3E%3Crect%20width%3D%22128%22%20height%3D%22128%22%20rx%3D%2218%22%20fill%3D%22%23222%22/%3E%3Ctext%20x%3D%2264%22%20y%3D%2276%22%20font-size%3D%2244%22%20text-anchor%3D%22middle%22%20fill%3D%22white%22%3E%F0%9F%8E%AE%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E'
          };
        });
      })
      .catch(function() { return []; });
  })).then(function(groups) {
    if (version !== showcaseSearchVersion) return;

    var merged = [];
    var seen = {};
    for (var g = 0; g < groups.length; g++) {
      for (var i = 0; i < groups[g].length; i++) {
        var item = groups[g][i];
        var dedupe = item.type + '|' + item.name.toLowerCase();
        if (seen[dedupe]) continue;
        seen[dedupe] = true;

        var localDuplicate = Object.keys(ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG).some(function(localId) {
          var local = ECHO_SHOWCASE_CATALOG[localId];
          return local.type === item.type && local.name.toLowerCase() === item.name.toLowerCase();
        });
        if (!localDuplicate) merged.push(item);
      }
    }

    showcaseOnlineResults = merged.slice(0, 30);
    filterShowcaseSettings(true);
  });
}

function filterShowcaseSettings(skipOnlineSearch) {
  var q = document.getElementById('showcase-search');
  var type = document.getElementById('showcase-type-filter');
  var query = q ? q.value.trim() : '';
  var typeValue = type ? type.value : 'all';

  renderShowcaseSettings(null, query, typeValue);

  if (skipOnlineSearch === true) return;

  if (showcaseSearchTimer) clearTimeout(showcaseSearchTimer);

  if (query.length < 2) {
    showcaseOnlineResults = [];
    renderShowcaseSettings(null, query, typeValue);
    return;
  }

  var version = ++showcaseSearchVersion;
  showcaseSearchTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    fetchWikipediaShowcase(query, typeValue, version);
  }, 350);
}

function echoRegionFlag(code) {
  code = (code || '').toUpperCase();
  if (!/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(code)) return '';
  return String.fromCodePoint(
    127397 + code.charCodeAt(0),
    127397 + code.charCodeAt(1)
  );
}

function getEchoLocationFlag(locationText) {
  var value = (locationText || '').trim();
  if (!value) return '';

  var normalized = value.toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[.]/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();

  var aliases = {
    'united kingdom':'GB',
    'great britain':'GB',
    'britain':'GB',
    'uk':'GB',
    'england':'GB',
    'scotland':'GB',
    'wales':'GB',
    'northern ireland':'GB',
    'united states of america':'US',
    'united states':'US',
    'usa':'US',
    'us':'US',
    'canada':'CA',
    'mexico':'MX',
    'brazil':'BR',
    'argentina':'AR',
    'chile':'CL',
    'colombia':'CO',
    'peru':'PE',
    'ireland':'IE',
    'france':'FR',
    'germany':'DE',
    'spain':'ES',
    'portugal':'PT',
    'italy':'IT',
    'netherlands':'NL',
    'belgium':'BE',
    'switzerland':'CH',
    'austria':'AT',
    'poland':'PL',
    'czechia':'CZ',
    'czech republic':'CZ',
    'slovakia':'SK',
    'hungary':'HU',
    'romania':'RO',
    'bulgaria':'BG',
    'greece':'GR',
    'croatia':'HR',
    'serbia':'RS',
    'slovenia':'SI',
    'bosnia and herzegovina':'BA',
    'montenegro':'ME',
    'albania':'AL',
    'north macedonia':'MK',
    'ukraine':'UA',
    'belarus':'BY',
    'moldova':'MD',
    'denmark':'DK',
    'sweden':'SE',
    'norway':'NO',
    'finland':'FI',
    'iceland':'IS',
    'estonia':'EE',
    'latvia':'LV',
    'lithuania':'LT',
    'russia':'RU',
    'turkey':'TR',
    'türkiye':'TR',
    'israel':'IL',
    'palestine':'PS',
    'jordan':'JO',
    'lebanon':'LB',
    'saudi arabia':'SA',
    'uae':'AE',
    'united arab emirates':'AE',
    'qatar':'QA',
    'kuwait':'KW',
    'bahrain':'BH',
    'oman':'OM',
    'iraq':'IQ',
    'iran':'IR',
    'india':'IN',
    'pakistan':'PK',
    'bangladesh':'BD',
    'sri lanka':'LK',
    'nepal':'NP',
    'china':'CN',
    'japan':'JP',
    'south korea':'KR',
    'korea':'KR',
    'north korea':'KP',
    'taiwan':'TW',
    'hong kong':'HK',
    'singapore':'SG',
    'malaysia':'MY',
    'indonesia':'ID',
    'philippines':'PH',
    'thailand':'TH',
    'vietnam':'VN',
    'cambodia':'KH',
    'laos':'LA',
    'myanmar':'MM',
    'australia':'AU',
    'new zealand':'NZ',
    'south africa':'ZA',
    'egypt':'EG',
    'morocco':'MA',
    'algeria':'DZ',
    'tunisia':'TN',
    'nigeria':'NG',
    'ghana':'GH',
    'kenya':'KE',
    'ethiopia':'ET'
  };

  var keys = Object.keys(aliases).sort(function(a, b) {
    return b.length - a.length;
  });

  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var alias = keys[i];
    if (
      normalized === alias ||
      normalized.endsWith(', ' + alias) ||
      normalized.endsWith(' ' + alias)
    ) {
      return echoRegionFlag(aliases[alias]);
    }
  }

  var parts = value.split(',')
    .map(function(part) { return part.trim(); })
    .filter(Boolean);

  for (var p = parts.length - 1; p >= 0; p--) {
    if (/^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(parts[p])) {
      return echoRegionFlag(parts[p]);
    }
  }

  try {
    if (typeof Intl !== 'undefined' && Intl.DisplayNames) {
      var codes = (
        'AD AE AF AG AI AL AM AO AR AS AT AU AW AX AZ BA BB BD BE BF BG BH BI BJ BL BM BN BO BQ BR BS BT BW BY BZ ' +
        'CA CC CD CF CG CH CI CK CL CM CN CO CR CU CV CW CX CY CZ DE DJ DK DM DO DZ EC EE EG EH ER ES ET FI FJ FK FM ' +
        'FO FR GA GB GD GE GF GG GH GI GL GM GN GP GQ GR GS GT GU GW GY HK HM HN HR HT HU ID IE IL IM IN IO IQ IR IS ' +
        'IT JE JM JO JP KE KG KH KI KM KN KP KR KW KY KZ LA LB LC LI LK LR LS LT LU LV LY MA MC MD ME MF MG MH MK ML ' +
        'MM MN MO MP MQ MR MS MT MU MV MW MX MY MZ NA NC NE NF NG NI NL NO NP NR NU NZ OM PA PE PF PG PH PK PL PM PN ' +
        'PR PS PT PW PY QA RE RO RS RU RW SA SB SC SD SE SG SH SI SJ SK SL SM SN SO SR SS ST SV SX SY SZ TC TD TF TG ' +
        'TH TJ TK TL TM TN TO TR TT TV TW TZ UA UG UM US UY UZ VA VC VE VG VI VN VU WF WS YE YT ZA ZM ZW'
      ).split(' ');

      var displayNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(['en'], { type: 'region' });
      var target = parts.length
        ? parts[parts.length - 1].toLowerCase()
        : normalized;

      for (var c = 0; c < codes.length; c++) {
        var regionName = (displayNames.of(codes[c]) || '').toLowerCase();
        if (regionName === target) {
          return echoRegionFlag(codes[c]);
        }
      }
    }
  } catch(e) {}

  return '';
}

function renderProfileLocation(storedBio) {
  var el = document.getElementById('profile-location');
  if (!el) return;
  var style = getProfileStyleData(storedBio || '');
  var value = (style.locationText || '').trim();
  var oldBreak = document.getElementById('profile-location-break');
  if (oldBreak) oldBreak.remove();
  if (!value) {
    el.textContent = '';
    el.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }
  var flag = getEchoLocationFlag(value);
  el.textContent = (flag ? flag + ' ' : '') + value;
  el.style.display = 'inline';
  var br = document.createElement('br');
  br.id = 'profile-location-break';
  el.parentNode.insertBefore(br, el.nextSibling);
}

function renderProfileShowcase(storedBio) {
  var box = document.getElementById('profile-showcase');
  if (!box) return;

  var style = getProfileStyleData(storedBio || '');
  var ids = style.showcaseIds || [];
  var remoteItems = style.showcaseRemoteItems || [];

  if (!ids.length) {
    box.innerHTML = '<span style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">Nothing showcased yet.</span>';
    return;
  }

  var games = [], bands = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
    var item = getShowcaseItem(ids[i], remoteItems);
    if (!item) continue;
    if (item.type === 'Game') games.push(item);
    else if (item.type === 'Band') bands.push(item);
  }

  function renderGroup(title, items) {
    if (!items.length) return '';
    var html = '<div class="profile-showcase-group"><div class="profile-showcase-group-title">' +
      echoEscapeHtml(title) + '</div><div class="profile-showcase-grid">';

    for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++) {
      var item = items[j];
      html += '<div class="profile-showcase-item"><img src="' +
        echoEscapeHtml(echoSafeShowcaseImage(item)) + '" alt="' +
        echoEscapeHtml(item.name) + '"><span>' +
        echoEscapeHtml(item.name) + '</span></div>';
    }
    return html + '</div></div>';
  }

  var html = renderGroup('My Games', games) + renderGroup('My Bands', bands);
  box.innerHTML = html || '<span style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">Nothing showcased yet.</span>';
}

function getProfileStyleData(storedBio) {
  storedBio = storedBio || '';
  var isV2 = storedBio.indexOf(ECHO_STYLE_V2_PREFIX) === 0;
  var rest = isV2 ? storedBio.substring(ECHO_STYLE_V2_PREFIX.length) : storedBio;
  var moving = false, bioColor = false, nameColor = false, customNameColor = '', showcaseIds = [], showcaseRemoteItems = [], locationText = '', profileExtras = { accentColor:'#0587fc', seasonalEffect:'none', gamingHandles:{}, socials:{}, letterShuffle:false, boxShape:'rounded', boxShapeStored:false, cuteHearts:false, pawCorners:false, kittyCorners:false, pastelGlow:false, starSparkles:false, top8Notes:{} }, avatarGlow = false, avatarFloat = false, profileAura = false, profileNameGlow = false, profileNeonBorder = false, profileShine = false, profileElectricPulse = false, avatarOrbit = false, top8Ids = [], top8BffId = '', privateProfile = false, hideFavorites = false, postsVisibility = 'everyone', privacyStored = false, backgroundKey = ECHO_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_KEY, changed = true;

  while (changed) {
    changed = false;
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_MOVING_BIO_PREFIX) === 0) {
      moving = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_MOVING_BIO_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_COLOR_BIO_PREFIX) === 0) {
      bioColor = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_COLOR_BIO_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_COLOR_NAME_PREFIX) === 0) {
      nameColor = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_COLOR_NAME_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_CUSTOM_NAME_COLOR_PREFIX) === 0) {
      var nameColorEnd = rest.indexOf(']]');
      if (nameColorEnd !== -1) {
        var nameHex = rest.substring(ECHO_CUSTOM_NAME_COLOR_PREFIX.length, nameColorEnd);
        if (/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(nameHex)) customNameColor = nameHex;
        rest = rest.substring(nameColorEnd + 2);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_SHOWCASE_REMOTE_PREFIX) === 0) {
      var remoteShowcaseEnd = rest.indexOf(']]');
      if (remoteShowcaseEnd !== -1) {
        var remoteRaw = rest.substring(ECHO_SHOWCASE_REMOTE_PREFIX.length, remoteShowcaseEnd);
        try {
          var remoteParsed = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(remoteRaw));
          if (Array.isArray(remoteParsed)) {
            showcaseRemoteItems = remoteParsed.filter(function(item) {
              return item && item.id && item.name && (item.type === 'Band' || item.type === 'Game');
            }).slice(0, 8);
          }
        } catch(e) {}
        rest = rest.substring(remoteShowcaseEnd + 2);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_SHOWCASE_PREFIX) === 0) {
      var showcaseEnd = rest.indexOf(']]');
      if (showcaseEnd !== -1) {
        var showcaseRaw = rest.substring(ECHO_SHOWCASE_PREFIX.length, showcaseEnd);
        showcaseIds = showcaseRaw ? showcaseRaw.split('|').filter(function(id) { return !!id; }).slice(0, 8) : [];
        rest = rest.substring(showcaseEnd + 2);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_LOCATION_PREFIX) === 0) {
      var locationEnd = rest.indexOf(']]');
      if (locationEnd !== -1) {
        var locationRaw = rest.substring(ECHO_LOCATION_PREFIX.length, locationEnd);
        try { locationText = decodeURIComponent(locationRaw); } catch(e) { locationText = locationRaw; }
        locationText = locationText.substring(0, 50);
        rest = rest.substring(locationEnd + 2);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_PROFILE_EXTRAS_PREFIX) === 0) {
      var extrasEnd = rest.indexOf(']]');
      if (extrasEnd !== -1) {
        var extrasRaw = rest.substring(ECHO_PROFILE_EXTRAS_PREFIX.length, extrasEnd);
        try {
          var extrasParsed = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(extrasRaw));
          if (extrasParsed && typeof extrasParsed === 'object') {
            if (/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(extrasParsed.accentColor || '')) profileExtras.accentColor = extrasParsed.accentColor;
            if (['none','snow','autumn','money','bubbles','arcade','pixel'].indexOf(extrasParsed.seasonalEffect) !== -1) profileExtras.seasonalEffect = extrasParsed.seasonalEffect;
            if (extrasParsed.gamingHandles && typeof extrasParsed.gamingHandles === 'object') profileExtras.gamingHandles = extrasParsed.gamingHandles;
            if (extrasParsed.socials && typeof extrasParsed.socials === 'object') profileExtras.socials = extrasParsed.socials;
            profileExtras.letterShuffle = extrasParsed.letterShuffle === true;
            if (['square','rounded','bubble'].indexOf(extrasParsed.boxShape) !== -1) {
              profileExtras.boxShape = extrasParsed.boxShape;
              profileExtras.boxShapeStored = true;
            }
            profileExtras.cuteHearts = extrasParsed.cuteHearts === true;
            profileExtras.pawCorners = extrasParsed.pawCorners === true || extrasParsed.seasonalEffect === 'paw';
            profileExtras.kittyCorners = extrasParsed.kittyCorners === true || extrasParsed.seasonalEffect === 'kitty';
            profileExtras.pastelGlow = extrasParsed.pastelGlow === true;
            profileExtras.starSparkles = extrasParsed.starSparkles === true;
            if (extrasParsed.top8Notes && typeof extrasParsed.top8Notes === 'object') {
              var parsedTop8Notes = {};
              Object.keys(extrasParsed.top8Notes).slice(0, 8).forEach(function(id) {
                var note = (extrasParsed.top8Notes[id] || '').toString().trim().substring(0, 60);
                if (note) parsedTop8Notes[id] = note;
              });
              profileExtras.top8Notes = parsedTop8Notes;
            }
          }
        } catch(e) {}
        rest = rest.substring(extrasEnd + 2);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_BOX_SHAPE_PREFIX) === 0) {
      var boxShapeEnd = rest.indexOf(']]');
      if (boxShapeEnd !== -1) {
        var storedBoxShape = rest.substring(ECHO_BOX_SHAPE_PREFIX.length, boxShapeEnd);
        if (['square','rounded','bubble'].indexOf(storedBoxShape) !== -1) {
          profileExtras.boxShape = storedBoxShape;
          profileExtras.boxShapeStored = true;
        }
        rest = rest.substring(boxShapeEnd + 2);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_AVATAR_GLOW_PREFIX) === 0) {
      avatarGlow = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_AVATAR_GLOW_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_AVATAR_FLOAT_PREFIX) === 0) {
      avatarFloat = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_AVATAR_FLOAT_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_PROFILE_AURA_PREFIX) === 0) {
      profileAura = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_PROFILE_AURA_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_PROFILE_NAME_GLOW_PREFIX) === 0) {
      profileNameGlow = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_PROFILE_NAME_GLOW_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_PROFILE_NEON_BORDER_PREFIX) === 0) {
      profileNeonBorder = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_PROFILE_NEON_BORDER_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_PROFILE_SHINE_PREFIX) === 0) {
      profileShine = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_PROFILE_SHINE_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_PROFILE_ELECTRIC_PULSE_PREFIX) === 0) {
      profileElectricPulse = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_PROFILE_ELECTRIC_PULSE_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_AVATAR_ORBIT_PREFIX) === 0) {
      avatarOrbit = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_AVATAR_ORBIT_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_PRIVATE_PROFILE_PREFIX) === 0) {
      privateProfile = true;
      privacyStored = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_PRIVATE_PROFILE_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_HIDE_FAVORITES_PREFIX) === 0) {
      hideFavorites = true;
      privacyStored = true;
      rest = rest.substring(ECHO_HIDE_FAVORITES_PREFIX.length);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_POSTS_VIS_PREFIX) === 0) {
      var visEnd = rest.indexOf(']]');
      if (visEnd !== -1) {
        var vis = rest.substring(ECHO_POSTS_VIS_PREFIX.length, visEnd);
        if (vis === 'followers' || vis === 'mutual' || vis === 'everyone') postsVisibility = vis;
        privacyStored = true;
        rest = rest.substring(visEnd + 2);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_TOP8_BFF_PREFIX) === 0) {
      var bffEnd = rest.indexOf(']]');
      if (bffEnd !== -1) {
        top8BffId = rest.substring(ECHO_TOP8_BFF_PREFIX.length, bffEnd);
        rest = rest.substring(bffEnd + 2);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_TOP8_PREFIX) === 0) {
      var top8End = rest.indexOf(']]');
      if (top8End !== -1) {
        var top8Raw = rest.substring(ECHO_TOP8_PREFIX.length, top8End);
        top8Ids = top8Raw ? top8Raw.split('|').filter(function(id) { return id; }).slice(0, 8) : [];
        rest = rest.substring(top8End + 2);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (rest.indexOf(ECHO_PROFILE_BG_PREFIX) === 0) {
      var bgEnd = rest.indexOf(']]');
      if (bgEnd !== -1) {
        var bgKey = rest.substring(ECHO_PROFILE_BG_PREFIX.length, bgEnd);
        if (ECHO_PROFILE_BACKGROUNDS[bgKey]) backgroundKey = bgKey;
        rest = rest.substring(bgEnd + 2);
        changed = true;
      }
    }
  }

  /*
   * If a profile contains an Echo metadata marker from another/newer build
   * that this parser does not know yet, never show that marker as biography text.
   * Only strip marker-shaped metadata from the START of the stored bio.
   */
  var safety = 0;
  while (rest.indexOf('[[ECHO_') === 0 && safety < 30) {
    var unknownEnd = rest.indexOf(']]');
    if (unknownEnd === -1) break;
    rest = rest.substring(unknownEnd + 2);
    safety++;
  }

  rest = stripEchoMetadataFromVisibleText(rest);

  /* Before these separate checkboxes existed, moving bio also meant rainbow bio. */
  if (!isV2 && moving) bioColor = true;

  return { bio: rest, moving: moving, bioColor: bioColor, nameColor: nameColor, customNameColor: customNameColor, showcaseIds: showcaseIds, showcaseRemoteItems: showcaseRemoteItems, locationText: locationText, profileExtras: profileExtras, avatarGlow: avatarGlow, avatarFloat: avatarFloat, profileAura: profileAura, profileNameGlow: profileNameGlow, profileNeonBorder: profileNeonBorder, profileShine: profileShine, profileElectricPulse: profileElectricPulse, avatarOrbit: avatarOrbit, top8Ids: top8Ids, top8BffId: top8BffId, privateProfile: privateProfile, hideFavorites: hideFavorites, postsVisibility: postsVisibility, privacyStored: privacyStored, backgroundKey: backgroundKey };
}

function buildStoredBio(bio, moving, bioColor, nameColor, avatarGlow, avatarFloat, profileAura, profileNameGlow, profileNeonBorder, profileShine, profileElectricPulse, avatarOrbit, backgroundKey, top8Ids, privateProfile, hideFavorites, postsVisibility, customNameColor, showcaseIds, locationText, showcaseRemoteItems, top8BffId, profileExtras) {
  backgroundKey = ECHO_PROFILE_BACKGROUNDS[backgroundKey] ? backgroundKey : ECHO_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_KEY;
  return ECHO_STYLE_V2_PREFIX +
    (moving ? ECHO_MOVING_BIO_PREFIX : '') +
    (bioColor ? ECHO_COLOR_BIO_PREFIX : '') +
    (nameColor ? ECHO_COLOR_NAME_PREFIX : '') +
    (/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(customNameColor || '') ? ECHO_CUSTOM_NAME_COLOR_PREFIX + customNameColor + ']]' : '') +
    ((showcaseRemoteItems || []).length ? ECHO_SHOWCASE_REMOTE_PREFIX + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify((showcaseRemoteItems || []).slice(0, 8))) + ']]' : '') +
    ECHO_SHOWCASE_PREFIX + ((showcaseIds || []).filter(function(id) { return !!id; }).slice(0, 8).join('|')) + ']]' +
    ((locationText || '').trim() ? ECHO_LOCATION_PREFIX + encodeURIComponent((locationText || '').trim().substring(0, 50)) + ']]' : '') +
    ECHO_PROFILE_EXTRAS_PREFIX + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(profileExtras || { accentColor:'#0587fc', seasonalEffect:'none', gamingHandles:{}, boxShape:'rounded', cuteHearts:false, pawCorners:false, kittyCorners:false, pastelGlow:false, starSparkles:false, top8Notes:{} })) + ']]' +
    ECHO_BOX_SHAPE_PREFIX + ((profileExtras && ['square','rounded','bubble'].indexOf(profileExtras.boxShape) !== -1) ? profileExtras.boxShape : 'rounded') + ']]' +
    (avatarGlow ? ECHO_AVATAR_GLOW_PREFIX : '') +
    (avatarFloat ? ECHO_AVATAR_FLOAT_PREFIX : '') +
    (profileAura ? ECHO_PROFILE_AURA_PREFIX : '') +
    (profileNameGlow ? ECHO_PROFILE_NAME_GLOW_PREFIX : '') +
    (profileNeonBorder ? ECHO_PROFILE_NEON_BORDER_PREFIX : '') +
    (profileShine ? ECHO_PROFILE_SHINE_PREFIX : '') +
    (profileElectricPulse ? ECHO_PROFILE_ELECTRIC_PULSE_PREFIX : '') +
    (avatarOrbit ? ECHO_AVATAR_ORBIT_PREFIX : '') +
    (privateProfile ? ECHO_PRIVATE_PROFILE_PREFIX : '') +
    (hideFavorites ? ECHO_HIDE_FAVORITES_PREFIX : '') +
    ECHO_POSTS_VIS_PREFIX + ((postsVisibility === 'followers' || postsVisibility === 'mutual') ? postsVisibility : 'everyone') + ']]' +
    (top8BffId ? ECHO_TOP8_BFF_PREFIX + top8BffId + ']]' : '') +
    ECHO_TOP8_PREFIX + ((top8Ids || []).slice(0, 8).join('|')) + ']]' +
    ECHO_PROFILE_BG_PREFIX + backgroundKey + ']]' +
    (bio || '');
}

function stripEchoMetadataFromVisibleText(value) {
  var text = (value || '').toString();
  var safety = 0;

  while (safety < 60) {
    var next = text.replace(/^\s+/, '');
    if (next.indexOf('[[ECHO_') !== 0) {
      text = next;
      break;
    }
    var end = next.indexOf(']]');
    if (end === -1) break;
    text = next.substring(end + 2);
    safety++;
  }

  return text.replace(/^\s+/, '');
}

function getVisibleBio(storedBio) {
  return stripEchoMetadataFromVisibleText(getProfileStyleData(storedBio).bio);
}

function hasUsernameColorCycle(storedBio) {
  return getProfileStyleData(storedBio).nameColor;
}

function usernameColorClass(storedBio) {
  return hasUsernameColorCycle(storedBio) ? ' name-color-cycle' : '';
}

function hasAvatarGlow(storedBio) {
  return getProfileStyleData(storedBio).avatarGlow;
}

function avatarGlowClass(storedBio) {
  return hasAvatarGlow(storedBio) ? ' avatar-glow' : '';
}

function applyAvatarGlow(elementId, storedBio) {
  var el = document.getElementById(elementId);
  if (!el) return;
  el.classList.toggle('avatar-glow', hasAvatarGlow(storedBio));
}

function loadBackendProfileBoxShape(userId, callback) {
  if (!userId || typeof callback !== 'function') return;

  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) {
    callback('');
    return;
  }

  sb.from('profiles')
    .select('box_shape')
    .eq('id', userId)
    .maybeSingle()
    .then(function(res) {
      if (res.error || !res.data) {
        callback('');
        return;
      }

      var shape = res.data.box_shape;
      callback(['square','rounded','bubble'].indexOf(shape) !== -1 ? shape : '');
    });
}

function applyProfileExtras(storedBio, backendBoxShape) {
var style = getProfileStyleData(storedBio || '');
var extras = style.profileExtras || { accentColor:'#0587fc', seasonalEffect:'none', gamingHandles:{}, boxShape:'rounded', cuteHearts:false, pawCorners:false, kittyCorners:false, pastelGlow:false, starSparkles:false };

var hasBackendBoxShape = ['square','rounded','bubble'].indexOf(backendBoxShape) !== -1;
if (hasBackendBoxShape) {
extras.boxShape = backendBoxShape;
extras.boxShapeStored = true;
}
var page = document.getElementById('page-profile');
var box = document.querySelector('#page-profile .profile-page-box');
var profileIsActive = !!(page && page.classList.contains('active'));
var accent = /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/.test(extras.accentColor || '') ? extras.accentColor : '#0587fc';

if (!hasBackendBoxShape && currentUser && (!viewingUserId || viewingUserId === currentUser.id)) {
var metaShape = currentUser.user_metadata
? currentUser.user_metadata.echo_profile_box_shape
: '';

if (['square','rounded','bubble'].indexOf(metaShape) !== -1) {
extras.boxShape = metaShape;
extras.boxShapeStored = true;
} else {
try {
var savedOwnShape = localStorage.getItem('echoProfileBoxShape:' + currentUser.id);
if (['square','rounded','bubble'].indexOf(savedOwnShape) !== -1) {
extras.boxShape = savedOwnShape;
}
} catch(e) {}
}
}

if (page) {
page.style.setProperty('--echo-profile-accent', accent);
page.classList.remove(
'echo-profile-box-square','echo-profile-box-rounded','echo-profile-box-bubble',
'echo-profile-cute-hearts','echo-profile-paw-corners','echo-profile-kitty-corners','echo-profile-pastel-glow','echo-profile-star-sparkles'
);
var boxShape = ['square','rounded','bubble'].indexOf(extras.boxShape) !== -1 ? extras.boxShape : 'rounded';
page.classList.add('echo-profile-box-' + boxShape);
if (extras.cuteHearts === true) page.classList.add('echo-profile-cute-hearts');
if (extras.pawCorners === true) page.classList.add('echo-profile-paw-corners');
if (extras.kittyCorners === true) page.classList.add('echo-profile-kitty-corners');
if (extras.pastelGlow === true) page.classList.add('echo-profile-pastel-glow');
if (extras.starSparkles === true) page.classList.add('echo-profile-star-sparkles');
}

/* Seasonal effects are profile-only, even if Settings is opened elsewhere. */
document.body.classList.remove('echo-profile-season-autumn','echo-profile-season-money');

if (box) {
box.classList.remove('profile-season-snow','profile-season-autumn','profile-season-fireworks','profile-season-bubbles','profile-season-arcade','profile-season-pixel');
var extraBoxEffects = {
snow:'profile-season-snow',

bubbles:'profile-season-bubbles',
arcade:'profile-season-arcade',
pixel:'profile-season-pixel'
};
if (profileIsActive && extraBoxEffects[extras.seasonalEffect]) {
box.classList.add(extraBoxEffects[extras.seasonalEffect]);
}
}

if (profileIsActive && extras.seasonalEffect === 'autumn') {
document.body.classList.add('echo-profile-season-autumn');
}

if (profileIsActive && extras.seasonalEffect === 'money') {
document.body.classList.add('echo-profile-season-money');
}



renderGamingHandles(storedBio);
}

function renderGamingHandles(storedBio) {
  var box = document.getElementById('profile-gaming-handles');
  if (!box) return;

  var style = getProfileStyleData(storedBio || '');
  var extras = style.profileExtras || {};
  var handles = extras.gamingHandles || {};
  var socials = extras.socials || {};

  var gamingRows = [];
  if (handles.xbox) gamingRows.push('<div class="profile-gaming-handle"><strong>Xbox:</strong> ' + adminEscape(handles.xbox) + '</div>');
  if (handles.psn) gamingRows.push('<div class="profile-gaming-handle"><strong>PlayStation:</strong> ' + adminEscape(handles.psn) + '</div>');
  if (handles.steam) gamingRows.push('<div class="profile-gaming-handle"><strong>Steam:</strong> ' + adminEscape(handles.steam) + '</div>');
  if (handles.nintendo) gamingRows.push('<div class="profile-gaming-handle"><strong>Nintendo:</strong> ' + adminEscape(handles.nintendo) + '</div>');

  function socialRow(label, value) {
    var safe = echoSafeHttpUrl(value || '');
    if (!safe) return '';
    return '<div class="profile-gaming-handle"><strong>' + label + ':</strong> <a href="' +
      echoEscapeHtml(safe) +
      '" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" onclick="event.stopPropagation();" style="color:#1da1f2;">Open</a></div>';
  }

  var socialRows = [];
  var yt = socialRow('YouTube', socials.youtube);
  var ig = socialRow('Instagram', socials.instagram);
  var dc = socialRow('Discord', socials.discord);
  var tw = socialRow('Twitch', socials.twitch);

  if (yt) socialRows.push(yt);
  if (ig) socialRows.push(ig);
  if (dc) socialRows.push(dc);
  if (tw) socialRows.push(tw);

  if (!gamingRows.length && !socialRows.length) {
    box.innerHTML = '';
    box.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }

  var html = '';
  if (gamingRows.length) {
    html += '<div class="profile-showcase-group-title">Gaming Handles</div>' + gamingRows.join('');
  }
  if (socialRows.length) {
    html += '<div class="profile-showcase-group-title" style="margin-top:' +
      (gamingRows.length ? '10px' : '0') +
      ';">Socials</div>' + socialRows.join('');
  }

  box.innerHTML = html;
  box.style.display = 'block';
}

function loadFriendAnniversary(userId) {
  var section = document.getElementById('friend-anniversary-section');
  var box = document.getElementById('friend-anniversary');
  if (!section || !box || !currentUser || !userId || userId === currentUser.id) {
    if (section) section.style.display='none';
    return;
  }
  var sb=getSupabase();
  sb.from('follows').select('created_at').eq('follower_id',currentUser.id).eq('following_id',userId).maybeSingle().then(function(a){
    if (a.error || !a.data || !a.data.created_at) { section.style.display='none'; return; }
    sb.from('follows').select('created_at').eq('follower_id',userId).eq('following_id',currentUser.id).maybeSingle().then(function(b){
      if (b.error || !b.data || !b.data.created_at) { section.style.display='none'; return; }
      var da=new Date(a.data.created_at), db=new Date(b.data.created_at);
      var since = da > db ? da : db;
      if (isNaN(since.getTime())) { section.style.display='none'; return; }
      var now=new Date();
      var years=now.getFullYear()-since.getFullYear();
      if (now.getMonth()<since.getMonth() || (now.getMonth()===since.getMonth() && now.getDate()<since.getDate())) years--;
      var dateText=since.toLocaleDateString(undefined,{day:'numeric',month:'short',year:'numeric'});
      var anniversaryToday = now.getMonth()===since.getMonth() && now.getDate()===since.getDate();
      box.innerHTML = (anniversaryToday
        ? '<img src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/partyhat_orig.png" alt="" style="width:18px;height:18px;object-fit:contain;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:5px;"> <strong>Friend anniversary today!</strong><br>'
        : '') +
        'Mutual friends since ' + dateText + (years>0 ? '<br>' + years + ' year' + (years===1?'':'s') + ' together' : '');
      section.style.display='block';
    });
  });
}

function applyExtraProfileEffects(storedBio) {
  var style = getProfileStyleData(storedBio);
  var avatar = document.getElementById('profile-avatar');
  var box = document.querySelector('#page-profile .profile-page-box');
  var name = document.getElementById('profile-name');
  if (avatar) {
    avatar.classList.toggle('avatar-float', !!style.avatarFloat);
    avatar.classList.toggle('avatar-orbit', !!style.avatarOrbit);
  }
  if (box) {
    box.classList.toggle('profile-aura', !!style.profileAura);
    box.classList.toggle('profile-neon-border', !!style.profileNeonBorder);
    box.classList.toggle('profile-shine', !!style.profileShine);
    box.classList.toggle('profile-electric-pulse', !!style.profileElectricPulse);
    var boxAnimations = [];
    if (style.profileAura) boxAnimations.push('echoProfileAura 2.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate');
    if (style.profileNeonBorder) boxAnimations.push('echoProfileNeonBorder 2.2s linear infinite');
    if (style.profileElectricPulse) boxAnimations.push('echoElectricPulse 1.35s steps(2,end) infinite');
    box.style.animation = boxAnimations.join(', ');
    box.style.willChange = boxAnimations.length ? 'filter, border-color, box-shadow' : '';
  }
  if (name) {
    name.classList.toggle('profile-name-glow', !!style.profileNameGlow);
    applyProfileNameStyle('profile-name', storedBio);
  }
}

function setEchoPageBackground(url) {
  var selectors = [
    'html', 'body',
    '#wrapper', '.wrapper',
    '#page-wrap', '.page-wrap',
    '#body-wrap', '.body-wrap',
    '#main-wrap', '.main-wrap',
    '#content-wrap', '.content-wrap',
    '#wsite-content', '.wsite-content-main',
    '.container-wrap',
    '.wsite-wrapper',
    '.wsite-page-index', '#wsite-page-index',
    '.wsite-background', '.wsite-body-background',
    '.wsite-section-wrap', '.wsite-section',
    '.wsite-section-content', '.wsite-section-elements',
    '.wsite-not-footer',
    '#wsite-body', '.wsite-body'
  ];
  var seen = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < selectors.length; i++) {
    var nodes = document.querySelectorAll(selectors[i]);
    for (var j = 0; j < nodes.length; j++) {
      var el = nodes[j];
      if (seen.indexOf(el) !== -1) continue;
      seen.push(el);
      el.style.setProperty('background-color', 'transparent', 'important');
      el.style.setProperty('background-image', "url('" + url + "')", 'important');
      el.style.setProperty('background-repeat', 'no-repeat', 'important');
      el.style.setProperty('background-position', 'center center', 'important');
      el.style.setProperty('background-size', 'cover', 'important');
      el.style.setProperty('background-attachment', 'fixed', 'important');
    }
  }
}

function applyDefaultSiteBackground() {
  setEchoPageBackground(ECHO_PROFILE_BACKGROUNDS[ECHO_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_KEY].url);
}

function applyProfileBackground(storedBio) {
  var style = getProfileStyleData(storedBio);
  var bg = ECHO_PROFILE_BACKGROUNDS[style.backgroundKey] || ECHO_PROFILE_BACKGROUNDS[ECHO_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_KEY];
  setEchoPageBackground(bg.url);
}

applyDefaultSiteBackground();

function selectProfileBackground(key) {
  if (!ECHO_PROFILE_BACKGROUNDS[key]) return;
  selectedProfileBackgroundKey = key;
  var options = document.querySelectorAll('.profile-bg-option');
  for (var i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
    options[i].classList.toggle('selected', options[i].getAttribute('data-bg-key') === key);
  }
}

function renderProfileBackgroundOptions(selectedKey) {
  selectedProfileBackgroundKey = ECHO_PROFILE_BACKGROUNDS[selectedKey] ? selectedKey : ECHO_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_KEY;
  var box = document.getElementById('profile-background-options');
  if (!box) return;
  var html = '';
  var keys = Object.keys(ECHO_PROFILE_BACKGROUNDS);
  for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
    var key = keys[i], bg = ECHO_PROFILE_BACKGROUNDS[key];
    html += '<div class="profile-bg-option' + (key === selectedProfileBackgroundKey ? ' selected' : '') + '" data-bg-key="' + key + '" onclick="selectProfileBackground(\'' + key + '\')">' +
      '<div class="profile-bg-thumb" style="background-image:url(\'' + bg.url + '\');"></div>' +
      '<span class="profile-bg-name">' + bg.name + '</span>' +
      '</div>';
  }
  box.innerHTML = html;
}

function resetProfileBackground() {
  selectedProfileBackgroundKey = ECHO_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_KEY;
  selectProfileBackground(ECHO_DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_KEY);
  saveProfileBackground();
}

function saveProfileBackground() {
  if (!currentUser) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;
  sb.from('profiles').select('bio').eq('id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) { showMessage('Error', res.error.message); return; }
    var style = getProfileStyleData((res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
    var effectivePrivacy = style.privacyStored ? style : privacy;
    var storedBio = buildStoredBio(style.bio, style.moving, style.bioColor, style.nameColor, style.avatarGlow, style.avatarFloat, style.profileAura, style.profileNameGlow, style.profileNeonBorder, style.profileShine, style.profileElectricPulse, style.avatarOrbit, selectedProfileBackgroundKey, style.top8Ids, !!effectivePrivacy.privateProfile, !!effectivePrivacy.hideFavorites, effectivePrivacy.postsVisibility || 'everyone', style.customNameColor, style.showcaseIds, style.locationText, style.showcaseRemoteItems, style.top8BffId, style.profileExtras);
    sb.from('profiles').update({ bio: storedBio }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function(updateRes) {
      if (updateRes.error) { showMessage('Error', updateRes.error.message); return; }
      if (viewingUserId === currentUser.id) applyProfileBackground(storedBio);
      showMessage('Saved', 'Profile background updated.');
    });
  });
}

function applyProfileNameStyle(elementId, storedBio) {
  var el = document.getElementById(elementId);
  if (!el) return;

  var style = getProfileStyleData(storedBio);
  var extras = style.profileExtras || {};
  var letterShuffle = !!extras.letterShuffle;

  if (elementId === 'profile-name') {
    el.setAttribute('data-echo-style-bio', storedBio || '');
    el.classList.toggle('name-letter-shuffle', letterShuffle);

    if (letterShuffle) startProfileNameLetterShuffle(el);
    else stopProfileNameLetterShuffle(el);
  }

  el.classList.toggle('name-color-cycle', !!style.nameColor);

  if (elementId === 'profile-name') {
    if (style.nameColor) {
      /* JS-driven rainbow remains independent from letter shuffle. */
      var animations = [];
      if (style.profileNameGlow) animations.push('echoProfileNameGlow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate');
      if (animations.length) el.style.setProperty('animation', animations.join(', '), 'important');
      else el.style.removeProperty('animation');
      el.style.willChange = style.profileNameGlow ? 'color, text-shadow' : 'color';
      startProfileNameColorCycle(el);
      return;
    }

    stopProfileNameColorCycle();

    if (style.profileNameGlow) {
      el.style.setProperty('animation', 'echoProfileNameGlow 1.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate', 'important');
      el.style.willChange = 'text-shadow';
    } else {
      el.style.removeProperty('animation');
      el.style.willChange = '';
    }
  } else if (style.nameColor) {
    el.style.removeProperty('color');
    return;
  }

  if (style.customNameColor) {
    el.style.setProperty('color', style.customNameColor, 'important');
  } else if (document.body.classList.contains('echo-dark') && elementId === 'profile-name') {
    el.style.setProperty('color', '#ffffff', 'important');
  } else {
    el.style.removeProperty('color');
  }
}

  var profileStyle = getProfileStyleData(storedBio);
  var bio = stripEchoMetadataFromVisibleText(profileStyle.bio) || 'Just joined';

  if (profileStyle.moving && elementId === 'profile-bio') el.classList.add('bio-moving'); else el.classList.remove('bio-moving');
  if (profileStyle.bioColor) el.classList.add('bio-color-cycle'); else el.classList.remove('bio-color-cycle');
}

function saveProfileBoxShapeOnly() {
  if (!currentUser) return;

  var select = document.getElementById('profile-box-shape');
  if (!select) return;

  var chosen = select.value;
  if (['square','rounded','bubble'].indexOf(chosen) === -1) chosen = 'rounded';

  try {
    localStorage.setItem('echoProfileBoxShape:' + currentUser.id, chosen);
  } catch(e) {}

  var page = document.getElementById('page-profile');
  if (page && (!viewingUserId || viewingUserId === currentUser.id)) {
    page.classList.remove('echo-profile-box-square','echo-profile-box-rounded','echo-profile-box-bubble');
    page.classList.add('echo-profile-box-' + chosen);
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;

  sb.from('profiles').select('bio').eq('id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) {
      showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
      return;
    }

    var style = getProfileStyleData((res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
    var extras = style.profileExtras || {};
    extras.boxShape = chosen;
    extras.boxShapeStored = true;

    var storedBio = buildStoredBio(
      style.bio, style.moving, style.bioColor, style.nameColor,
      style.avatarGlow, style.avatarFloat, style.profileAura,
      style.profileNameGlow, style.profileNeonBorder, style.profileShine,
      style.profileElectricPulse, style.avatarOrbit, style.backgroundKey,
      style.top8Ids,
      style.privacyStored ? style.privateProfile : privacy.privateProfile,
      style.privacyStored ? style.hideFavorites : privacy.hideFavorites,
      style.privacyStored ? style.postsVisibility : privacy.postsVisibility,
      style.customNameColor, style.showcaseIds, style.locationText,
      style.showcaseRemoteItems, style.top8BffId, extras
    );

    sb.from('profiles').update({ bio: storedBio }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function(updateRes) {
      if (updateRes.error) {
        showMessage('Error', updateRes.error.message);
        return;
      }

      sb.auth.updateUser({
        data: { echo_profile_box_shape: chosen }
      }).then(function(authRes) {
        if (!authRes.error && authRes.data && authRes.data.user) {
          currentUser = authRes.data.user;
        }
      });

      sb.from('profiles')
        .update({ box_shape: chosen })
        .eq('id', currentUser.id)
        .then(function(shapeRes) {
          if (!shapeRes.error) applyProfileExtras(storedBio, chosen);
        });
    });
  });
}

};

}

var top8Ids = (existingStyle.top8Ids || currentTop8Showcase || []).slice(0, 8);
var bffId = existingStyle.top8BffId || currentTop8BffId || '';

var storedBio = buildStoredBio(

}
function adminEscape(value) {
  return (value == null ? '' : value.toString())
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

function openAdminPanel() {
  if (!isEchoAdmin) {
    showMessage('Admin only', 'You do not have permission to open the Admin Panel.');
    return;
  }
  showPage('admin');
}

function loadAdminPanel() {
  if (!currentUser || !isEchoAdmin) return;
  loadAdminReports();
}

function getAdminReportKey(report) {
  if (report && report.id !== undefined && report.id !== null && report.id !== '') {
    return 'id-' + String(report.id);
  }

  var raw = [
    report && report.reporter_id ? report.reporter_id : '',
    report && report.reported_id ? report.reported_id : '',
    report && report.created_at ? report.created_at : '',
    report && report.reason ? report.reason : ''
  ].join('|');

  var hash = 2166136261;
  for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
    hash ^= raw.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
  }
  return 'legacy-' + (hash >>> 0).toString(16);
}

function loadAdminReports() {
  var box = document.getElementById('admin-reports');
  if (!box || !isEchoAdmin) return;
  box.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">Loading reports...</p>';
  var sb = getSupabase();

  sb.from('reports').select('*').limit(250).then(function(reportRes) {
    if (reportRes.error) { box.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#e0245e;">' + adminEscape(reportRes.error.message) + '</p>'; return; }
    var reports = reportRes.data || [];
    reports.sort(function(a,b){ return new Date(b.created_at||0)-new Date(a.created_at||0); });
    if(!reports.length){ box.innerHTML='<p style="color:#888;">No reports.</p>'; return; }
    var reportCounts={};
    function reportGroupKey(r){var m=(r.reason||'').match(/^\[Post ID ([^\]]+)\]/);return m?'post:'+m[1]:'profile:'+r.reported_id;}
    reports.forEach(function(r){var k=reportGroupKey(r);reportCounts[k]=(reportCounts[k]||0)+1;});
    reports=reports.filter(function(r){return reportCounts[reportGroupKey(r)]>=10;});
    if(!reports.length){box.innerHTML='<p style="color:#888;">No reports have reached 10 yet.</p>';return;}

    var userIds=[], postIds=[], reportIds=[];
    reports.forEach(function(r){
      if(r.reported_id && userIds.indexOf(r.reported_id)===-1) userIds.push(r.reported_id);
      if(r.reporter_id && userIds.indexOf(r.reporter_id)===-1) userIds.push(r.reporter_id);
      reportIds.push(getAdminReportKey(r));
      var match=(r.reason||'').match(/^\[Post ID ([^\]]+)\]/);
      if(match && postIds.indexOf(match[1])===-1) postIds.push(match[1]);
    });

    var profilesMap={}, postsMap={}, metaMap={};
    var pending=2+(postIds.length?1:0);
    function done(){ pending--; if(pending>0) return; render(); }
    function render(){
      var html='';
      reports.forEach(function(r){
        var target=profilesMap[r.reported_id]||{}, reporter=profilesMap[r.reporter_id]||{};
        var postMatch=(r.reason||'').match(/^\[Post ID ([^\]]+)\]/), postId=postMatch?postMatch[1]:null;
        var post=postId?(postsMap[postId]||{}):null;
        var reportKey=getAdminReportKey(r);
        var meta=metaMap[reportKey]||{status:'open',note:''};
        var targetName=target.display_name||target.username||r.reported_id||'Unknown';
        var reporterName=reporter.display_name||reporter.username||r.reporter_id||'Unknown';
        html += '<div class="admin-report-card">' +
          '<div><strong>'+(postId?'Echo report':'Profile report')+'</strong></div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:4px;">Target: '+adminEscape(targetName)+(target.username?' (@'+adminEscape(target.username)+')':'')+'</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:12px;">Reporter: '+adminEscape(reporterName)+'</div>' +
          (postId?'<div style="font-size:12px;">Post ID: '+adminEscape(postId)+'</div>':'') +
          (post&&post.text?'<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:5px;"><strong>Post:</strong> '+adminEscape(post.text)+'</div>':'') +
          '<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:5px;"><strong>Reason:</strong> '+adminEscape(r.reason||'')+'</div>' +
          (r.created_at?'<div style="font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-top:4px;">'+adminEscape(new Date(r.created_at).toLocaleString())+'</div>':'') +
          '<div class="admin-report-status"><strong style="font-size:11px;">Status</strong>' +
          '<select onchange="adminSetReportStatus(\''+adminEscape(reportKey)+'\',this.value)">' +
          ['open','reviewing','resolved','dismissed'].map(function(s){ return '<option value="'+s+'"'+(meta.status===s?' selected':'')+'>'+s.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+s.slice(1)+'</option>'; }).join('') +
          '</select></div>' +
          '<textarea class="admin-note-box" id="admin-report-note-'+adminEscape(reportKey)+'" placeholder="Private admin note">'+adminEscape(meta.note||'')+'</textarea>' +
          '<div class="admin-actions">' +
          '<button onclick="adminSaveReportNote(\''+adminEscape(reportKey)+'\')">Save note</button>' +
          '<button onclick="viewProfile(\''+adminEscape(r.reported_id)+'\')">View profile</button>' +
          '<button onclick="adminWarnUser(\''+adminEscape(r.reported_id)+'\')">Warn</button>' +
          '<button onclick="adminBanUser(\''+adminEscape(r.reported_id)+'\')">Ban</button>' +
          '<button onclick="adminSuspendUser(\''+adminEscape(r.reported_id)+'\',1)">Suspend 1 day</button>' +
          '<button onclick="adminSuspendUser(\''+adminEscape(r.reported_id)+'\',7)">Suspend 7 days</button>' +
          (postId?'<button style="color:#e0245e;" onclick="adminDeletePost(\''+adminEscape(postId)+'\')">Delete post</button>':'') +
          '</div></div>';
      });
      box.innerHTML=html;
    }

    sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url').in('id',userIds).then(function(res){ (res.data||[]).forEach(function(p){profilesMap[p.id]=p;}); done(); });
    if(postIds.length) sb.from('posts').select('id,text,user_id,created_at').in('id',postIds).then(function(res){ (res.data||[]).forEach(function(p){postsMap[p.id]=p;}); done(); });
    sb.rpc('echo_admin_get_report_meta', { p_report_ids: reportIds }).then(function(res){
      if (!res.error) {
        (res.data || []).forEach(function(m){ metaMap[String(m.report_id)] = m; });
      }
      done();
    });
  });
}

function adminSetReportStatus(reportId, status) {
  if (!isEchoAdmin) return;
  if (['open','reviewing','resolved','dismissed'].indexOf(status) === -1) return;

  getSupabase().rpc('echo_admin_save_report_meta', {
    p_report_id: String(reportId),
    p_status: status,
    p_note: null
  }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) {
      showMessage('Admin error', res.error.message);
      loadAdminReports();
      return;
    }
    showMessage('Saved', 'Report status updated.');
  });
}
function adminSaveReportNote(reportId) {
  if (!isEchoAdmin) return;
  var el = document.getElementById('admin-report-note-' + reportId);

    p_report_id: String(reportId),
    p_status: null,

  }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) {
      showMessage('Admin error', res.error.message);
      return;
    }
    showMessage('Saved', 'Report admin note saved.');
  });
}

function openAdminActionModal(action, targetId, extra) {
  if (!isEchoAdmin || !targetId) return;

  var title = 'Admin Action';
  var description = '';
  var placeholder = '';
  var showInput = false;
  var confirmLabel = 'Confirm';

  if (action === 'warn') {
    title = 'Issue Warning';
    description = 'Send an official warning to this account. The warning will also appear in their Echo notifications.';
    placeholder = 'Warning message shown to the user';
    showInput = true;
    confirmLabel = 'Send Warning';
  } else if (action === 'ban') {
    title = 'Ban Account';
    description = 'Ban this account from Echo. You can optionally include a reason.';
    placeholder = 'Ban reason (optional)';
    showInput = true;
    confirmLabel = 'Ban Account';
  } else if (action === 'suspend') {
    title = 'Suspend Account';
    description = 'Suspend this account for ' + extra + ' day' + (extra === 1 ? '' : 's') + '. You can optionally include a reason.';
    placeholder = 'Suspension reason (optional)';
    showInput = true;
    confirmLabel = 'Suspend Account';
  } else if (action === 'unban') {
    title = 'Unban Account';
    description = 'Remove the ban from this account?';
    confirmLabel = 'Unban';
  } else if (action === 'clear-suspension') {
    title = 'Clear Suspension';
    description = 'Remove the current suspension from this account?';
    confirmLabel = 'Clear Suspension';
  } else if (action === 'make-admin') {
    title = 'Make Admin';
    description = 'Give this account Echo admin access?';
    confirmLabel = 'Make Admin';
  } else if (action === 'remove-admin') {
    title = 'Remove Admin';
    description = 'Remove Echo admin access from this account?';
    confirmLabel = 'Remove Admin';
  } else if (action === 'delete-post') {
    title = 'Delete Echo';
    description = 'Permanently delete this reported Echo? This cannot be undone.';
    confirmLabel = 'Delete Echo';
  } else {
    return;
  }

  pendingAdminAction = {
    action: action,
    targetId: targetId,
    extra: extra || null
  };

  var input = document.getElementById('admin-action-input');
  var error = document.getElementById('admin-action-error');
  document.getElementById('admin-action-title').textContent = title;
  document.getElementById('admin-action-description').textContent = description;
  document.getElementById('admin-action-confirm-btn').textContent = confirmLabel;

  input.value = '';
  input.placeholder = placeholder;
  input.style.display = showInput ? 'block' : 'none';

  error.textContent = '';
  error.style.display = 'none';

  document.getElementById('admin-action-modal').style.display = 'flex';

  if (showInput) {
    setTimeout(function() { input.focus(); }, 40);
  }
}

function closeAdminActionModal() {
  pendingAdminAction = null;
  var modal = document.getElementById('admin-action-modal');
  if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
}

function confirmAdminActionModal() {
  if (!pendingAdminAction || !isEchoAdmin) return;

  var action = pendingAdminAction;
  var input = document.getElementById('admin-action-input');
  var value = (input && input.style.display !== 'none') ? (input.value || '').trim() : '';
  var error = document.getElementById('admin-action-error');

  if (action.action === 'warn' && !value) {
    error.textContent = 'Enter a warning message.';
    error.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }

  closeAdminActionModal();

  if (action.action === 'warn') performAdminWarnUser(action.targetId, value);
  else if (action.action === 'ban') performAdminBanUser(action.targetId, value);
  else if (action.action === 'suspend') performAdminSuspendUser(action.targetId, action.extra, value);
  else if (action.action === 'unban') performAdminUnbanUser(action.targetId);
  else if (action.action === 'clear-suspension') performAdminClearSuspension(action.targetId);
  else if (action.action === 'make-admin') performAdminMakeAdmin(action.targetId);
  else if (action.action === 'remove-admin') performAdminRemoveAdmin(action.targetId);
  else if (action.action === 'delete-post') performAdminDeletePost(action.targetId);
}

function adminWarnUser(userId) {
  if (!isEchoAdmin || !userId || userId === currentUser.id) return;
  openAdminActionModal('warn', userId);
}

function performAdminWarnUser(userId, message) {
  getSupabase().from('admin_warnings').insert({
    user_id: userId,
    message: (message || '').trim().substring(0,1000),
    created_by: currentUser.id
  }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) {
      showMessage('Admin', 'Run the supplied moderation backend update to issue warnings.');
      return;
    }
    showMessage('Warning sent', 'The user will see this official warning in their notifications and warning modal.');
    adminSearchUsers();
  });
}

function adminSearchUsers() {
  if (!isEchoAdmin) return;
  var input=document.getElementById('admin-user-search'), box=document.getElementById('admin-user-results');
  var q=(input.value||'').trim().replace(/^@/,'');
  if(!q){ box.innerHTML='<p style="color:#888;">Enter a username.</p>'; return; }
  box.innerHTML='<p style="color:#888;">Searching...</p>';
  var sb=getSupabase();
  sb.from('profiles').select('id,username,display_name,avatar_url').ilike('username','%'+q+'%').limit(20).then(function(res){
    if(res.error){ box.innerHTML='<p style="color:#e0245e;">'+adminEscape(res.error.message)+'</p>'; return; }
    var users=res.data||[]; if(!users.length){box.innerHTML='<p style="color:#888;">No matching accounts.</p>';return;}
    var ids=users.map(function(u){return u.id;}), adminSet={}, moderationMap={}, notesMap={}, warningCount={};
    var pending=4;
    function done(){ pending--; if(pending>0)return; render(); }
    function render(){
      var html='';
      users.forEach(function(u){
        var m=moderationMap[u.id]||{}, status=adminSet[u.id]?'Admin':'User';
        if(m.banned) status+=' · BANNED'; else if(m.suspended_until&&new Date(m.suspended_until)>new Date()) status+=' · Suspended until '+new Date(m.suspended_until).toLocaleString();
        html+='<div class="admin-user-card"><strong>'+adminEscape(u.display_name||u.username||'user')+'</strong> <span class="screen-name">@'+adminEscape(u.username||'user')+'</span>' +
          '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-top:3px;">'+adminEscape(status)+'</div>' +
          '<div class="admin-warning-count">Warnings issued: '+(warningCount[u.id]||0)+'</div>' +
          '<textarea class="admin-note-box" id="admin-user-note-'+u.id+'" placeholder="Private admin note about this account">'+adminEscape(notesMap[u.id]||'')+'</textarea>' +
          '<div class="admin-actions"><button onclick="adminSaveUserNote(\''+u.id+'\')">Save note</button><button onclick="viewProfile(\''+u.id+'\')">View profile</button>' +
          (adminSet[u.id]?(u.id===currentUser.id?'':'<button onclick="adminRemoveAdmin(\''+u.id+'\')">Remove admin</button>'):'<button onclick="adminMakeAdmin(\''+u.id+'\')">Make admin</button>') +
          '<button onclick="adminWarnUser(\''+u.id+'\')">Warn</button>' +
          (m.banned?'<button onclick="adminUnbanUser(\''+u.id+'\')">Unban</button>':'<button onclick="adminBanUser(\''+u.id+'\')">Ban</button>') +
          '<button onclick="adminSuspendUser(\''+u.id+'\',1)">Suspend 1 day</button><button onclick="adminSuspendUser(\''+u.id+'\',7)">Suspend 7 days</button><button onclick="adminClearSuspension(\''+u.id+'\')">Clear suspension</button></div></div>';
      });
      box.innerHTML=html;
    }
    sb.from('echo_admins').select('user_id').in('user_id',ids).then(function(r){(r.data||[]).forEach(function(x){adminSet[x.user_id]=true;});done();});
    sb.from('account_moderation').select('user_id,banned,suspended_until,reason').in('user_id',ids).then(function(r){(r.data||[]).forEach(function(x){moderationMap[x.user_id]=x;});done();});
    sb.rpc('echo_admin_get_user_notes', { p_user_ids: ids }).then(function(r){
      if (!r.error) (r.data || []).forEach(function(x){ notesMap[x.user_id] = x.note || ''; });
      done();
    });
    sb.from('admin_warnings').select('user_id').in('user_id',ids).then(function(r){if(!r.error)(r.data||[]).forEach(function(x){warningCount[x.user_id]=(warningCount[x.user_id]||0)+1;});done();});
  });
}

function performAdminBanUser(userId, reason) {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('account_moderation').upsert({
    user_id: userId,
    banned: true,
    suspended_until: null,
    reason: reason || '',
    updated_by: currentUser.id,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }, { onConflict: 'user_id' }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) { showMessage('Error', res.error.message); return; }
    showMessage('Banned', 'Account banned.');
    adminSearchUsers();
  });
}

function adminUnbanUser(userId) {
  if (!isEchoAdmin || !userId) return;
  openAdminActionModal('unban', userId);
}

  sb.from('account_moderation').upsert({
    user_id: userId,
    banned: false,
    suspended_until: null,
    reason: '',
    updated_by: currentUser.id,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }, { onConflict: 'user_id' }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) { showMessage('Error', res.error.message); return; }
    showMessage('Unbanned', 'Account unbanned.');
    adminSearchUsers();
  });
}

function adminSuspendUser(userId, days) {
  if (!isEchoAdmin || !userId || userId === currentUser.id) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();

  sb.from('admin_warnings')
    .select('id', { count:'exact', head:true })
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .then(function(w) {
      if (w.error) {
        showMessage('Admin', 'Run the supplied moderation backend update before suspending accounts.');
        return;
      }
      if (!w.count) {
        showMessage('Warning required', 'Issue at least one warning before suspending this account.');
        return;
      }
      openAdminActionModal('suspend', userId, days);
    });
}

function performAdminSuspendUser(userId, days, reason) {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var until = new Date(Date.now() + (days * 86400000)).toISOString();

  sb.from('account_moderation').upsert({
    user_id: userId,
    banned: false,
    suspended_until: until,
    reason: reason || '',
    updated_by: currentUser.id,
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString()
  }, { onConflict:'user_id' }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) { showMessage('Error',res.error.message); return; }
    showMessage('Suspended','Account suspended for '+days+' day'+(days===1?'':'s')+'.');
    adminSearchUsers();
  });
}
