function showProfileTab(tab, suppressBrowserHistory) {
  currentProfileTab = tab;
  if (viewingUserId) {
    rememberEchoPage('profile');
    if (!suppressBrowserHistory) {
      echoReplaceBrowserState({
        echoPage:'profile',
        profileUserId:viewingUserId,
        profileTab:tab
      });
    }
  }

  if (tab !== 'top8' && profileTop8ActivityTimer) {
    clearInterval(profileTop8ActivityTimer);
    profileTop8ActivityTimer = null;
  }

  document.getElementById('tab-echos').className = tab === 'echos' ? 'active' : '';
  document.getElementById('tab-favorites').className = tab === 'favorites' ? 'active' : '';
  document.getElementById('tab-comments').className = tab === 'comments' ? 'active' : '';
  document.getElementById('tab-top8').className = tab === 'top8' ? 'active' : '';
  if (!viewingProfileContentAllowed && viewingUserId !== currentUser.id) {
    document.getElementById('profile-timeline').innerHTML = '<p style="padding:14px 0;color:#888;">This profile is private or its Echos are limited to approved followers.</p>';
    return;
  }
  if (tab === 'favorites') {
    if (viewingProfilePrivacy.hideFavorites && viewingUserId !== currentUser.id) { document.getElementById('profile-timeline').innerHTML = '<p>Favorites are private.</p>'; return; }
    loadFavorites();
  } else if (tab === 'comments') {
    loadProfileComments();
  } else if (tab === 'top8') {
    loadProfileTop8(viewingUserId || currentUser.id);
  } else if (viewingUserId) loadUserPosts(viewingUserId, viewingAvatarUrl);
}

function top8Escape(value) {
  return (value == null ? '' : value.toString())
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

function renderTop8Cards(profiles, editable, bffId, top8Notes) {
  var html = '<div class="profile-top8-grid profile-top8-ranked-list">';
  top8Notes = top8Notes || {};

  for (var i = 0; i < profiles.length; i++) {
    var p = profiles[i];
    var name = p.display_name || p.username || 'user';
    var handle = p.username || 'user';
    var av = p.avatar_url || 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/friend_orig.png';
    var check = p.verified ? ' <img class="verified-check" src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/31311_orig.png" alt="">' : '';
    var isBff = !!bffId && p.id === bffId;
    var note = (top8Notes[p.id] || '').toString().trim().substring(0, 60);
    var joinedText = 'Joined Echo';

    if (p.created_at) {
      var joinedDate = new Date(p.created_at);
      if (!isNaN(joinedDate.getTime())) {
        var joinedMonths = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
        joinedText = 'Joined Echo<br>' + joinedMonths[joinedDate.getMonth()] + ' ' + joinedDate.getFullYear();
      }
    }

    html += '<div class="profile-top8-card' + (isBff ? ' top8-bff' : '') + '" data-top8-user-id="' + top8Escape(p.id) + '">' +
      '<span class="profile-top8-rank">#' + (i + 1) + '</span>' +
      '<div class="profile-top8-avatar" style="background-image:url(&quot;' + top8Escape(av) + '&quot;);" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + p.id + '\')"></div>' +
      '<span class="profile-top8-name" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + p.id + '\')">' + top8Escape(name) + check + '<span class="profile-top8-online-slot"></span></span>' +
      '<span class="profile-top8-handle">@' + top8Escape(handle) + '</span>' +
      '<span class="profile-top8-joined">' + joinedText + '</span>' +
      (isBff ? '<span class="profile-top8-bff-badge">♥ BFF ♥</span>' : '') +
      (editable
        ? '<input class="profile-top8-note-input" type="text" maxlength="60" value="' + top8Escape(note) +
            '" placeholder="Add a short note..." data-top8-note-user="' + top8Escape(p.id) + '">' +
          '<div class="profile-top8-edit-controls">' +
            '<button type="button" class="profile-top8-note-save" onclick="saveProfileTop8NoteFromCard(\'' + p.id + '\',this)">Save text</button>' +
            '<div class="profile-top8-order">' +
              '<button type="button" title="Move earlier" aria-label="Move earlier" onclick="moveProfileTop8(\'' + p.id + '\',-1)">◀</button>' +
              '<button type="button" title="Move later" aria-label="Move later" onclick="moveProfileTop8(\'' + p.id + '\',1)">▶</button>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<button class="profile-top8-bff-btn" onclick="toggleProfileTop8Bff(\'' + p.id + '\')">' +
              (isBff ? 'Remove BFF' : 'Make BFF') +
            '</button>' +
            '<button class="profile-top8-action profile-top8-remove" onclick="removeFromProfileTop8(\'' + p.id + '\')">Remove</button>' +
          '</div>'
        : (note ? '<span class="profile-top8-note">' + top8Escape(note) + '</span>' : '')) +
      '</div>';
  }

  html += '</div>';
  return html;
}

function loadProfileTop8Activity(ids) {
  var box = document.getElementById('profile-top8-activity');
  var sb = getSupabase();

  if (!box || !sb || !currentUser || !ids || !ids.length) return;

  var cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - 35000).toISOString();

  sb.from('room_presence')
    .select('user_id,last_seen')
    .in('user_id', ids)
    .gte('last_seen', cutoff)
    .then(function(res) {
      if (!document.getElementById('profile-top8-activity')) return;

      var active = {};
      if (!res.error && res.data) {
        for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
          var row = res.data[i];
          if (row.user_id && row.last_seen && new Date(row.last_seen).getTime() >= Date.now() - 35000) {
            active[row.user_id] = true;
          }
        }
      }

      var count = Object.keys(active).length;
      var activityBox = document.getElementById('profile-top8-activity');

      if (activityBox) {
        activityBox.innerHTML =
          (count > 0 ? '<span class="profile-top8-activity-dot"></span>' : '') +
          '<span>' +
          (count === 1
            ? '1 of your Top 8 active now'
            : count + ' of your Top 8 active now') +
          '</span>';
      }

      var cards = document.querySelectorAll('#profile-timeline .profile-top8-card[data-top8-user-id]');
      for (var j = 0; j < cards.length; j++) {
        var card = cards[j];
        var id = card.getAttribute('data-top8-user-id');
        var slot = card.querySelector('.profile-top8-online-slot');
        if (!slot) continue;
        slot.innerHTML = active[id]
          ? '<span class="profile-top8-card-online-dot" title="Active now"></span>'
          : '';
      }
    });
}

function startProfileTop8Activity(ids) {
  if (profileTop8ActivityTimer) {
    clearInterval(profileTop8ActivityTimer);
    profileTop8ActivityTimer = null;
  }

  if (!ids || !ids.length || !currentUser) return;

  loadProfileTop8Activity(ids);

  profileTop8ActivityTimer = setInterval(function() {
    if (currentProfileTab !== 'top8' ||
        !viewingUserId ||
        viewingUserId !== currentUser.id) {
      clearInterval(profileTop8ActivityTimer);
      profileTop8ActivityTimer = null;
      return;
    }

    loadProfileTop8Activity(ids);
  }, 15000);
}

function loadProfileTop8(userId) {
  var timeline = document.getElementById('profile-timeline');
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!timeline || !sb || !userId) return;
  timeline.innerHTML = '<p>Loading Top 8...</p>';

  sb.from('profiles').select('bio').eq('id', userId).maybeSingle().then(function(profileRes) {
    var style = getProfileStyleData((profileRes.data && profileRes.data.bio) ? profileRes.data.bio : '');
    var ids = (style.top8Ids || []).slice(0, 8);
    var bffId = style.top8BffId || '';
    var top8Notes = (style.profileExtras && style.profileExtras.top8Notes) ? style.profileExtras.top8Notes : {};
    var isOwn = currentUser && userId === currentUser.id;
    if (isOwn) {
      currentTop8Showcase = ids.slice();
      currentTop8BffId = bffId;
      currentTop8Notes = Object.assign({}, top8Notes || {});
    }

    function finishShowcase(selectedProfiles) {
      var html = '<div style="padding:4px 0 2px;"><h3 style="margin:0 0 4px;">Top 8</h3><p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;margin:0;">' +
        (isOwn ? 'Showcase up to 8 mutual follows. Use ◀ ▶ to put them in the order you want.' : 'People this user has chosen for their Top 8.') +
        '</p>' +
        (isOwn && ids.length
          ? '<div id="profile-top8-activity" class="profile-top8-activity"><span>Checking Top 8 activity...</span></div>'
          : '') +
        '</div>';

      if (selectedProfiles.length) html += renderTop8Cards(selectedProfiles, isOwn, bffId, top8Notes);
      else html += '<p style="color:#888;padding:12px 0;">No one has been added to Top 8 yet.</p>';

      if (!isOwn) {
        timeline.innerHTML = html;
        return;
      }

      timeline.innerHTML = html + '<div class="profile-top8-manager"><h4 style="margin:0 0 4px;">Add mutual follows</h4><div id="profile-top8-eligible"><p style="color:#888;">Loading...</p></div></div>';
      if (ids.length) startProfileTop8Activity(ids);
      loadEligibleTop8Mutuals(ids);
    }

    if (!ids.length) {
      if (profileTop8ActivityTimer) {
        clearInterval(profileTop8ActivityTimer);
        profileTop8ActivityTimer = null;
      }
      finishShowcase([]);
      return;
    }

    sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified, created_at').in('id', ids).then(function(res) {
      var map = {};
      var rows = res.data || [];
      for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) map[rows[i].id] = rows[i];
      var ordered = [];
      for (var j = 0; j < ids.length; j++) if (map[ids[j]]) ordered.push(map[ids[j]]);
      finishShowcase(ordered);
    });
  });
}

function loadEligibleTop8Mutuals(selectedIds) {
  var box = document.getElementById('profile-top8-eligible');
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!box || !sb || !currentUser) return;

  if ((selectedIds || []).length >= 8) {
    box.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">Your Top 8 is full. Remove someone to add another person.</p>';
    return;
  }

  sb.from('follows').select('following_id').eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).then(function(followingRes) {
    var followingIds = (followingRes.data || []).map(function(row) { return row.following_id; });
    if (!followingIds.length) {
      box.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">No mutual follows available.</p>';
      return;
    }

    sb.from('follows').select('follower_id').eq('following_id', currentUser.id).in('follower_id', followingIds).then(function(backRes) {
      var mutualIds = (backRes.data || []).map(function(row) { return row.follower_id; }).filter(function(id) {
        return (selectedIds || []).indexOf(id) === -1;
      });

      if (!mutualIds.length) {
        box.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">No more mutual follows available.</p>';
        return;
      }

      sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified').in('id', mutualIds).limit(40).then(function(profileRes) {
        var profiles = profileRes.data || [];
        var html = '<div class="profile-top8-grid">';
        for (var i = 0; i < profiles.length; i++) {
          var p = profiles[i];
          var name = p.display_name || p.username || 'user';
          var handle = p.username || 'user';
          var av = p.avatar_url || 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/friend_orig.png';
          html += '<div class="profile-top8-card">' +
            '<div class="profile-top8-avatar" style="background-image:url(&quot;' + top8Escape(av) + '&quot;);" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + p.id + '\')"></div>' +
            '<span class="profile-top8-name" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + p.id + '\')">' + top8Escape(name) + '</span>' +
            '<span class="profile-top8-handle">@' + top8Escape(handle) + '</span>' +
            '<button class="profile-top8-action profile-top8-add" onclick="addToProfileTop8(\'' + p.id + '\')">Add</button>' +
            '</div>';
        }
        html += '</div>';
        box.innerHTML = html;
      });
    });
  });
}

function saveProfileTop8Ids(ids) {
  if (!currentUser) return;
  ids = (ids || []).slice(0, 8);
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('profiles').select('bio').eq('id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) { showMessage('Error', res.error.message); return; }
    var style = getProfileStyleData((res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
    var bffId = currentTop8BffId || '';
    if (ids.indexOf(bffId) === -1) bffId = '';
    currentTop8BffId = bffId;

    var top8Extras = style.profileExtras || {};
    var existingTop8Notes = top8Extras.top8Notes || {};
    var keptTop8Notes = {};
    Object.keys(existingTop8Notes).forEach(function(noteUserId) {
      if (ids.indexOf(noteUserId) !== -1) {
        var keptNote = (existingTop8Notes[noteUserId] || '').toString().trim().substring(0, 60);
        if (keptNote) keptTop8Notes[noteUserId] = keptNote;
      }
    });
    top8Extras.top8Notes = keptTop8Notes;

    var storedBio = buildStoredBio(
      style.bio, style.moving, style.bioColor, style.nameColor,
      style.avatarGlow, style.avatarFloat, style.profileAura,
      style.profileNameGlow, style.profileNeonBorder, style.profileShine,
      style.profileElectricPulse, style.avatarOrbit, style.backgroundKey, ids,
      style.privacyStored ? style.privateProfile : privacy.privateProfile,
      style.privacyStored ? style.hideFavorites : privacy.hideFavorites,
      style.privacyStored ? style.postsVisibility : privacy.postsVisibility,
      style.customNameColor, style.showcaseIds, style.locationText,
      style.showcaseRemoteItems, bffId, top8Extras
    );
    sb.from('profiles').update({ bio: storedBio }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function(updateRes) {
      if (updateRes.error) { showMessage('Error', updateRes.error.message); return; }
      currentTop8Showcase = ids.slice();
      if (viewingUserId === currentUser.id && currentProfileTab === 'top8') loadProfileTop8(currentUser.id);
    });
  });
}

function toggleProfileTop8Bff(userId) {
  if (!currentUser || currentTop8Showcase.indexOf(userId) === -1) return;
  currentTop8BffId = currentTop8BffId === userId ? '' : userId;
  saveProfileTop8Bff();
}

function saveProfileTop8Bff() {
  if (!currentUser) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();

  sb.from('profiles').select('bio').eq('id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) { showMessage('Error', res.error.message); return; }

    var style = getProfileStyleData((res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
    var ids = (style.top8Ids || []).slice(0, 8);
    var bffId = currentTop8BffId;
    if (ids.indexOf(bffId) === -1) bffId = '';

    var storedBio = buildStoredBio(
      style.bio, style.moving, style.bioColor, style.nameColor,
      style.avatarGlow, style.avatarFloat, style.profileAura,
      style.profileNameGlow, style.profileNeonBorder, style.profileShine,
      style.profileElectricPulse, style.avatarOrbit, style.backgroundKey, ids,
      style.privacyStored ? style.privateProfile : privacy.privateProfile,
      style.privacyStored ? style.hideFavorites : privacy.hideFavorites,
      style.privacyStored ? style.postsVisibility : privacy.postsVisibility,
      style.customNameColor, style.showcaseIds, style.locationText,
      style.showcaseRemoteItems, bffId, style.profileExtras
    );

    sb.from('profiles').update({ bio: storedBio }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function(updateRes) {
      if (updateRes.error) { showMessage('Error', updateRes.error.message); return; }
      currentTop8BffId = bffId;
      if (viewingUserId === currentUser.id && currentProfileTab === 'top8') loadProfileTop8(currentUser.id);
    });
  });
}

function addToProfileTop8(userId) {
  if (!currentUser || !userId) return;
  if (currentTop8Showcase.indexOf(userId) !== -1) return;
  if (currentTop8Showcase.length >= 8) { showMessage('Top 8', 'Your Top 8 is already full.'); return; }

  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('follows').select('following_id').eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).eq('following_id', userId).maybeSingle().then(function(a) {
    if (!a.data) { showMessage('Top 8', 'You can only add people you follow.'); return; }
    sb.from('follows').select('follower_id').eq('follower_id', userId).eq('following_id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle().then(function(b) {
      if (!b.data) { showMessage('Top 8', 'They must follow you back before you can add them.'); return; }
      var ids = currentTop8Showcase.slice();
      ids.push(userId);
      saveProfileTop8Ids(ids);
    });
  });
}

function saveProfileTop8NoteFromCard(userId, button) {
  if (!userId || !button) return;
  var card = button.closest ? button.closest('.profile-top8-card') : null;
  var input = card ? card.querySelector('.profile-top8-note-input') : null;
  if (!input) return;
  saveProfileTop8Note(userId, input.value, button);
}

function saveProfileTop8Note(userId, value, button) {
  if (!currentUser || !userId) return;

  var note = (value || '').toString().trim().substring(0, 60);
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;

  sb.from('profiles').select('bio').eq('id', currentUser.id).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) {
      showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
      return;
    }

    var style = getProfileStyleData((res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
    var extras = style.profileExtras || {};
    var notes = {};

    if (extras.top8Notes && typeof extras.top8Notes === 'object') {
      Object.keys(extras.top8Notes).forEach(function(id) {
        var existingNote = (extras.top8Notes[id] || '').toString().trim().substring(0, 60);
        if (existingNote) notes[id] = existingNote;
      });
    }

    if (note) notes[userId] = note;
    else delete notes[userId];

    extras.top8Notes = notes;

    var storedBio = buildStoredBio(
      style.bio, style.moving, style.bioColor, style.nameColor,
      style.avatarGlow, style.avatarFloat, style.profileAura,
      style.profileNameGlow, style.profileNeonBorder, style.profileShine,
      style.profileElectricPulse, style.avatarOrbit, style.backgroundKey,
      style.top8Ids,
      style.privacyStored ? style.privateProfile : privacy.privateProfile,
      style.privacyStored ? style.hideFavorites : privacy.hideFavorites,
      style.privacyStored ? style.postsVisibility : privacy.postsVisibility,
      style.customNameColor, style.showcaseIds, style.locationText,
      style.showcaseRemoteItems, style.top8BffId, extras
    );

    sb.from('profiles').update({ bio: storedBio }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function(updateRes) {
      if (updateRes.error) {
        showMessage('Error', updateRes.error.message);
        return;
      }

      if (button) {
        var oldText = button.textContent;
        button.textContent = 'Saved ✓';
        setTimeout(function() {
          if (button) button.textContent = oldText || 'Save text';
        }, 1200);
      }
    });
  });
}

function moveProfileTop8(userId, direction) {
  if (!currentUser || !userId) return;

  var ids = currentTop8Showcase.slice();
  var from = ids.indexOf(userId);
  if (from === -1) return;

  var to = from + (direction < 0 ? -1 : 1);
  if (to < 0 || to >= ids.length) return;

  var moved = ids.splice(from, 1)[0];
  ids.splice(to, 0, moved);

  currentTop8Showcase = ids.slice();
  saveProfileTop8Ids(ids);
}

function removeFromProfileTop8(userId) {
  if (!currentUser || !userId) return;
  if (currentTop8BffId === userId) currentTop8BffId = '';
  var ids = currentTop8Showcase.filter(function(id) { return id !== userId; });
  saveProfileTop8Ids(ids);
}

function loadFavorites() {
  var timeline = document.getElementById('profile-timeline'), sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('favorites').select('*').eq('user_id', viewingUserId || currentUser.id).then(function(favs) {
    var favoriteRows = favs.data || [];
    var favoriteTimes = {};
    for (var fi = 0; fi < favoriteRows.length; fi++) {
      var fr = favoriteRows[fi];
      favoriteTimes[fr.post_id] = fr.created_at || fr.favorited_at || fr.inserted_at || favActivityTimes[fr.post_id] || null;
    }
    var ids = favoriteRows.map(function(f) { return f.post_id; });
    if (ids.length === 0) { timeline.innerHTML = '<p>No favorites yet.</p>'; return; }
    sb.from('posts').select('id, text, created_at, user_id').in('id', ids).then(function(res) {
      if (res.error || !res.data) { timeline.innerHTML = '<p>No favorites yet.</p>'; return; }
      res.data.sort(function(a, b) {
        var aTime = favoriteTimes[a.id] || favActivityTimes[a.id] || a.created_at;
        var bTime = favoriteTimes[b.id] || favActivityTimes[b.id] || b.created_at;
        return new Date(bTime).getTime() - new Date(aTime).getTime();
      });
      var userIds = [];
      var postIds = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
        if (userIds.indexOf(res.data[i].user_id) === -1) userIds.push(res.data[i].user_id);
        postIds.push(res.data[i].id);
      }
      sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified, bio').in('id', userIds).then(function(prof) {
        var map = {};
        if (prof.data) for (var j = 0; j < prof.data.length; j++) {
          var pd = prof.data[j]; map[pd.id] = { username: pd.username || 'user', display_name: pd.display_name || pd.username || 'user', avatar: pd.avatar_url, verified: !!pd.verified, bio: pd.bio || '' };
        }
        var counts = {};
        var done = 0;
        function finish() {
          done++;
          if (done < 3) return;
          var html = '';
          for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
            var p = res.data[i], u = map[p.user_id] || { username: 'user', display_name: 'user', avatar: null, verified: false };
            var av = u.avatar ? "url('" + u.avatar + "')" : "url('https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/friend_orig.png')";
            html += renderTweet(p, u, av, false, counts[p.id] || {});
          }
          timeline.innerHTML = html || '<p>No favorites yet.</p>';
        }
        if (postIds.length === 0) { finish(); finish(); finish(); return; }
        sb.from('likes').select('post_id').in('post_id', postIds).then(function(r) {
          if (r.data) for (var k = 0; k < r.data.length; k++) {
            var id = r.data[k].post_id;
            if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
            counts[id].likes = (counts[id].likes || 0) + 1;
          }
          finish();
        });
        loadEchoFavoriteCounts(postIds, function(favCounts) {
          for (var k = 0; k < postIds.length; k++) {
            var id = postIds[k];
            if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
            counts[id].favs = favCounts[String(id)] || 0;
          }
          finish();
        });
        sb.from('reposts').select('post_id').in('post_id', postIds).then(function(r) {
          if (r.data) for (var k = 0; k < r.data.length; k++) {
            var id = r.data[k].post_id;
            if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
            counts[id].reposts = (counts[id].reposts || 0) + 1;
          }
          finish();
        });
      });
    });
  });
}

function loadProfileComments() {
  var timeline = document.getElementById('profile-timeline'), sb = getSupabase();
  var userId = viewingUserId || (currentUser && currentUser.id);
  if (!timeline || !sb || !userId) return;

  timeline.innerHTML = '<p>Loading comments...</p>';

  sb.from('comments')
    .select('id, text, created_at, post_id, user_id')
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .then(function(res) {
      if (res.error || !res.data || res.data.length === 0) {
        timeline.innerHTML = '<p>No comments yet.</p>';
        return;
      }

      var name = viewingDisplayName || viewingUsername || 'user';
      var handle = viewingUsername || 'user';
      var avatar = echoHtmlCssBackground(viewingAvatarUrl, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR);
      var html = '';

      for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
        var c = res.data[i];
        var postArg = JSON.stringify(c.post_id);
        html += '<div class="comment" style="padding:10px 8px;cursor:pointer;" onclick="openPostModal(' + postArg + ')">' +
          '<div class="avatar" style="background-image:' + avatar + ';float:left;margin-right:8px;cursor:pointer;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();viewProfile(\'' + c.user_id + '\')"></div>' +
          '<div><strong>' + echoEscapeHtml(name) + '</strong> <span class="screen-name">@' + echoEscapeHtml(handle) + '</span>' +
          '<div>' + linkMentionsAndTags(c.text) + '</div>' +
          '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#888;margin-top:4px;">Commented ' + timeAgo(c.created_at) + ' · View Echo</div>' +
          '</div><div class="clear"></div></div>';
      }

      timeline.innerHTML = html || '<p>No comments yet.</p>';
    });
}

function liveSearch() {
  var rawQ = document.getElementById('search-input').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('search-dropdown');
  var profileOnly = rawQ.charAt(0) === '@';
  var q = profileOnly ? rawQ.substring(1).trim() : rawQ;

  if (q.length < 1) {
    dropdown.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;

  sb.from('profiles')
    .select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified')
    .ilike('username', '%' + q + '%')
    .limit(8)
    .then(function(res) {
      if (res.error || !res.data || res.data.length === 0) {
        dropdown.style.display = 'none';
        return;
      }

      var html = '';

      for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
        var u = res.data[i];
        if (isBlocked(u.id)) continue;

        var check = u.verified
          ? ' <img class="verified-check" src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/31311_orig.png" alt="">'
          : '';

        var clickAction = profileOnly
          ? "viewProfile(this.getAttribute('data-profile-id'));document.getElementById('search-input').value='';document.getElementById('search-dropdown').style.display='none';"
          : "doSearch(this.getAttribute('data-search-query'));document.getElementById('search-dropdown').style.display='none';";

        html += '<div data-search-query="' + echoEscapeHtml(rawQ) +
          '" data-profile-id="' + echoEscapeHtml(u.id) +
          '" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;" onclick="' + clickAction + '">' +
          '<div style="width:30px;height:30px;flex:0 0 30px;border-radius:6px;background:' +
          echoHtmlCssBackground(u.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
          ' center/cover no-repeat;"></div>' +
          '<div style="min-width:0;"><span style="font-weight:bold;">' +
          echoEscapeHtml(u.display_name || u.username || 'user') + check +
          '</span> <span style="color:#888;">@' + echoEscapeHtml(u.username || 'user') +
          '</span></div></div>';
      }

      dropdown.innerHTML = html || '<div>No results</div>';
      dropdown.style.display = 'block';
    });
}
function doSearch(q) {
  if (!q) q = document.getElementById('search-input').value.trim();
  if (!q) return;

  document.getElementById('search-input').value = '';
  document.getElementById('search-dropdown').style.display = 'none';
  showPage('search');

  var box = document.getElementById('search-results');
  box.innerHTML = '<p>Searching...</p>';
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var userHtml = '', postHtml = '', done = 0;

  function finish() {
    done++;
    if (done < 2) return;
    box.innerHTML = (userHtml || '<p>No users found</p>') +
      '<h4 style="margin-top:16px;">Posts</h4>' +
      (postHtml || '<p>No posts found</p>');
  }

  sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified, bio')
    .or('username.ilike.%' + q + '%,display_name.ilike.%' + q + '%')
    .limit(10)
    .then(function(res) {
      if (res.data && res.data.length) {
        userHtml = '<h4>Users</h4>';
        for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
          var u = res.data[i];
          var check = u.verified ? ' <img class="verified-check" src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/31311_orig.png" alt="">' : '';

          userHtml += '<div class="tweet"><div class="avatar" style="background-image:' +
            echoHtmlCssBackground(u.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
            ';cursor:pointer;" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + u.id + '\')"></div><span class="username" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + u.id + '\')">' +
            echoEscapeHtml(u.display_name || u.username || 'user') + check +
            '</span><span class="screen-name">@' +
            echoEscapeHtml(u.username || 'user') +
            '</span><div class="clear"></div></div>';
        }
      }
      finish();
    });

  sb.from('posts').select('id, text, created_at, user_id')
    .ilike('text', '%' + q + '%')
    .order('created_at', { ascending:false })
    .limit(20)
    .then(function(res) {
      if (res.data && res.data.length) {
        var ids = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
          if (ids.indexOf(res.data[i].user_id) === -1) ids.push(res.data[i].user_id);
        }

        sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified, bio').in('id', ids).then(function(prof) {
          var map = {};
          if (prof.data) for (var j = 0; j < prof.data.length; j++) {
            var pd = prof.data[j];
            map[pd.id] = {
              username: pd.username || 'user',
              display_name: pd.display_name || pd.username || 'user',
              avatar: pd.avatar_url,
              verified: !!pd.verified,
              bio: pd.bio || ''
            };
          }

          postHtml = '';
          for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
            var p = res.data[i];
            var u = map[p.user_id] || { username:'user', display_name:'user', avatar:null, verified:false };
            postHtml += renderTweet(p, u, '', false, {});
          }
          finish();
        });
      } else {
        finish();
      }
    });
}

function checkFollow(userId) {
  if (!currentUser || userId === currentUser.id) { document.getElementById('follow-btn').style.display = 'none'; return; }
  viewingUserId = userId;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('follows').select('follower_id').eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).eq('following_id', userId).then(function(res) {
    isFollowing = res.data && res.data.length > 0;
    var btn = document.getElementById('follow-btn');
    btn.style.display = 'inline-block'; btn.className = isFollowing ? 'follow-btn following' : 'follow-btn follow';
  });
}
function toggleFollow() {
  if (!currentUser || !viewingUserId) return;
  if (isFollowing) document.getElementById('unfollow-modal').style.display = 'flex'; else doFollow();
}
function closeUnfollow() { document.getElementById('unfollow-modal').style.display = 'none'; window.pendingUnfollowUserId = null; window.pendingUnfollowBtn = null; }
function confirmUnfollow() {
  closeUnfollow();
  if (window.pendingUnfollowUserId && window.pendingUnfollowBtn) {
    doPostFollow(window.pendingUnfollowUserId, window.pendingUnfollowBtn, true);
    window.pendingUnfollowUserId = null;
    window.pendingUnfollowBtn = null;
  } else {
    doUnfollow();
  }
}
function doFollow() {
  var sb = getSupabase(), btn = document.getElementById('follow-btn');
  sb.from('follows').insert({ follower_id: currentUser.id, following_id: viewingUserId }).then(function(res) {
    if (!res.error) {
      isFollowing = true;
      btn.className = 'follow-btn following';
      loadStats();
      loadProfileStats(viewingUserId);
      loadFollowingList(viewingUserId);
      followingMap[viewingUserId] = true;
      rememberCrewFollowed(viewingUserId);
    }
    else showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
  });
}
function doUnfollow() {
  var sb = getSupabase(), btn = document.getElementById('follow-btn');
  sb.from('follows').delete().eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).eq('following_id', viewingUserId).then(function(res) {
    if (!res.error) { isFollowing = false; btn.className = 'follow-btn follow'; loadStats(); loadProfileStats(viewingUserId); loadFollowingList(viewingUserId); followingMap[viewingUserId] = false; }
    else showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
  });
}

function loadFollowingList(userId) {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb || !userId) return;

  sb.from('follows').select('following_id').eq('follower_id', userId).then(function(res) {
    var box = document.getElementById('following-list');
    if (res.error || !res.data || res.data.length === 0) {
      box.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">Not following anyone</p>';
      return;
    }

    var ids = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) ids.push(res.data[i].following_id);

    sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, avatar_url').in('id', ids).then(function(prof) {
      var html = '';
      if (prof.data) for (var j = 0; j < prof.data.length; j++) {
        var u = prof.data[j];
        html += '<div class="following-avatar" style="background-image:' +
          echoHtmlCssBackground(u.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
          ';" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + u.id + '\')" title="@' +
          echoEscapeHtml(u.username || 'user') + '"></div>';
      }
      box.innerHTML = html || '<p style="color:#888;">Not following anyone</p>';
    });
  });
}
function openFollowersModal(userId) {
  if (!userId) return;
  var modal = document.getElementById('followers-modal');
  var list = document.getElementById('followers-modal-list');
  if (!modal || !list) return;

  list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">Loading...</p>';
  var title = document.getElementById('followers-modal-title');
  if (title) title.textContent = 'Followers';
  modal.style.display = 'flex';

  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('follows').select('follower_id').eq('following_id', userId).then(function(res) {
    var ids = (res.data || []).map(function(row) { return row.follower_id; });
    if (!ids.length) {
      list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">No followers yet.</p>';
      return;
    }

    sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified').in('id', ids).then(function(prof) {
      var rows = prof.data || [];
      var html = '';

      for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
        var p = rows[i];
        var name = echoEscapeHtml(p.display_name || p.username || 'user');
        var handle = echoEscapeHtml(p.username || 'user');
        var check = p.verified ? ' <img class="verified-check" src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/31311_orig.png" alt="">' : '';

        html += '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;padding:8px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;cursor:pointer;" onclick="closeFollowersModal();viewProfile(\'' +
          p.id + '\')"><div style="width:38px;height:38px;flex:0 0 38px;border-radius:8px;background:' +
          echoHtmlCssBackground(p.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
          ' center/cover;margin-right:9px;"></div><div style="min-width:0;"><strong style="display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere;">' +
          name + check + '</strong><span class="screen-name">@' + handle + '</span></div></div>';
      }

      list.innerHTML = html || '<p style="color:#888;">No followers yet.</p>';
    });
  });
}
function openFollowingModal(userId) {
  if (!userId) return;

  var modal = document.getElementById('followers-modal');
  var list = document.getElementById('followers-modal-list');
  var title = document.getElementById('followers-modal-title');
  if (!modal || !list) return;

  if (title) title.textContent = 'Following';
  list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">Loading...</p>';
  modal.style.display = 'flex';

  var sb = getSupabase();

  sb.from('follows').select('following_id').eq('follower_id', userId).then(function(res) {
    var ids = (res.data || []).map(function(row) { return row.following_id; });

    if (!ids.length) {
      list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#888;">Not following anyone yet.</p>';
      return;
    }

    sb.from('profiles')
      .select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified')
      .in('id', ids)
      .then(function(prof) {
        var rows = prof.data || [];
        var map = {};

        for (var i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) map[rows[i].id] = rows[i];

        var html = '';

        for (var j = 0; j < ids.length; j++) {
          var p = map[ids[j]];
          if (!p) continue;

          var name = echoEscapeHtml(p.display_name || p.username || 'user');
          var handle = echoEscapeHtml(p.username || 'user');
          var check = p.verified
            ? ' <img class="verified-check" src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/31311_orig.png" alt="">'
            : '';

          html += '<div data-profile-id="' + echoEscapeHtml(p.id) +
            '" style="display:flex;align-items:center;padding:8px 2px;border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;cursor:pointer;"' +
            ' onclick="closeFollowersModal();viewProfile(this.dataset.profileId)">' +
            '<div style="width:38px;height:38px;flex:0 0 38px;border-radius:8px;background:' +
            echoHtmlCssBackground(p.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
            ' center/cover;margin-right:9px;"></div><div style="min-width:0;"><strong style="display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere;">' +
            name + check + '</strong><span class="screen-name">@' + handle + '</span></div></div>';
        }

        list.innerHTML = html || '<p style="color:#888;">Not following anyone yet.</p>';
      });
  });
}

function closeFollowersModal() {
  var modal = document.getElementById('followers-modal');
  if (modal) modal.style.display = 'none';
}

function loadProfileStats(userId) {
  var sb = getSupabase(); if (!sb || !userId) return;
  sb.from('posts').select('id', { count: 'exact' }).eq('user_id', userId).then(function(res) { document.getElementById('profile-echo-count').innerHTML = res.count || 0; });
  sb.from('follows').select('following_id', { count: 'exact' }).eq('follower_id', userId).then(function(res) { document.getElementById('profile-following-count').innerHTML = res.count || 0; });
  sb.from('follows').select('follower_id', { count: 'exact' }).eq('following_id', userId).then(function(res) { document.getElementById('profile-followers-count').innerHTML = res.count || 0; });
  loadFollowingList(userId);
}

}

function updateModal() {
  var birthday = document.getElementById('birthday');
  if (birthday) {
    var today = new Date();
    var yyyy = today.getFullYear();
    var mm = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    var dd = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    birthday.max = yyyy + '-' + mm + '-' + dd;
  }

  
  document.getElementById('interests-wrap').style.display = 'none';
}

function switchMode() {
  
  updateModal();
}

function echoParseInterests(rawInterests) {
  var list = [];

  if (Array.isArray(rawInterests)) {
    list = rawInterests.slice();
  } else if (rawInterests) {
    var rawText = rawInterests.toString().trim();

    if (rawText.charAt(0) === '[' && rawText.charAt(rawText.length - 1) === ']') {
      try {
        var parsed = JSON.parse(rawText);
        if (Array.isArray(parsed)) list = parsed;
      } catch(e) {}
    }

    if (!list.length) {
      rawText = rawText.replace(/^\{/, '').replace(/\}$/, '');
      list = rawText.split(',');
    }
  }

  var cleaned = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    var value = (list[i] == null ? '' : list[i].toString())
      .replace(/^\s*["']|["']\s*$/g, '')
      .trim();

    if (value && cleaned.indexOf(value) === -1) cleaned.push(value);
  }

  return cleaned;
}

function renderProfileInterestSettings(rawInterests) {
  var box = document.getElementById('profile-interest-settings');
  if (!box) return;

  var search = document.getElementById('profile-interest-search');
  if (search) search.value = '';

  var selected = echoParseInterests(rawInterests).slice(0, 5);
  var html = '';

  for (var i = 0; i < INTERESTS.length; i++) {
    var interest = INTERESTS[i];
    var checked = selected.indexOf(interest) !== -1 ? ' checked' : '';

    html += '<label style="display:inline-block;margin:3px 8px 3px 0;font-size:12px;">' +
      '<input type="checkbox" class="profile-interest-cb" value="' +
      echoEscapeHtml(interest) +
      '"' + checked +
      ' onchange="checkProfileInterestLimit()"> ' +
      echoEscapeHtml(interest) +
      '</label>';
  }

  box.innerHTML = html;
  checkProfileInterestLimit();
}

function filterProfileInterestSettings() {
  var input = document.getElementById('profile-interest-search');
  var box = document.getElementById('profile-interest-settings');
  if (!box) return;

  var query = input ? input.value.toLowerCase().trim() : '';
  var labels = box.querySelectorAll('label');

  for (var i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
    var labelText = (labels[i].textContent || '').toLowerCase();
    labels[i].style.display = !query || labelText.indexOf(query) !== -1
      ? 'inline-block'
      : 'none';
  }
}

function checkProfileInterestLimit() {
  var checked = document.querySelectorAll('.profile-interest-cb:checked');

  if (checked.length > 5) {
    checked[checked.length - 1].checked = false;
    checked = document.querySelectorAll('.profile-interest-cb:checked');
    showMessage('Interests', 'You can choose up to 5 interests.');
  }

  var count = document.getElementById('profile-interest-settings-count');
  if (count) count.textContent = checked.length + ' / 5 selected';
}

function saveProfileInterests() {
  if (!currentUser) return;

  var checked = document.querySelectorAll('.profile-interest-cb:checked');
  if (checked.length > 5) {
    showMessage('Interests', 'You can choose up to 5 interests.');
    return;
  }

  var selected = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < checked.length; i++) selected.push(checked[i].value);

  var selectedText = selected.join(',');
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;

  sb.from('profiles')
    .update({ interests: selectedText })
    .eq('id', currentUser.id)
    .then(function(profileRes) {
      if (profileRes.error) {
        showMessage('Error', profileRes.error.message);
        return;
      }

      sb.auth.updateUser({
        data: { interests: selectedText }
      }).then(function(authRes) {
        if (!authRes.error && authRes.data && authRes.data.user) {
          currentUser = authRes.data.user;
        }

        loadProfileInterests(currentUser.id);
        loadSimilarAccounts(currentUser.id);
        showMessage('Saved', 'Your interests have been updated.');
      });
    });
}

  var box = document.getElementById('interests-list');
  var html = '';

  }
  box.innerHTML = html;
}

    showMessage('Limit', 'Select only 3 interests');
  }
}

function maybeRequirePostVerifyInterests(continueCallback) {
  if (!currentUser) {
    if (typeof continueCallback === 'function') continueCallback();
    return;
  }

  var meta = currentUser.user_metadata || {};
  var emailVerified = !!(currentUser.email_confirmed_at || currentUser.confirmed_at);

  if (meta.echo_interests_pending !== true || !emailVerified) {
    if (typeof continueCallback === 'function') continueCallback();
    return;
  }

  echoPostVerifyContinue = continueCallback || null;
  renderPostVerifyInterests();

  var error = document.getElementById('post-verify-interests-error');
  if (error) {
    error.textContent = '';
    error.style.display = 'none';
  }

  closeAuth();
  document.getElementById('post-verify-interests-modal').style.display = 'flex';
}

function savePostVerifyInterests() {
  if (!currentUser) return;

  var checked = document.querySelectorAll('.post-verify-interest-cb:checked');
  var error = document.getElementById('post-verify-interests-error');

  if (checked.length !== 3) {
    if (error) {
      error.textContent = 'Choose exactly 3 interests to continue.';
      error.style.display = 'block';
    }
    return;
  }

  var selected = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < checked.length; i++) {
    selected.push(checked[i].value);
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;

  var selectedText = selected.join(',');

  sb.from('profiles')
    .update({ interests: selectedText })
    .eq('id', currentUser.id)
    .then(function(profileRes) {
      if (profileRes.error) {
        if (error) {
          error.textContent = profileRes.error.message;
          error.style.display = 'block';
        }
        return;
      }

      sb.auth.updateUser({
        data: {
          interests: selectedText,
          echo_interests_pending: false
        }
      }).then(function(authRes) {
        if (authRes.error) {
          if (error) {
            error.textContent = authRes.error.message;
            error.style.display = 'block';
          }
          return;
        }

        if (authRes.data && authRes.data.user) currentUser = authRes.data.user;

        document.getElementById('post-verify-interests-modal').style.display = 'none';

        var next = echoPostVerifyContinue;
        echoPostVerifyContinue = null;
        if (typeof next === 'function') next();
      });
    });
}

function forgotEchoPassword() {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) {
    showMessage('Error', 'Could not connect.');
    return;
  }

  var email = (document.getElementById('login-email').value || '').trim();
  if (!email) {
    showMessage('Forgot password', 'Enter your email address first, then press Forgot password.');
    return;
  }

  sb.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {
    redirectTo: window.location.origin + window.location.pathname
  }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) {
      showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
      return;
    }

    showMessage(
      'Password reset sent',
      'Check your email for a password reset link.'
    );
  });
}

function submitAuth() {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) {
    showMessage('Error', 'Could not connect');
    return;
  }

  var email = (document.getElementById('login-email').value || '').trim();
  var password = document.getElementById('login-password').value || '';

  if (!email || !password) {
    showMessage('Error', 'Enter email and password');
    return;
  }

  showSpinner();

  sb.auth.signInWithPassword({
    email: email,
    password: password
  }).then(function(res) {
    hideSpinner();

    if (res.error) {
      showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
      return;
    }

    currentUser = res.data.user;
    accountSessionToken++;
    resetAccountScopedViewState();
    loadDismissedNotifications();

    if (document.getElementById('remember-me').checked) {
      try { localStorage.setItem('echoRemember', '1'); } catch(e) {}
    } else {
      try { localStorage.removeItem('echoRemember'); } catch(e) {}
    }

    checkAccountModeration(function(allowed) {
      if (!allowed) return;

      maybeRequirePostVerifyInterests(function() {
        loadProfile();
        restoreEchoLastPage();
        updateUI();
        closeAuth();
        loadPosts();
        loadStats();
        loadUserInteractions();
        checkEchoAdmin();
        setTimeout(function() { maybeShowWelcomeEcho(currentUser); }, 250);
        setTimeout(checkPendingAdminWarning, 650);
      });
    });
  });
}

function submitSignupAuth() {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) {
    showMessage('Error', 'Could not connect');
    return;
  }

  var email = (document.getElementById('email').value || '').trim();
  var password = document.getElementById('password').value || '';
  var confirm = document.getElementById('confirm-password').value || '';
  var usernameRaw = document.getElementById('username').value || '';
  var username = usernameRaw.trim().toLowerCase().substring(0, 20);
  var birthday = document.getElementById('birthday').value;

  if (!username) {
    showMessage('Error', 'Choose a username');
    return;
  }

  if (usernameRaw.indexOf(' ') !== -1) {
    showMessage('Error', 'Username cannot contain spaces');
    return;
  }

  if (!email || !password) {
    showMessage('Error', 'Enter email and password');
    return;
  }

  if (!birthday) {
    showMessage('Error', 'Enter your birthday');
    return;
  }

  var birthdayDate = new Date(birthday + 'T00:00:00');
  var todayDate = new Date();
  todayDate.setHours(0,0,0,0);

  if (isNaN(birthdayDate.getTime()) || birthdayDate > todayDate) {
    showMessage('Error', 'Enter a valid birthday');
    return;
  }

  if (password !== confirm) {
    showMessage('Error', 'Passwords do not match');
    return;
  }

  if (authSubmitting) return;
  authSubmitting = true;
  showSignupSpinner();

  sb.from('profiles')
    .select('username')
    .eq('username', username)
    .maybeSingle()
    .then(function(check) {
      if (check.error) {
        authSubmitting = false;
        hideSignupSpinner();
        showMessage('Error', check.error.message);
        return;
      }

      if (check.data) {
        authSubmitting = false;
        hideSignupSpinner();
        showMessage('Error', 'Username already taken');
        return;
      }

      sb.auth.signUp({
        email: email,
        password: password,
        options: {
          data: {
            username: username,
            display_name: username,
            name: username,
            echo_signup_username: username,
            date_of_birth: birthday,
            echo_interests_pending: true,
            echo_welcome_pending: true
          }
        }
      }).then(function(res) {
        authSubmitting = false;
        hideSignupSpinner();

        if (res.error) {
          var authError = res.error.message || 'Could not create account';
          var waitMatch = authError.match(/(?:after|in)\s+(\d+)\s*seconds?/i);

          if (waitMatch) {
            showMessage(
              'Please wait',
              'Please wait ' + waitMatch[1] + ' seconds before trying to sign up again.'
            );
          } else {
            showMessage('Error', authError);
          }
          return;
        }

        showMessage(
          'Verify your email',
          'Account created. Check your email and verify your address. After verification, sign in and you will choose your 3 interests.'
        );
      });
    });
}

function loadUserInteractions() {
  if (!currentUser) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('likes').select('post_id').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    likedPosts = {}; if (res.data) for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) likedPosts[res.data[i].post_id] = true;
  });
  sb.from('favorites').select('post_id').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    favPosts = {}; if (res.data) for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) favPosts[res.data[i].post_id] = true;
  });
  sb.from('reposts').select('post_id').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    repostPosts = {}; if (res.data) for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) repostPosts[res.data[i].post_id] = true;
  });
  sb.from('blocks').select('blocked_id').eq('blocker_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    blockedUsers = []; if (res.data) for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) blockedUsers.push(res.data[i].blocked_id);
  });
  var relationLoads = 0;
  function relationshipLoaded() {
    relationLoads++;
    if (relationLoads === 2) {
      var active = document.querySelector('.page.active');
      if (active && active.id === 'page-home') loadPosts();
    }
  }
  sb.from('follows').select('following_id').eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    followingMap = {}; if (res.data) for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) followingMap[res.data[i].following_id] = true;
    relationshipLoaded();
  });
  sb.from('follows').select('follower_id').eq('following_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    followedByMap = {}; if (res.data) for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) followedByMap[res.data[i].follower_id] = true;
    relationshipLoaded();
  });
  sb.from('comment_likes').select('comment_id').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    likedComments = {}; if (res.data) for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) likedComments[res.data[i].comment_id] = true;
  });
}

function loadProfile() {
if (!currentUser) return;
var sb = getSupabase();
var requestedUserId = currentUser.id;
var requestedSessionToken = accountSessionToken;
document.getElementById('sidebar-name').innerHTML = 'Loading...';
document.getElementById('sidebar-handle').innerHTML = '';
document.getElementById('sidebar-avatar').style.backgroundImage = "url('https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/friend_orig.png')";
sb.from('profiles').select('username, display_name, bio, avatar_url, verified, background_url, interests').eq('id', requestedUserId).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
if (!currentUser || currentUser.id !== requestedUserId || requestedSessionToken !== accountSessionToken) return;
var emailValue = currentUser.email || '';
var emailFallback = emailValue ? emailValue.split('@')[0].substring(0, 20) : 'user';
var meta = currentUser.user_metadata || {};
var signupUsername = (meta.echo_signup_username || meta.username || '').toString().trim().toLowerCase().substring(0, 20);
var signupInterests = '';
if (Array.isArray(meta.interests)) signupInterests = meta.interests.join(',');
else if (meta.interests) signupInterests = meta.interests.toString();

if (res.data && res.data.username) {
var fixedUsername = res.data.username;
var fixedDisplayName = res.data.display_name || res.data.username;
var needsProfileFix = false;

if (signupUsername && (fixedUsername === emailValue || fixedUsername === emailFallback)) {
fixedUsername = signupUsername;
needsProfileFix = true;
}
if (!fixedDisplayName || fixedDisplayName === emailValue || fixedDisplayName === emailFallback) {
fixedDisplayName = signupUsername || fixedUsername;
needsProfileFix = true;
}

currentUsername = fixedUsername;
currentDisplayName = fixedDisplayName;
currentUserVerified = !!res.data.verified;
var check = currentUserVerified ? ' <img class="verified-check" src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/31311_orig.png" alt="Verified">' : '';
document.getElementById('sidebar-name').innerHTML = echoEscapeHtml(currentDisplayName || currentUsername) + check;

var profileFixData = {};
if (needsProfileFix) {
profileFixData.username = fixedUsername;
profileFixData.display_name = fixedDisplayName;
}
if ((!res.data.interests || res.data.interests.toString().trim() === '') && signupInterests) {
profileFixData.interests = signupInterests;
}
if (Object.keys(profileFixData).length > 0) {
sb.from('profiles').update(profileFixData).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function() {});
}
} else {
var fallback = signupUsername || emailFallback;
currentUsername = fallback;
currentDisplayName = fallback;
currentUserVerified = false;
sb.from('profiles').insert({
id: currentUser.id,
username: fallback,
display_name: fallback,
interests: signupInterests
}).then(function() {
setTimeout(function() { loadProfile(); }, 600);
});
}
var ownProfileStyle = getProfileStyleData((res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
if (ownProfileStyle.privacyStored) {
privacy.privateProfile = ownProfileStyle.privateProfile;
privacy.hideFavorites = ownProfileStyle.hideFavorites;
privacy.postsVisibility = ownProfileStyle.postsVisibility;
try { localStorage.setItem('echoPrivacy', JSON.stringify(privacy)); } catch(e) {}
} else if (privacy.privateProfile || privacy.hideFavorites || privacy.postsVisibility !== 'everyone') {
setTimeout(savePrivacyToProfile, 50);
}
renderProfileBio('profile-bio', (res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
renderProfileLocation((res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
renderProfileShowcase((res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
var ownStoredBio = (res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '';
applyProfileExtras(ownStoredBio);
loadBackendProfileBoxShape(requestedUserId, function(savedBackendShape) {
if (
savedBackendShape &&
currentUser &&
currentUser.id === requestedUserId &&
requestedSessionToken === accountSessionToken
) {
applyProfileExtras(ownStoredBio, savedBackendShape);
}
});
applyAvatarGlow('profile-avatar', (res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
if (res.data && res.data.avatar_url) {
document.getElementById('profile-avatar').style.backgroundImage = "url('" + res.data.avatar_url + "')";
document.getElementById('sidebar-avatar').style.backgroundImage = "url('" + res.data.avatar_url + "')";
} else {
document.getElementById('profile-avatar').style.backgroundImage = "url('https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/friend_orig.png')";
document.getElementById('sidebar-avatar').style.backgroundImage = "url('https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/friend_orig.png')";
}
if (res.data && res.data.background_url) document.body.style.backgroundImage = "url('" + res.data.background_url + "')";
updateUI(); loadStats(); loadUserInteractions();
setTimeout(checkEchoBadges, 300);
});
}

function loadMutualFollows(userId) {
  if (!currentUser || userId === currentUser.id) {
    document.getElementById('mutual-follows').innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('follows').select('follower_id').eq('following_id', userId).then(function(theirFollowers) {
    var followerIds = (theirFollowers.data || []).map(function(f) { return f.follower_id; });
    if (followerIds.length === 0) {
      document.getElementById('mutual-follows').innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">No mutual follows</p>';
      return;
    }

    sb.from('follows').select('following_id').eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).in('following_id', followerIds).then(function(mutual) {
      var mutualIds = (mutual.data || []).map(function(m) { return m.following_id; });
      if (mutualIds.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('mutual-follows').innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">No mutual follows</p>';
        return;
      }

      sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url').in('id', mutualIds).limit(6).then(function(prof) {
        var html = '';
        if (prof.data) for (var i = 0; i < prof.data.length; i++) {
          var p = prof.data[i];
          html += '<div style="display:inline-block;vertical-align:top;width:50px;margin:4px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;" onclick="viewProfile(\'' +
            p.id + '\')"><div style="width:36px;height:36px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:8px;background:' +
            echoHtmlCssBackground(p.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
            ' center/cover;"></div><div style="font-size:10px;max-width:50px;overflow:hidden;">' +
            echoEscapeHtml(p.display_name || p.username || 'user') +
            '</div></div>';
        }
        document.getElementById('mutual-follows').innerHTML = html || '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">No mutual follows</p>';
      });
    });
  });
}
function loadSimilarAccounts(userId) {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('profiles').select('interests').eq('id', userId).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    if (!res.data || !res.data.interests) {
      document.getElementById('similar-accounts').innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">No interests set</p>';
      return;
    }

    var interests = res.data.interests.split(',');
    sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, interests').neq('id', userId).limit(50).then(function(all) {
      var matches = [];
      if (all.data) for (var i = 0; i < all.data.length; i++) {
        var p = all.data[i];
        if (!p.interests) continue;
        var theirInterests = p.interests.split(',');
        var shared = 0;
        for (var j = 0; j < interests.length; j++) if (theirInterests.indexOf(interests[j]) !== -1) shared++;
        if (shared > 0) matches.push({ profile:p, shared:shared });
      }

      matches.sort(function(a, b) { return b.shared - a.shared; });
      matches = matches.slice(0, 6);

      var html = '';
      for (var i = 0; i < matches.length; i++) {
        var p = matches[i].profile;
        html += '<div style="display:inline-block;margin:4px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;" onclick="viewProfile(\'' +
          p.id + '\')"><div style="width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:8px;background:' +
          echoHtmlCssBackground(p.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
          ' center/cover;"></div><div style="font-size:10px;max-width:50px;overflow:hidden;">' +
          echoEscapeHtml(p.display_name || p.username || 'user') +
          '</div></div>';
      }

      document.getElementById('similar-accounts').innerHTML = html || '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">No similar accounts</p>';
    });
  });
}

function loadProfileInterests(userId) {
  var box = document.getElementById('profile-interests');
  if (!box || !userId) return;
  box.innerHTML = '';
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;

  sb.from('profiles').select('interests').eq('id', userId).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
    var rawInterests = (res.data && res.data.interests) ? res.data.interests : '';

    if (currentUser && userId === currentUser.id && (!rawInterests || (typeof rawInterests === 'string' && rawInterests.trim() === ''))) {
      var ownMeta = currentUser.user_metadata || {};
      rawInterests = ownMeta.interests || '';
    }

    var cleaned = echoParseInterests(rawInterests);

    if (cleaned.length > 0) {
      box.innerHTML = '<strong style="color:inherit;">Interests:</strong> ' +
        cleaned.map(echoEscapeHtml).join(' · ');
      box.style.display = 'block';
    } else {
      box.innerHTML = '';
      box.style.display = 'none';
    }
  });
}

function viewProfile(userId, afterOpen, suppressBrowserHistory) {
  if (isBlocked(userId)) {
    showMessage('Blocked', 'You have blocked this user.');
    return;
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) {
    viewProfileAllowed(userId, afterOpen, suppressBrowserHistory);
    return;
  }

  sb.rpc('is_echo_account_suspended', { target_user_id: userId }).then(function(res) {
    /* Do not break profile viewing if the optional backend helper has not
       been installed yet. */
    if (res.error) {
      viewProfileAllowed(userId, afterOpen, suppressBrowserHistory);
      return;
    }

    if (res.data === true) {
      showMessage('Account suspended', 'This account is currently suspended.');
      return;
    }

    viewProfileAllowed(userId, afterOpen, suppressBrowserHistory);
  });
}

function viewProfileAllowed(userId, afterOpen, suppressBrowserHistory) {

echoPushBrowserState({
echoPage:'profile',
profileUserId:userId,
profileTab:'echos'

}

var thisProfileViewToken = ++profileViewToken;
var thisSessionToken = accountSessionToken;
viewingUserId = userId;

document.getElementById('tab-echos').className = 'active';
document.getElementById('tab-favorites').className = '';
document.getElementById('tab-comments').className = '';
document.getElementById('tab-top8').className = '';
var sb = getSupabase();
sb.from('profiles').select('username, display_name, bio, avatar_url, verified, created_at, anthem_url, interests').eq('id', userId).maybeSingle().then(function(res) {
if (thisProfileViewToken !== profileViewToken || thisSessionToken !== accountSessionToken || viewingUserId !== userId) return;
var name = 'user', handle = 'user', verified = false;
if (res.data) {
handle = res.data.username || 'user';
name = res.data.display_name || res.data.username || 'user';
verified = !!res.data.verified;
}
viewingUsername = handle;
viewingDisplayName = name;
viewingProfilePrivacy = getProfileStyleData((res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '');
viewingProfileContentAllowed = true;

viewingAvatarUrl = avatarUrl;

document.getElementById('profile-name').innerHTML = echoEscapeHtml(name) + check;

document.getElementById('profile-handle').textContent = '@' + handle;
renderProfileBio('profile-bio', (res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : 'Just joined');

savedBackendShape &&
thisProfileViewToken === profileViewToken &&
thisSessionToken === accountSessionToken &&
viewingUserId === userId
) {
applyProfileExtras(viewedStoredBio, savedBackendShape);
}
});
var anthem = '';
if (res.data && res.data.anthem_url) {
var anthemName = res.data.anthem_name || 'Song';
var safeAnthemUrl = echoSafeHttpUrl(res.data.anthem_url);
if (safeAnthemUrl) {
anthem = '<a href="#" data-anthem-url="' + echoEscapeHtml(safeAnthemUrl) +
'" onclick="playAnthem(this.getAttribute(\'data-anthem-url\'));return false;" style="color:#1da1f2;">Anthem - ' +
echoEscapeHtml(anthemName) + '</a>';
}
if (!res.data.anthem_name) fetchAnthemName(res.data.anthem_url, userId);
}
document.getElementById('profile-anthem').innerHTML = anthem;
if (currentUser && userId === currentUser.id) {
sb.from('profile_views').select('id', { count: 'exact' }).eq('profile_id', userId).then(function(v) {
var el = document.getElementById('profile-visitors');
if (el) el.innerHTML = (v.count || 0) + ' profile views';
});
} else {
var el = document.getElementById('profile-visitors');
if (el) el.innerHTML = '';
if (currentUser) sb.from('profile_views').insert({ profile_id: userId, viewer_id: currentUser.id }).then(function() {});
}
var joined = 'Joined';
if (res.data && res.data.created_at) {
