var months = ['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
joined = 'Joined ' + months[d.getMonth()] + ' ' + d.getFullYear();
}
document.getElementById('profile-joined').innerHTML = joined;
loadProfileInterests(userId);
document.getElementById('about-handle').textContent = '@' + handle;
document.getElementById('mutual-handle').textContent = '@' + handle;
document.getElementById('similar-handle').textContent = '@' + handle;
loadMutualFollows(userId);
loadFriendAnniversary(userId);
loadSimilarAccounts(userId);
document.getElementById('similar-handle').textContent = '@' + handle;
renderProfileBio('about-bio', (res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : 'Just joined');
document.getElementById('profile-avatar').style.backgroundImage = echoCssBackgroundValue(avatarUrl, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR);
var isOwn = currentUser && userId === currentUser.id;
document.getElementById('edit-profile-btn').style.display = isOwn ? 'inline-block' : 'none';
document.getElementById('other-profile-menu').style.display = isOwn ? 'none' : 'inline-block';
if (!isOwn) updateMuteProfileOption();
document.getElementById('own-sidebar').style.display = 'none';
document.getElementById('profile-about').style.display = 'block';
checkFollow(userId);
loadProfileStats(userId);
loadProfileBadges(userId);
showPage('profile');
if (typeof afterOpen === 'function') {
try { afterOpen(); } catch(e) {}
}
checkProfileContentAccess(userId, (res.data && res.data.bio) ? res.data.bio : '', function(allowed) {
viewingProfileContentAllowed = allowed;
if (allowed) {
loadUserPosts(userId, avatarUrl);
} else {
document.getElementById('profile-timeline').innerHTML = '<p style="padding:14px 0;color:#888;">This profile is private or its Echos are limited to approved followers.</p>';
}
});
});
}

function loadUserPosts(userId, avatarUrl) {
  var sb = getSupabase(), av = avatarUrl || viewingAvatarUrl || 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/friend_orig.png';
  sb.from('posts').select('id, text, created_at, user_id, pinned, poll_options').eq('user_id', userId).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).then(function(res) {
    var timeline = document.getElementById('profile-timeline'), posts = (res.data || []).map(function(p) { return { post: p, isRepost: false, timelineAt: p.created_at }; });
    sb.from('reposts').select('*').eq('user_id', userId).then(function(rp) {
      var repostRows = rp.data || [];
      var repostIds = repostRows.map(function(r) { return r.post_id; });
      var repostTimes = {};
      for (var ri = 0; ri < repostRows.length; ri++) {
        var rr = repostRows[ri];
        repostTimes[rr.post_id] = rr.created_at || rr.reposted_at || rr.inserted_at || repostActivityTimes[rr.post_id] || null;
      }
      if (repostIds.length > 0) {
        sb.from('posts').select('id, text, created_at, user_id, pinned, poll_options').in('id', repostIds).then(function(rposts) {
          if (rposts.data) {
            for (var i = 0; i < rposts.data.length; i++) posts.push({ post: rposts.data[i], isRepost: true, timelineAt: repostTimes[rposts.data[i].id] || repostActivityTimes[rposts.data[i].id] || rposts.data[i].created_at });
          }
          renderProfilePosts(posts, timeline, av, userId);
        });
      } else {
        renderProfilePosts(posts, timeline, av, userId);
      }
    });
  });
}
function renderProfilePosts(posts, timeline, av, userId) {
  if (!posts || posts.length === 0) {
    timeline.innerHTML = '<p>No echos yet</p>';
    return;
  }

  var userIds = [];
  var postIds = [];

  for (var i = 0; i < posts.length; i++) {
    if (userIds.indexOf(posts[i].post.user_id) === -1) userIds.push(posts[i].post.user_id);
    postIds.push(posts[i].post.id);
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();

  sb.from('profiles')
    .select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified, bio')
    .in('id', userIds)
    .then(function(prof) {
      var map = {};

      if (prof.data) {
        for (var j = 0; j < prof.data.length; j++) {
          var pd = prof.data[j];
          map[pd.id] = {
            username: pd.username || 'user',
            display_name: pd.display_name || pd.username || 'user',
            avatar: pd.avatar_url,
            verified: !!pd.verified,
            bio: pd.bio || ''
          };
        }
      }

      var counts = {};
      var pollVoteMap = {};
      var done = 0;

      function finish() {
        done++;
        if (done < 4) return;

        posts.sort(function(a, b) {
          var pinDiff = (b.post.pinned ? 1 : 0) - (a.post.pinned ? 1 : 0);
          if (pinDiff) return pinDiff;
          return new Date(b.timelineAt || b.post.created_at).getTime() - new Date(a.timelineAt || a.post.created_at).getTime();
        });

        var html = '';

        for (var i = 0; i < posts.length; i++) {
          var item = posts[i];
          var p = item.post;
          var u = map[p.user_id] || {
            username: viewingUsername || 'user',
            display_name: viewingDisplayName || 'user',
            avatar: null,
            verified: false
          };

          p.poll_votes = pollVoteMap[p.id] || {};

          var postAv = echoHtmlCssBackground(u.avatar, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR);
          html += renderTweet(p, u, postAv, item.isRepost, counts[p.id] || {});
        }

        timeline.innerHTML = html || '<p>No echos yet</p>';
      }

      if (postIds.length === 0) {
        finish(); finish(); finish(); finish();
        return;
      }

      sb.from('likes').select('post_id').in('post_id', postIds).then(function(r) {
        if (r.data) {
          for (var k = 0; k < r.data.length; k++) {
            var id = r.data[k].post_id;
            if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
            counts[id].likes = (counts[id].likes || 0) + 1;
          }
        }
        finish();
      });

      loadEchoFavoriteCounts(postIds, function(favCounts) {
        for (var k = 0; k < postIds.length; k++) {
          var id = postIds[k];
          if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
          counts[id].favs = favCounts[String(id)] || 0;
        }
        finish();
      });

      sb.from('reposts').select('post_id').in('post_id', postIds).then(function(r) {
        if (r.data) {
          for (var k = 0; k < r.data.length; k++) {
            var id = r.data[k].post_id;
            if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
            counts[id].reposts = (counts[id].reposts || 0) + 1;
          }
        }
        finish();
      });

      loadPollVoteCounts(postIds, function(voteMap) {
        pollVoteMap = voteMap || {};
        finish();
      });
    });
}

function updateUI() {
  var dropdownAuth = document.getElementById('dropdown-auth'), stats = document.getElementById('stats');
  if (currentUser) {
    dropdownAuth.innerHTML = 'Sign out'; stats.style.display = 'block';
    var name = currentDisplayName || currentUsername || 'user';
    var handle = currentUsername || 'user';
    var check = currentUserVerified ? ' <img class="verified-check" src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/31311_orig.png" alt="Verified">' : '';
    document.getElementById('sidebar-name').innerHTML = echoEscapeHtml(name) + check;
    document.getElementById('sidebar-handle').textContent = '@' + handle;
  } else {
    dropdownAuth.innerHTML = 'Sign in'; stats.style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('sidebar-name').innerHTML = 'Guest';
    document.getElementById('sidebar-handle').innerHTML = '@guest';
  }
}
function loadStats() {
  if (!currentUser) return;
  var sb = getSupabase(); if (!sb) return;
  sb.from('posts').select('id', { count: 'exact' }).eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) { document.getElementById('echo-count').innerHTML = res.count || 0; });
  sb.from('follows').select('following_id', { count: 'exact' }).eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) { document.getElementById('following-count').innerHTML = res.count || 0; });
  sb.from('follows').select('follower_id', { count: 'exact' }).eq('following_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) { document.getElementById('followers-count').innerHTML = res.count || 0; });
}

function refreshLatestEchoes(button) {
  if (button) {
    button.disabled = true;
    button.textContent = 'Refreshing...';
  }

  loadPosts();

  setTimeout(function() {
    if (button) {
      button.disabled = false;
      button.textContent = 'Refresh';
    }
  }, 700);
}

function loadPosts() {
var sb = getSupabase(); if (!sb) return;
sb.from('posts').select('id, text, created_at, user_id, pinned, poll_options').order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(50).then(function(res) {
var timeline = document.getElementById('timeline');
if (res.error || !res.data) { timeline.innerHTML = '<p>Could not load posts</p>'; return; }

var allPosts = res.data.slice();

function renderFeedPosts(feedPosts) {
var ids = [];
var postIds = [];
for (var i = 0; i < feedPosts.length; i++) {
if (ids.indexOf(feedPosts[i].user_id) === -1 && !isBlocked(feedPosts[i].user_id)) ids.push(feedPosts[i].user_id);
postIds.push(feedPosts[i].id);
}
if (ids.length === 0) { timeline.innerHTML = '<p>No posts yet</p>'; return; }
sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified, bio').in('id', ids).then(function(prof) {
userMap = {};
if (prof.data) for (var j = 0; j < prof.data.length; j++) {
var pd = prof.data[j]; userMap[pd.id] = { username: pd.username || 'user', display_name: pd.display_name || pd.username || 'user', avatar: pd.avatar_url, verified: !!pd.verified, bio: pd.bio || '' };
}
var counts = {};
var pollVotes = {};
var done = 0;
function finish() {
done++;
if (done < 4) return;
var html = '';
for (var i = 0; i < feedPosts.length; i++) {
var p = feedPosts[i]; if (isBlocked(p.user_id)) continue;
p.poll_votes = pollVotes[p.id] || {};
var u = userMap[p.user_id] || { username: 'user', display_name: 'user', avatar: null, verified: false };
var av = u.avatar ? "url('" + u.avatar + "')" : "url('https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/friend_orig.png')";
html += renderTweet(p, u, av, false, counts[p.id] || {});
}
timeline.innerHTML = html || '<p>No posts yet</p>';
}
if (postIds.length === 0) { finish(); finish(); finish(); finish(); return; }
sb.from('likes').select('post_id').in('post_id', postIds).then(function(r) {
if (r.data) for (var k = 0; k < r.data.length; k++) {
var id = r.data[k].post_id;
if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
counts[id].likes = (counts[id].likes || 0) + 1;
}
finish();
});
loadEchoFavoriteCounts(postIds, function(favCounts) {
for (var k = 0; k < postIds.length; k++) {
var id = postIds[k];
if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
counts[id].favs = favCounts[String(id)] || 0;
}
finish();
});
sb.from('reposts').select('post_id').in('post_id', postIds).then(function(r) {
if (r.data) for (var k = 0; k < r.data.length; k++) {
var id = r.data[k].post_id;
if (!counts[id]) counts[id] = {};
counts[id].reposts = (counts[id].reposts || 0) + 1;
}
finish();
});
sb.from('poll_votes').select('post_id, option_index').in('post_id', postIds).then(function(r) {
if (r.data) for (var k = 0; k < r.data.length; k++) {
var id = r.data[k].post_id;
var idx = r.data[k].option_index;
if (!pollVotes[id]) pollVotes[id] = {};
pollVotes[id][idx] = (pollVotes[id][idx] || 0) + 1;
}
finish();
});
});
}

// Keep the existing public/latest feed for signed-out visitors.
if (!currentUser) { renderFeedPosts(allPosts); return; }

// Signed-in home feed: your own posts + people you follow, with up to
// three discovery posts from the highest-followed active accounts.
sb.from('follows').select('following_id').eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).then(function(followRes) {
if (followRes.error) { renderFeedPosts(allPosts); return; }

var followed = {};
if (followRes.data) for (var i = 0; i < followRes.data.length; i++) followed[followRes.data[i].following_id] = true;

var candidateIds = [];
for (var i = 0; i < allPosts.length; i++) {
var postUserId = allPosts[i].user_id;
if (isBlocked(postUserId) || postUserId === currentUser.id || followed[postUserId]) continue;
if (candidateIds.indexOf(postUserId) === -1) candidateIds.push(postUserId);
}

if (candidateIds.length === 0) {
var followedOnly = [];
for (var i = 0; i < allPosts.length; i++) {
if (!isBlocked(allPosts[i].user_id) && (allPosts[i].user_id === currentUser.id || followed[allPosts[i].user_id])) followedOnly.push(allPosts[i]);
}
renderFeedPosts(followedOnly);
return;
}

sb.from('follows').select('following_id').in('following_id', candidateIds).then(function(popRes) {
if (popRes.error) { renderFeedPosts(allPosts); return; }

var followerCounts = {};
for (var i = 0; i < candidateIds.length; i++) followerCounts[candidateIds[i]] = 0;
if (popRes.data) for (var i = 0; i < popRes.data.length; i++) {
var followedId = popRes.data[i].following_id;
followerCounts[followedId] = (followerCounts[followedId] || 0) + 1;
}

candidateIds.sort(function(a, b) {
var diff = (followerCounts[b] || 0) - (followerCounts[a] || 0);
if (diff !== 0) return diff;
return 0;
});

var featuredAccounts = {};
for (var i = 0; i < candidateIds.length && i < 3; i++) featuredAccounts[candidateIds[i]] = true;

var usedFeatured = {};
var feedPosts = [];
for (var i = 0; i < allPosts.length; i++) {
var p = allPosts[i];
if (isBlocked(p.user_id)) continue;
if (p.user_id === currentUser.id || followed[p.user_id]) {
feedPosts.push(p);
} else if (featuredAccounts[p.user_id] && !usedFeatured[p.user_id]) {
feedPosts.push(p);
usedFeatured[p.user_id] = true;
}
}

renderFeedPosts(feedPosts);
});
});
});
}
function loadConnect() {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;

  sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url, verified, bio').then(function(res) {
    var box = document.getElementById('connect-users');
    if (res.error || !res.data || res.data.length === 0) {
      box.innerHTML = '<p>No users yet</p>';
      return;
    }

    var people = [];
    for (var p = 0; p < res.data.length; p++) {
      var person = res.data[p];
      if (isBlocked(person.id)) continue;
      if (currentUser && person.id === currentUser.id) continue;
      people.push(person);
    }

    for (var s = people.length - 1; s > 0; s--) {
      var r = Math.floor(Math.random() * (s + 1));
      var temp = people[s];
      people[s] = people[r];
      people[r] = temp;
    }

    people = people.slice(0, 12);
    var html = '';

    for (var i = 0; i < people.length; i++) {
      var u = people[i];
      var name = echoEscapeHtml(u.display_name || u.username || 'user');
      var handle = echoEscapeHtml(u.username || 'user');
      var check = u.verified ? ' <img class="verified-check" src="https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/31311_orig.png" alt="">' : '';

      html += '<div class="tweet"><div class="avatar" style="background-image:' +
        echoHtmlCssBackground(u.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
        ';"></div><span class="username" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + u.id + '\')">' +
        name + check + '</span><span class="screen-name">@' + handle +
        '</span><div class="clear"></div></div>';
    }

    box.innerHTML = html || '<p>No users yet</p>';
  });
}
function loadDiscover() {
  var sb = getSupabase(); if (!sb) return;
  sb.from('posts').select('text').limit(200).then(function(res) {
    var box = document.getElementById('hashtags');
    if (res.error || !res.data) { box.innerHTML = '<p>No hashtags yet</p>'; return; }
    var counts = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
      var matches = (res.data[i].text || '').match(/#\w+/g);
      if (matches) for (var m = 0; m < matches.length; m++) { var tag = matches[m].toLowerCase(); counts[tag] = (counts[tag] || 0) + 1; }
    }
    var sorted = Object.keys(counts).sort(function(a, b) { return counts[b] - counts[a]; }).slice(0, 10);
    var html = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
      var trendRank = i === 0 ? '<span style="display:block;color:#888;font-weight:normal;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:2px;">Trending #1</span>' : '';
      html += '<a href="#" style="display:block;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;color:#1da1f2;font-weight:bold;font-size:15px;" onclick="goToHashtag(\'' + sorted[i].substring(1) + '\');return false;">' + trendRank + sorted[i] + ' <span style="color:#888;font-weight:normal;font-size:11px;">' + counts[sorted[i]] + '</span></a>';
    }
    box.innerHTML = html || '<p>No hashtags yet. Use # in your posts.</p>';
  });
}
function loadTrending() {
  var sb = getSupabase(); if (!sb) return;
  sb.from('posts').select('text').limit(200).then(function(res) {
    var box = document.getElementById('trending-list');
    if (res.error || !res.data) { box.innerHTML = '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">No trends yet</p>'; return; }
    var counts = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < res.data.length; i++) {
      var matches = (res.data[i].text || '').match(/#\w+/g);
      if (matches) for (var m = 0; m < matches.length; m++) { var tag = matches[m].toLowerCase(); counts[tag] = (counts[tag] || 0) + 1; }
    }
    var sorted = Object.keys(counts).sort(function(a, b) { return counts[b] - counts[a]; }).slice(0, 5);
    var html = '';
    for (var i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
      var trendRank = i === 0 ? '<span style="display:block;color:#888;font-weight:normal;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:2px;">Trending #1</span>' : '';
      html += '<a href="#" onclick="goToHashtag(\'' + sorted[i].substring(1) + '\');return false;">' + trendRank + sorted[i] + '</a>';
    }
    box.innerHTML = html || '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">No trends yet</p>';
  });
}

function uploadAvatar(input) {
  if (!input.files || !input.files[0] || !currentUser) return;
  var file = input.files[0];
  if (file.size > 500000) { showMessage('Error', 'Image must be under 500KB'); return; }
  var sb = getSupabase(), path = currentUser.id + '/avatar.png';
  sb.storage.from('avatars').upload(path, file, { upsert: true }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) { showMessage('Error', res.error.message); return; }
    var url = sb.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl + '?t=' + Date.now();
    sb.from('profiles').update({ avatar_url: url }).eq('id', currentUser.id).then(function() {
      document.getElementById('profile-avatar').style.backgroundImage = "url('" + url + "')";
      document.getElementById('sidebar-avatar').style.backgroundImage = "url('" + url + "')";
      showMessage('Saved', 'Profile picture updated.');
    });
  });
}

}
function echoPushBrowserState(state) {
  if (!state || !state.echoPage) return;

  var current = history.state || {};
  var same =
    current.echoPage === state.echoPage &&
    (current.profileUserId || '') === (state.profileUserId || '') &&
    (current.profileTab || '') === (state.profileTab || '');

  if (!same) history.pushState(state, '', location.href);
}

function echoReplaceBrowserState(state) {
  if (!state || !state.echoPage) return;
  history.replaceState(state, '', location.href);
}

function echoLastPageStorageKey() {
  return currentUser && currentUser.id ? 'echoLastPage:' + currentUser.id : null;
}

function rememberEchoPage(name) {
  if (!currentUser) return;
  if (['home','discover','connect','crew','profile'].indexOf(name) === -1) return;

  var key = echoLastPageStorageKey();
  if (!key) return;

  var state = { page:name };

  if (name === 'profile') {
    state.profileUserId = viewingUserId || currentUser.id;
    state.profileTab = currentProfileTab || 'echos';
  }

  try { localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(state)); } catch(e) {}
}

function restoreEchoLastPage() {
  if (!currentUser) return;

  var key = echoLastPageStorageKey();
  var state = null;

  try {
    state = JSON.parse((key && localStorage.getItem(key)) || 'null');
  } catch(e) {
    state = null;
  }

  if (!state || ['home','discover','connect','crew','profile'].indexOf(state.page) === -1) {
    echoReplaceBrowserState({ echoPage:'home' });
    showPage('home', true);
    return;
  }

  if (state.page === 'profile') {
    var profileId = state.profileUserId || currentUser.id;
    var savedTab = ['echos','favorites','comments','top8'].indexOf(state.profileTab) !== -1 ? state.profileTab : 'echos';

    echoReplaceBrowserState({
      echoPage:'profile',
      profileUserId:profileId,
      profileTab:savedTab
    });

    viewProfile(profileId, function() {
      if (savedTab !== 'echos') showProfileTab(savedTab, true);
    }, true);
    return;
  }

  echoReplaceBrowserState({ echoPage:state.page });
  showPage(state.page, true);
}

function showPage(name, suppressBrowserHistory) {
  if (name !== 'profile') document.body.classList.remove('echo-profile-season-autumn','echo-profile-season-money');
  if (!currentUser) {
    openAuth('signin');
    return;
  }
  if (name === 'admin' && !isEchoAdmin) {
    showMessage('Admin only', 'You do not have permission to open the Admin Panel.');
    return;
  }
  var pages = document.getElementsByClassName('page');
  for (var i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) pages[i].className = 'page';
  document.getElementById('page-' + name).className = 'page active';
  ['home','discover','connect','crew'].forEach(function(n) {
    var el = document.getElementById('nav-' + n); if (el) el.className = (n === name) ? 'active' : '';
  });
  updateNavIcons(name);
  if (name !== 'crew') stopCrewPresence();
  if (name !== 'profile') applyDefaultSiteBackground();
  if (name === 'connect') loadConnect();
  if (name === 'discover') loadDiscover();
  if (name === 'crew') { loadCrew(); if (currentRoomId) markCrewRead(currentRoomId); }
  if (name === 'admin') loadAdminPanel();
  if (name === 'profile') {
    document.getElementById('main-content').style.width = '100%';
    document.getElementById('sidebar').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('own-sidebar').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('profile-about').style.display = 'block';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('main-content').style.width = '62%';
    document.getElementById('sidebar').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('own-sidebar').style.display = 'block';
    document.getElementById('profile-about').style.display = 'none';
    if (currentUser) loadStats();
    loadTrending();
  }

  if (!suppressBrowserHistory && name !== 'profile') {
    echoPushBrowserState({ echoPage:name });
  }

  rememberEchoPage(name);
}

function getCrewTheme() { return ECHO_ROOM_THEMES[currentRoomTheme] || ECHO_ROOM_THEMES.classic; }
function applyCrewRoomTheme(key) {
  currentRoomTheme = ECHO_ROOM_THEMES[key] ? key : 'classic';
  var t = getCrewTheme();
  var header = document.getElementById('crew-chat-header');
  var msgs = document.getElementById('crew-messages');
  var inputArea = document.getElementById('crew-input-area');
  var typing = document.getElementById('crew-typing-indicator');

  if (header) {
    header.style.background = t.accent;
    header.style.boxShadow = t.headerShadow || '';
  }

  if (msgs) {
    msgs.style.background = t.background;
    msgs.style.backgroundSize = t.gridSize || '';
  }

  if (inputArea) inputArea.style.background = t.input;
  if (typing) typing.style.background = t.input;
}
function loadCrewRoomTheme(roomId) {
  var sb=getSupabase();
  sb.from('rooms').select('theme_key').eq('id',roomId).maybeSingle().then(function(res){
    if(res.error || !res.data) { applyCrewRoomTheme('classic'); return; }
    applyCrewRoomTheme(res.data.theme_key || 'classic');
  });
}
function openRoomThemeModal() {
  document.getElementById('room-menu').style.display='none';
  if(!currentRoomId || !currentRoomIsOwner) return;
  var box=document.getElementById('room-theme-grid');
  var html='';
  Object.keys(ECHO_ROOM_THEMES).forEach(function(key){
    var t=ECHO_ROOM_THEMES[key];
    html += '<div class="room-theme-choice" onclick="saveRoomTheme(\''+key+'\')">' +
      '<div class="room-theme-swatch" style="background:'+t.accent+';"></div>'+t.name+'</div>';
  });
  box.innerHTML=html;
  document.getElementById('room-theme-modal').style.display='flex';
}
function saveRoomTheme(key) {
  if (!currentRoomId || !currentRoomIsOwner || !ECHO_ROOM_THEMES[key] || !currentUser) return;

  var sb = getSupabase();
  var roomId = currentRoomId;

  sb.from('rooms')
    .update({ theme_key: key })
    .eq('id', roomId)
    .eq('owner_id', currentUser.id)
    .select('theme_key')
    .maybeSingle()
    .then(function(res) {
      if (res.error) {
        showMessage('Theme', res.error.message);
        return;
      }

      /* Supabase can return no error but update zero rows when RLS blocks it.
         Only treat the theme as saved after the database returns it. */
      if (!res.data || res.data.theme_key !== key) {
        showMessage('Theme', 'The room theme could not be saved. Run the supplied Top 8 theme permission update once in Supabase.');
        return;
      }

      if (currentRoomId === roomId) applyCrewRoomTheme(res.data.theme_key);
      document.getElementById('room-theme-modal').style.display = 'none';
    });
}

function writeCrewPresence(roomId, typing) {
  if (!roomId || !currentUser) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var now = new Date();
  var typingUntil = typing ? new Date(now.getTime() + 7000).toISOString() : null;
  sb.from('room_presence').upsert({
    room_id: roomId,
    user_id: currentUser.id,
    last_seen: now.toISOString(),
    typing_until: typingUntil
  }, { onConflict: 'room_id,user_id' }).then(function() {});
}
function startCrewPresence(roomId) {
  if (crewPresenceInterval) clearInterval(crewPresenceInterval);
  crewTypingActive = false;
  crewLastTypingAt = 0;
  writeCrewPresence(roomId, false);
  crewPresenceInterval = setInterval(function() {
    if (currentRoomId !== roomId || !currentUser) return;
    var stillTyping = crewTypingActive && (Date.now() - crewLastTypingAt < 4500);
    if (!stillTyping) crewTypingActive = false;
    writeCrewPresence(roomId, stillTyping);
  }, 4000);
}
function stopCrewPresence() {
  if (crewPresenceInterval) clearInterval(crewPresenceInterval);
  crewPresenceInterval = null;
  if (crewTypingTimer) clearTimeout(crewTypingTimer);
  crewTypingTimer = null;
  crewTypingActive = false;
  crewLastTypingAt = 0;
  if (currentRoomId && currentUser) writeCrewPresence(currentRoomId, false);
}
function handleCrewTyping() {
  if (!currentRoomId || !currentUser) return;
  crewTypingActive = true;
  crewLastTypingAt = Date.now();
  writeCrewPresence(currentRoomId, true);
  if (crewTypingTimer) clearTimeout(crewTypingTimer);
  crewTypingTimer = setTimeout(function() {
    if (!currentRoomId) return;
    if (Date.now() - crewLastTypingAt >= 3800) {
      crewTypingActive = false;
      writeCrewPresence(currentRoomId, false);
    }
  }, 4000);
}
function loadCrewTyping(roomId) {
  var indicator=document.getElementById('crew-typing-indicator');
  if(!indicator || !currentUser) return;
  var sb=getSupabase();
  sb.from('room_presence').select('user_id,typing_until').eq('room_id',roomId).then(function(res){
    if(res.error){ indicator.innerHTML=''; return; }
    var now=Date.now();
    var ids=(res.data||[]).filter(function(r){ return r.user_id!==currentUser.id && r.typing_until && new Date(r.typing_until).getTime()>now; }).map(function(r){return r.user_id;});
    if(!ids.length){ indicator.innerHTML=''; return; }
    sb.from('profiles').select('id,display_name,username').in('id',ids).then(function(p){
      var names=(p.data||[]).map(function(u){return u.display_name||u.username||'Someone';});
      indicator.textContent = names.join(', ') + (names.length===1 ? ' is typing…' : ' are typing…');
    });
  });
}

function loadCrew() {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb || !currentUser) return;

  var crewUserId = currentUser.id;
  var crewToken = accountSessionToken;

  sb.from('room_members').select('room_id').eq('user_id', crewUserId).then(function(res) {
    if (!currentUser || currentUser.id !== crewUserId || accountSessionToken !== crewToken) return;

    var roomIds = (res.data || []).map(function(r) { return r.room_id; });

    if (currentRoomId && roomIds.indexOf(parseInt(currentRoomId)) === -1 && roomIds.indexOf(currentRoomId) === -1) {
      var staleRoomId = currentRoomId;

      sb.from('rooms').select('name').eq('id', staleRoomId).maybeSingle().then(function(r) {
        if (!currentUser || currentUser.id !== crewUserId || accountSessionToken !== crewToken) return;

        var name = (r.data && r.data.name) ? r.data.name : 'the room';
        document.getElementById('kicked-text').innerHTML =
          'You have been kicked from <strong>' + echoEscapeHtml(name) + '</strong>';
        document.getElementById('kicked-modal').style.display = 'flex';

        currentRoomId = null;
        currentRoomIsOwner = false;
        if (crewPollInterval) clearInterval(crewPollInterval);
        if (crewMemberPollInterval) clearInterval(crewMemberPollInterval);
        crewPollInterval = null;
        crewMemberPollInterval = null;

        var roomNameText = document.getElementById('room-name-text');
        if (roomNameText) roomNameText.textContent = 'Select a room';
        document.getElementById('crew-messages').innerHTML = '';
        document.getElementById('crew-input-area').style.display = 'none';
      });
    }

    if (roomIds.length === 0) {
      document.getElementById('crew-room-list').innerHTML =
        '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">No rooms yet</p>';
      document.getElementById('crew-messages').innerHTML = '';
      document.getElementById('crew-input-area').style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }

    sb.from('rooms').select('id, name, owner_id').in('id', roomIds).then(function(rooms) {
      if (!currentUser || currentUser.id !== crewUserId || accountSessionToken !== crewToken) return;

      var html = '';
      if (rooms.data) {
        for (var i = 0; i < rooms.data.length; i++) {
          var r = rooms.data[i];
          html += '<div style="padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;" onclick="openCrewRoom(' +
            r.id + ')">' + echoEscapeHtml(r.name || 'Room') +
            (r.owner_id === crewUserId ? ' (owner)' : '') + '</div>';
        }
      }

      document.getElementById('crew-room-list').innerHTML =
        html || '<p style="font-size:12px;color:#888;">No rooms yet</p>';
    });
  });
}

function openCreateRoom() {
  if (!currentUser) { showMessage('Sign in', 'Sign in to create a room'); return; }
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('rooms').select('id').eq('owner_id', currentUser.id).then(function(res) {
    if (res.data && res.data.length > 0) { showMessage('Limit', 'You can only own 1 room'); return; }
    sb.from('room_members').select('room_id').eq('user_id', currentUser.id).then(function(mem) {
      if (mem.data && mem.data.length >= 3) { showMessage('Limit', 'You can only be in 3 rooms total'); return; }
      document.getElementById('room-name-input').value = '';
      document.getElementById('create-room-modal').style.display = 'flex';
    });
  });
}
function closeCreateRoom() { document.getElementById('create-room-modal').style.display = 'none'; }
function confirmCreateRoom() {
  var name = document.getElementById('room-name-input').value.trim().substring(0, 20);
  if (!name) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('rooms').insert({ name: name, owner_id: currentUser.id }).select().then(function(ins) {
    if (ins.error) { showMessage('Error', ins.error.message); return; }
    var roomId = ins.data[0].id;
    sb.from('room_members').insert({ room_id: roomId, user_id: currentUser.id }).then(function() {
      closeCreateRoom();
      loadCrew();
      openCrewRoom(roomId);
      checkEchoBadges();
    });
  });
}

var crewPollInterval = null;
var crewMemberPollInterval = null;
var crewMessageToDelete = null;
function toggleRoomMenu() {
  var menu = document.getElementById('room-menu');
  if (!menu || !currentRoomId) return;
  if (menu.style.display === 'block') {
    menu.style.opacity = '0';
    menu.style.transform = 'translateY(-6px)';
    setTimeout(function() { menu.style.display = 'none'; }, 150);
  } else {
    menu.style.display = 'block';
    setTimeout(function() { menu.style.opacity = '1'; menu.style.transform = 'translateY(0)'; }, 10);
  }
}
function changeRoomName() {
  document.getElementById('room-menu').style.display = 'none';
  if (!currentRoomId || !currentUser || !currentRoomIsOwner) return;
  var currentName = document.getElementById('room-name-text').textContent.replace(/\s*▾\s*$/, '').trim();
  var input = document.getElementById('rename-room-input');
  input.value = currentName;
  document.getElementById('rename-room-modal').style.display = 'flex';
  setTimeout(function() { input.focus(); input.select(); }, 20);
}

function closeRenameRoom() {
  document.getElementById('rename-room-modal').style.display = 'none';
}

function confirmChangeRoomName() {
  if (!currentRoomId || !currentUser || !currentRoomIsOwner) {
    closeRenameRoom();
    return;
  }

  var input = document.getElementById('rename-room-input');
  var newName = (input.value || '').trim().substring(0, 20);
  if (!newName) {
    showMessage('Room name', 'Please enter a room name.');
    return;
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();
  var roomId = currentRoomId;
  sb.from('rooms')
    .update({ name: newName })
    .eq('id', roomId)
    .eq('owner_id', currentUser.id)
    .then(function(res) {
      if (res.error) {
        showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
        return;
      }
      closeRenameRoom();
      if (currentRoomId === roomId) document.getElementById('room-name-text').textContent = newName + ' ▾';
      loadCrew();
    });
}

function loadRoomMembers(roomId, isOwner) {
  var sb = getSupabase();

  sb.from('room_members').select('user_id, joined_at').eq('room_id', roomId).order('joined_at', { ascending:true }).then(function(res) {
    var members = res.data || [];
    var ids = members.map(function(m) { return m.user_id; });
    if (ids.length === 0) return;

    sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url').in('id', ids).then(function(prof) {
      var map = {};
      if (prof.data) for (var j = 0; j < prof.data.length; j++) {
        var p = prof.data[j];
        map[p.id] = { name:p.display_name || p.username || 'user', avatar:p.avatar_url };
      }

      sb.from('room_presence').select('user_id,last_seen').eq('room_id', roomId).then(function(presenceRes) {
        var online = {};
        if (!presenceRes.error) {
          var threshold = Date.now() - 35000;
          (presenceRes.data || []).forEach(function(r) {
            if (r.last_seen && new Date(r.last_seen).getTime() >= threshold) online[r.user_id] = true;
          });
        }

        var sideHtml = '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#666;margin-bottom:6px;">Members</div>';
        var dropHtml = '';

        for (var i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
          var u = map[members[i].user_id] || { name:'user', avatar:null };
          var dot = online[members[i].user_id] ? '<span class="crew-online-dot" title="Online"></span>' : '';
          var kick = (isOwner && members[i].user_id !== currentUser.id)
            ? ' <span style="color:#e0245e;cursor:pointer;font-size:11px;margin-left:4px;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();kickFromRoom(\'' +
              members[i].user_id + '\')">kick</span>'
            : '';

          sideHtml += '<div style="margin:4px 0;"><div style="display:inline-block;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:6px;background:' +
            echoHtmlCssBackground(u.avatar, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
            ' center/cover;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:6px;cursor:pointer;" onclick="viewProfile(\'' +
            members[i].user_id + '\')"></div><span style="font-size:12px;">' +
            echoEscapeHtml(u.name) + '</span>' + dot + kick + '</div>';

          dropHtml += '<div style="padding:6px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;font-size:12px;color:#333;cursor:pointer;" onclick="viewProfile(\'' +
            members[i].user_id + '\')">' + echoEscapeHtml(u.name) + dot + '</div>';
        }

        var dd = document.getElementById('members-dropdown');
        if (dd) dd.innerHTML = dropHtml || '<div style="padding:8px;color:#888;">No members</div>';

        var roomList = document.getElementById('crew-room-list');
        if (roomList && currentRoomId === roomId) {
          var existing = roomList.querySelector('.crew-members-side');
          if (existing) existing.remove();
          var div = document.createElement('div');
          div.className = 'crew-members-side';
          div.style.marginTop = '12px';
          div.innerHTML = sideHtml;
          roomList.appendChild(div);
        }
      });
    });
  });
}

function inviteToRoom() {
  if (!currentRoomId) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('room_members').select('user_id').eq('room_id', currentRoomId).then(function(mem) {
    if (mem.data && mem.data.length >= 8) { showMessage('Full', 'Room is full (max 8)'); return; }
    sb.from('follows').select('following_id').eq('follower_id', currentUser.id).then(function(following) {
      var followingIds = (following.data || []).map(function(f) { return f.following_id; });
      if (followingIds.length === 0) { showMessage('No one', 'You need mutual follows to invite'); return; }
      sb.from('follows').select('follower_id').eq('following_id', currentUser.id).in('follower_id', followingIds).then(function(mutual) {
        var mutualIds = (mutual.data || []).map(function(m) { return m.follower_id; });
        if (mutualIds.length === 0) { showMessage('No one', 'No mutual follows to invite'); return; }
        var existing = (mem.data || []).map(function(m) { return m.user_id; });
        var available = mutualIds.filter(function(id) { return existing.indexOf(id) === -1; });
        if (available.length === 0) { showMessage('None', 'All mutual follows are already in the room'); return; }
        sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url').in('id', available).then(function(prof) {
          var list = document.getElementById('invite-list');
          var html = '';
          if (prof.data) for (var i = 0; i < prof.data.length; i++) {
            var p = prof.data[i];
            var inviteName = p.display_name || p.username || 'user';
            html += '<div class="echo-safe-room-invite" data-user-id="' +
              echoEscapeHtml(p.id) +
              '" data-user-name="' +
              echoEscapeHtml(inviteName) +
              '" style="padding:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;cursor:pointer;"' +
              ' onclick="sendInvite(this.getAttribute(\'data-user-id\'),this.getAttribute(\'data-user-name\'))">' +
              '<div style="display:inline-block;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:6px;background:' +
              echoHtmlCssBackground(p.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
              ' center/cover;vertical-align:middle;margin-right:8px;"></div>' +
              echoEscapeHtml(inviteName) +
              '</div>';
          }
          list.innerHTML = html || '<p style="color:#888;">No one to invite</p>';
          document.getElementById('invite-modal').style.display = 'flex';
        });
      });
    });
  });
}

function deleteRoom() {
  if (!currentRoomId || !currentUser || !currentRoomIsOwner) return;
  document.getElementById('delete-room-modal').style.display = 'flex';
}
function confirmDeleteRoom() {
  document.getElementById('delete-room-modal').style.display = 'none';
  if (!currentRoomId || !currentUser || !currentRoomIsOwner) return;

  var sb = getSupabase();
  var deletedRoomId = currentRoomId;

  sb.from('rooms')
    .delete()
    .eq('id', deletedRoomId)
    .eq('owner_id', currentUser.id)
    .then(function(res) {
      if (res.error) {
        showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
        return;
      }

      /* Fully detach the deleted room before rebuilding the list.
         This prevents stale room/menu/presence state from blocking
         clicks on the remaining Top 8 rooms. */
      if (currentRoomId === deletedRoomId) {
        stopCrewPresence();

        currentRoomId = null;
        currentRoomIsOwner = false;
        currentCrewUnreadCutoff = null;
        crewTypingActive = false;
        crewLastTypingAt = 0;

        if (crewTypingTimer) {
          clearTimeout(crewTypingTimer);
          crewTypingTimer = null;
        }
        if (crewPollInterval) {
          clearInterval(crewPollInterval);
          crewPollInterval = null;
        }
        if (crewMemberPollInterval) {
          clearInterval(crewMemberPollInterval);
          crewMemberPollInterval = null;
        }

        var roomMenu = document.getElementById('room-menu');
        if (roomMenu) {
          roomMenu.style.display = 'none';
          roomMenu.style.opacity = '0';
          roomMenu.style.transform = 'translateY(-6px)';
        }

        var membersDropdown = document.getElementById('members-dropdown');
        if (membersDropdown) {
          membersDropdown.style.display = 'none';
          membersDropdown.style.opacity = '0';
          membersDropdown.style.transform = 'translateY(-6px)';
        }

        var themeModal = document.getElementById('room-theme-modal');
        if (themeModal) themeModal.style.display = 'none';

        var renameModal = document.getElementById('rename-room-modal');
        if (renameModal) renameModal.style.display = 'none';

        /* Keep the existing header/menu DOM intact. Replacing the whole
           header removed #room-name-text and made other rooms impossible
           to open until refresh. */
        var roomNameText = document.getElementById('room-name-text');
        if (roomNameText) {
          roomNameText.textContent = 'Select a room ▾';
          roomNameText.style.color = '#ccc';
        }

        document.getElementById('crew-messages').innerHTML = '';
        document.getElementById('crew-input-area').style.display = 'none';

        var typingIndicator = document.getElementById('crew-typing-indicator');
        if (typingIndicator) typingIndicator.innerHTML = '';
      }

      /* Rebuild remaining rooms only after deletion/state cleanup completes. */
      loadCrew();
    });
}

function showCrewProfilePopup(userId, el) {
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var existing = document.getElementById('crew-profile-popup');
  if (existing) existing.remove();

  sb.from('profiles').select('username, display_name, avatar_url').eq('id', userId).maybeSingle().then(function(prof) {
    if (!prof.data) return;

    var name = prof.data.display_name || prof.data.username || 'user';
    var avatar = echoSafeImageUrl(prof.data.avatar_url, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR);
    var popup = document.createElement('div');
    popup.id = 'crew-profile-popup';
    popup.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:6px;padding:10px;z-index:100;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);min-width:140px;text-align:center;';

    popup.innerHTML =
      '<img src="' + echoEscapeHtml(avatar) + '" style="width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:8px;">' +
      '<div style="font-weight:bold;margin-top:4px;">' + echoEscapeHtml(name) + '</div>' +
      '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#888;">@' + echoEscapeHtml(prof.data.username || 'user') + '</div>' +
      '<div style="margin-top:6px;font-size:12px;"><span id="cp-echos">0</span> Echos · <span id="cp-followers">0</span> Followers · <span id="cp-following">0</span> Following</div>' +
      '<a href="#" onclick="viewProfile(\'' + userId + '\');document.getElementById(\'crew-profile-popup\').remove();return false;" style="font-size:11px;color:#1da1f2;">View profile</a>';

    var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    popup.style.left = (rect.left + 30) + 'px';
    popup.style.top = (rect.top - 10) + 'px';
    document.body.appendChild(popup);

    sb.from('posts').select('id', { count:'exact' }).eq('user_id', userId).then(function(r) {
      var e = document.getElementById('cp-echos'); if (e) e.textContent = r.count || 0;
    });
    sb.from('follows').select('following_id', { count:'exact' }).eq('follower_id', userId).then(function(r) {
      var e = document.getElementById('cp-following'); if (e) e.textContent = r.count || 0;
    });
    sb.from('follows').select('follower_id', { count:'exact' }).eq('following_id', userId).then(function(r) {
      var e = document.getElementById('cp-followers'); if (e) e.textContent = r.count || 0;
    });

    setTimeout(function() {
      document.addEventListener('click', function closePopup(e) {
        if (!popup.contains(e.target)) {
          popup.remove();
          document.removeEventListener('click', closePopup);
        }
      });
    }, 100);
  });
}

function sendInvite(userId, name) {
  document.getElementById('invite-modal').style.display = 'none';
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('room_members').select('room_id').eq('user_id', userId).then(function(theirRooms) {
    if (theirRooms.data && theirRooms.data.length >= 3) { showMessage('Limit', 'That user is already in 3 rooms'); return; }
    sb.from('room_invites').insert({ room_id: currentRoomId, inviter_id: currentUser.id, invitee_id: userId, status: 'pending' }).then(function(ins) {
      if (ins.error) showMessage('Error', ins.error.message);
      else showMessage('Invited', 'Invite sent to ' + echoEscapeHtml(name));
    });
  });
}

var pendingKickUserId = null;
function kickFromRoom(userId) {
  if (!currentRoomId || !currentUser || !currentRoomIsOwner || userId === currentUser.id) return;
  pendingKickUserId = userId;
  document.getElementById('kick-modal').style.display = 'flex';
}
function confirmKick() {
  document.getElementById('kick-modal').style.display = 'none';
  if (!currentRoomId || !pendingKickUserId || !currentUser || !currentRoomIsOwner) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var roomId = currentRoomId;
  var userId = pendingKickUserId;
  sb.from('rooms').select('owner_id').eq('id', roomId).maybeSingle().then(function(roomRes) {
    if (!roomRes.data || roomRes.data.owner_id !== currentUser.id) {
      pendingKickUserId = null;
      currentRoomIsOwner = false;
      return;
    }
    sb.from('room_members').delete().eq('room_id', roomId).eq('user_id', userId).then(function(res) {
      pendingKickUserId = null;
      if (res.error) { showMessage('Error', res.error.message); return; }
      if (currentRoomId === roomId) openCrewRoom(roomId);
    });
  });
}

var crewLastSeen = {};
var crewHasUnread = false;
function crewSeenStorageKey() {
  return currentUser && currentUser.id ? 'echoCrewSeen:' + currentUser.id : null;
}

function markCrewRead(roomId) {
  if (!roomId || !currentUser) return;
  crewLastSeen[roomId] = new Date().toISOString();
  var key = crewSeenStorageKey();
  if (key) localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(crewLastSeen));
  crewHasUnread = false;
  updateCrewIcon();
}
function updateCrewIcon() {
  var icon = document.getElementById('icon-crew');
  if (!icon) return;
  var active = document.getElementById('nav-crew') && document.getElementById('nav-crew').className === 'active';
  if (crewHasUnread && !active) {
    icon.src = 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/1213_orig.png';
  } else if (active) {
    icon.src = 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/chat1_orig.png';
  } else {
    icon.src = 'https://www.theechonetwork.net/uploads/1/5/2/9/152994747/chat_orig.png';
  }
}
function checkCrewUnread() {
  if (!currentUser) return;

  var unreadUserId = currentUser.id;
  var unreadToken = accountSessionToken;
  var seenKey = crewSeenStorageKey();

  try {
    crewLastSeen = JSON.parse((seenKey && localStorage.getItem(seenKey)) || '{}');
  } catch(e) {
    crewLastSeen = {};
  }

  var sb = getSupabase();

  sb.from('room_members').select('room_id').eq('user_id', unreadUserId).then(function(res) {
    if (!currentUser || currentUser.id !== unreadUserId || accountSessionToken !== unreadToken) return;

    var roomIds = (res.data || []).map(function(r) { return r.room_id; });

    if (roomIds.length === 0) {
      crewHasUnread = false;
      updateCrewIcon();
      echoCrewUnreadInitialized = true;
      return;
    }

    var since = '2000-01-01T00:00:00Z';
    for (var id in crewLastSeen) if (crewLastSeen[id] > since) since = crewLastSeen[id];

    sb.from('room_messages')
      .select('id')
      .in('room_id', roomIds)
      .gt('created_at', since)
      .neq('user_id', unreadUserId)
      .limit(1)
      .then(function(msgs) {
        if (!currentUser || currentUser.id !== unreadUserId || accountSessionToken !== unreadToken) return;

        var hadUnread = crewHasUnread;
        crewHasUnread = !!(msgs.data && msgs.data.length > 0);
        updateCrewIcon();

        if (echoCrewUnreadInitialized && crewHasUnread && !hadUnread) playEchoNotificationSound();
        echoCrewUnreadInitialized = true;
      });
  });
}

function loadCrewMessages(roomId) {
if (!currentUser) return;

var sb = getSupabase();
var box = document.getElementById('crew-messages');
var messageUserId = currentUser.id;
var messageToken = accountSessionToken;

function stillSameRoom() {
return !!(
currentUser &&
currentUser.id === messageUserId &&
accountSessionToken === messageToken &&
currentRoomId === roomId
);
}

sb.from('room_messages')
.select('id, user_id, text, image_url, created_at')
.eq('room_id', roomId)
.order('created_at', { ascending:true })
.limit(100)
.then(function(res) {
if (!stillSameRoom()) return;

var messages = res.data || [];

sb.from('follows')
.select('following_id')
.eq('follower_id', messageUserId)
.then(function(follows) {
if (!stillSameRoom()) return;

var followingIds = (follows.data || []).map(function(f) { return f.following_id; });
rememberCrewFollowingList(followingIds);

sb.from('room_members')
.select('user_id, joined_at')
.eq('room_id', roomId)
.then(function(mem) {
if (!stillSameRoom()) return;

var joins = (mem.data || []).map(function(m) {
return { user_id:m.user_id, created_at:m.joined_at, isJoin:true };
});

var all = messages.concat(joins);
all.sort(function(a, b) { return new Date(a.created_at) - new Date(b.created_at); });

if (all.length === 0) {
box.innerHTML = '<p style="text-align:center;color:#888;font-size:12px;">No messages yet</p>';
return;
}

var ids = [];
for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
if (ids.indexOf(all[i].user_id) === -1) ids.push(all[i].user_id);
}

sb.from('profiles').select('id, username, display_name, avatar_url').in('id', ids).then(function(prof) {
if (!stillSameRoom()) return;

var map = {};
if (prof.data) {
for (var j = 0; j < prof.data.length; j++) {
var p = prof.data[j];
map[p.id] = {
name:p.display_name || p.username || 'user',
username:p.username || 'user',
avatar:p.avatar_url
};
}
}

var html = '';
var hiddenSenders = {};

for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
var m = all[i];
var u = map[m.user_id] || { name:'user', username:'user', avatar:null };

if (m.isJoin) {
html += '<div style="text-align:center;margin:8px 0;font-size:12px;color:#888;">' +
echoEscapeHtml(u.name) + ' joined</div>';
continue;
}

if (m.user_id !== messageUserId && followingIds.indexOf(m.user_id) === -1) {
hiddenSenders[m.user_id] = {
username:u.username,
previouslyFollowed:wasCrewUserPreviouslyFollowed(m.user_id)
};
continue;
}

if (currentCrewUnreadCutoff &&
new Date(m.created_at).getTime() > new Date(currentCrewUnreadCutoff).getTime()) {
html += '<div class="crew-unread-divider">NEW MESSAGES</div>';
currentCrewUnreadCutoff = null;
}

var isMe = m.user_id === messageUserId;
var align = isMe ? 'right' : 'left';
var activeTheme = getCrewTheme();
var bg = isMe ? activeTheme.accent : (activeTheme.otherBubble || '#ddd');
var color = isMe ? '#fff' : (activeTheme.otherText || '#333');

html += '<div style="text-align:' + align + ';margin:6px 0;clear:both;">';

if (!isMe) {
html += '<div style="display:inline-block;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:6px;background:' +
echoHtmlCssBackground(u.avatar, ECHO_FALLBACK_AVATAR) +
' center/cover;vertical-align:bottom;margin-right:6px;cursor:pointer;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();showCrewProfilePopup(\'' +
m.user_id + '\', this)"></div>';
}

var safeCrewImage = m.image_url ? echoSafeHttpUrl(m.image_url) : '';
var crewMessageBody = '';

if (safeCrewImage) {
crewMessageBody += '<img src="' + echoEscapeHtml(safeCrewImage) +
'" alt="Top 8 chat image" loading="lazy" style="display:block;max-width:min(280px,65vw);max-height:320px;width:auto;height:auto;border-radius:8px;object-fit:contain;cursor:pointer;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();window.open(this.src,\'_blank\',\'noopener\')">';
}

if (m.text && m.text !== '[Image]') {
crewMessageBody += (safeCrewImage ? '<div style="margin-top:6px;">' : '') +
echoEscapeHtml(m.text) +
(safeCrewImage ? '</div>' : '');
}

html += '<div style="display:inline-block;max-width:70%;background:' + bg +
';color:' + color +
';padding:8px 12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;text-align:left;">' +
crewMessageBody + '</div>';

var canDeleteMessage = isMe || currentRoomIsOwner;
var deleteMessageLink = canDeleteMessage
? ' · <span style="color:#e0245e;cursor:pointer;" onclick="event.stopPropagation();deleteOwnCrewMessage(' +
m.id + ')">Delete</span>'
: '';

html += '<div style="font-size:10px;color:#888;margin-top:2px;">' +
(isMe ? '' : echoEscapeHtml(u.name) + ' · ') +
timeAgo(m.created_at) +
deleteMessageLink +
'</div></div>';
}

var hiddenIds = Object.keys(hiddenSenders);
for (var h = 0; h < hiddenIds.length; h++) {
var hidden = hiddenSenders[hiddenIds[h]];
var notice = hidden.previouslyFollowed
? 'Because you unfollowed @' + hidden.username + ', you can no longer see their messages.'
: 'You must be following @' + hidden.username + ' to see their messages.';

html += '<div style="text-align:center;margin:10px 0;padding:9px 10px;background:#fff3cd;border:1px solid #ffe69c;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;color:#856404;">' +
echoEscapeHtml(notice) + '</div>';
}

if (!stillSameRoom()) return;
box.innerHTML = html;
box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
});
});
});
});
}

function deleteOwnCrewMessage(messageId) {
  if (!currentRoomId || !currentUser || !messageId) return;
  crewMessageToDelete = messageId;
  document.getElementById('deletemessage-modal').style.display = 'flex';
}

function closeDeleteOwnCrewMessage() {
  document.getElementById('deletemessage-modal').style.display = 'none';
  crewMessageToDelete = null;
}

function confirmDeleteOwnCrewMessage() {
  if (!currentRoomId || !currentUser || crewMessageToDelete === null) return;
  var sb = getSupabase();
  var messageId = crewMessageToDelete;
  var roomId = currentRoomId;
  var deleteQuery = sb.from('room_messages').delete().eq('id', messageId).eq('room_id', roomId);

  if (!currentRoomIsOwner) deleteQuery = deleteQuery.eq('user_id', currentUser.id);

  deleteQuery.then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) {
      closeDeleteOwnCrewMessage();
      showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
      return;
    }

    sb.from('room_messages').select('id').eq('id', messageId).maybeSingle().then(function(check) {
      closeDeleteOwnCrewMessage();

      if (check.error) {
        showMessage('Error', check.error.message);
        return;
      }

      if (check.data) {
        showMessage('Delete permission needed', 'Supabase is blocking this message deletion. Run the supplied Top 8 owner delete policy once in the Supabase SQL Editor.');
        return;
      }

      if (currentRoomId === roomId) loadCrewMessages(roomId);
    });
  });
}

function sendCrewImage(input) {
  if (!input || !input.files || !input.files[0] || !currentRoomId || !currentUser) return;

  var file = input.files[0];
  input.value = '';

  var messageInput = document.getElementById('crew-msg-input');
  var caption = messageInput ? (messageInput.value || '').trim().substring(0, 300) : '';

  var banned = ['nigger','nigga','faggot','retard','kike','spic','chink','tranny','dyke'];
  var lowerCaption = caption.toLowerCase();

  for (var b = 0; b < banned.length; b++) {
    if (lowerCaption.indexOf(banned[b]) !== -1) {
      showMessage('Not allowed', 'That word is not allowed');
      return;
    }
  }

  var allowed = ['image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','image/gif'];
  if (allowed.indexOf(file.type) === -1) {
    showMessage('Image', 'Please choose a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.');
    return;
  }

  if(file.size>1*1024*1024){showMessage('Image too large','That image is too large to send. Top 8 chat images must be 1MB or smaller. Please choose a smaller image.');return;}

  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (!sb) return;

  var roomId = currentRoomId;
  var senderId = currentUser.id;
  var ext = (file.name.split('.').pop() || 'jpg').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
  if (!ext) ext = 'jpg';

  var path = senderId + '/' + roomId + '/' + Date.now() + '-' +
    Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10) + '.' + ext;

  sb.storage.from('top8-chat').upload(path, file, {
    upsert: false,
    contentType: file.type,
    cacheControl: '3600'
  }).then(function(uploadRes) {
    if (uploadRes.error) {
      showMessage('Image', uploadRes.error.message);
      return;
    }

    var imageUrl = sb.storage.from('top8-chat').getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl;

    sb.from('room_messages').insert({
      room_id: roomId,
      user_id: senderId,
      text: caption || '[Image]',
      image_url: imageUrl
    }).then(function(messageRes) {
      if (messageRes.error) {
        sb.storage.from('top8-chat').remove([path]);
        showMessage('Image', messageRes.error.message);
        return;
      }

      if (messageInput) messageInput.value = '';
      crewTypingActive = false;
      crewLastTypingAt = 0;

      if (crewTypingTimer) clearTimeout(crewTypingTimer);
      crewTypingTimer = null;

      writeCrewPresence(roomId, false);
      loadCrewMessages(roomId);
    });
  });
}

function sendCrewMessage() {
  if (!currentRoomId || !currentUser) return;
  var input = document.getElementById('crew-msg-input');
  var text = (input.value || '').trim().substring(0, 300);
  if (!text) return;
  var banned = ['nigger','nigga','faggot','retard','kike','spic','chink','tranny','dyke'];
  var lower = text.toLowerCase();
  for (var i = 0; i < banned.length; i++) {
    if (lower.indexOf(banned[i]) !== -1) { showMessage('Not allowed', 'That word is not allowed'); return; }
  }
  var sb = getSupabase();
  sb.from('room_messages').insert({ room_id: currentRoomId, user_id: currentUser.id, text: text }).then(function(res) {
    if (res.error) showMessage('Error', res.error.message);
    else {
      input.value = '';
      crewTypingActive = false;
      crewLastTypingAt = 0;
      if (crewTypingTimer) clearTimeout(crewTypingTimer);
      crewTypingTimer = null;
      writeCrewPresence(currentRoomId, false);
      loadCrewMessages(currentRoomId);
    }
  });
}

function clearSearch() {
  var search = document.getElementById('search-input');
  if (search) { search.value = ''; search.setAttribute('value', ''); }
}

window.onload = function() {
  window.addEventListener('popstate', function(event) {
    var settingsModal = document.getElementById('edit-profile-modal');
    if (settingsModal && settingsModal.style.display !== 'none') closeEditProfile();
    if (!currentUser) return;

    var state = event.state || {};

    if (state.echoPage === 'profile' && state.profileUserId) {
      var backTab = ['echos','favorites','comments','top8'].indexOf(state.profileTab) !== -1
        ? state.profileTab
        : 'echos';

      viewProfile(state.profileUserId, function() {
        if (backTab !== 'echos') showProfileTab(backTab, true);
      }, true);
      return;
    }

    if (state.echoPage && document.getElementById('page-' + state.echoPage)) {
      showPage(state.echoPage, true);
      return;
    }

    showPage('home', true);
  });
  history.replaceState({ echoPage:'home' }, '', location.href);
  clearSearch();
  setTimeout(clearSearch, 50);
  setTimeout(clearSearch, 200);
  setTimeout(clearSearch, 800);
  loadLocal();
  var sb = getSupabase();
  if (sb) {
    sb.auth.getUser().then(function(res) {
      currentUser = res.data.user;
      if (currentUser) accountSessionToken++;
      if (currentUser) {
        loadDismissedNotifications();
        checkAccountModeration(function(allowed) {
          if (!allowed) return;
          maybeRequirePostVerifyInterests(function() {
            loadProfile();
            loadPosts(); loadTrending();
            setTimeout(restoreEchoLastPage, 80);
            checkEchoAdmin();
            setTimeout(function() { maybeShowWelcomeEcho(currentUser); }, 500);
            setTimeout(checkPendingAdminWarning, 850);
            setInterval(checkNotifications, 30000);
            setInterval(checkCrewUnread, 15000);

            /* Pull anything that arrived while offline immediately after auth,
               so the unread bell appears on boot rather than after opening it. */
            checkNotifications();
            setTimeout(checkCrewUnread, 3000);
            var params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            var postId = params.get('post');
            if (postId) setTimeout(function() { openPostModal(parseInt(postId)); }, 1500);
          });
        });
      } else {
        updateUI();
        openAuth('signin');
      }
    });
  } else {
    openAuth('signin');
  }
};
</script>

<script>

(function () {
  var mobileQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1024px) and (pointer: coarse)');

  function syncMobileUserInfoPosition() {
    var container = document.querySelector('.container');
    var main = document.getElementById('main-content');
    var sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
    var userInfo = document.getElementById('own-sidebar');
    if (!container || !main || !sidebar || !userInfo) return;

    if (mobileQuery.matches) {
      if (userInfo.parentNode !== main || main.firstElementChild !== userInfo) {
        main.insertBefore(userInfo, main.firstChild);
      }
    } else {
      if (userInfo.parentNode !== sidebar || sidebar.firstElementChild !== userInfo) {
        sidebar.insertBefore(userInfo, sidebar.firstChild);
      }
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', syncMobileUserInfoPosition);
  } else {
    syncMobileUserInfoPosition();
  }

  window.addEventListener('load', syncMobileUserInfoPosition);
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function () {
    setTimeout(syncMobileUserInfoPosition, 100);
  });

  if (mobileQuery.addEventListener) {
    mobileQuery.addEventListener('change', syncMobileUserInfoPosition);
  } else if (mobileQuery.addListener) {
    mobileQuery.addListener(syncMobileUserInfoPosition);
  }
})();
</script>
